chapters.chapterName: 第一章 市場風險計量與管理
chapters.summary: 本章是FRM二級的核心計算章節（權重20%）。圍繞VaR與ES的估計展開：參數法（正態、對數正態）、非參數法（歷史模擬及其年齡加權、波動率加權、相關性加權、過濾歷史模擬變形）、極值理論（GEV與POT）；隨後是VaR模型驗證（Kupiec回測、巴塞爾交通燈、ES回測）、VaR映射（本金映射、久期映射、現金流映射）、相關性建模（均值回復、高斯Copula）、波動率微笑、相關性互換、利率期限結構模型（Model 1-4、Ho-Lee、Vasicek、CIR、Black-Karasinski）、凸性效應與詹森不等式、DV01與回歸對沖，最後是壓力測試、FRTB流動性期限、交易賬簿與銀行賬簿之區分等監管內容。考試常見陷阱：正常VaR與對數正常VaR公式混用、歷史模擬各加權變形的優缺點辨析、GEV形狀參數ξ與分布對應關係、回測例外次數與懲罰乘數、不同期限結構模型的漂移與波動率設定等。
chapters.summaryEn: This chapter (20% weight) covers estimation of market risk measures: parametric (normal and lognormal VaR), non-parametric approaches (historical simulation and its age-weighted, volatility-weighted, correlation-weighted and filtered variants), and extreme value theory (GEV and POT). It then covers VaR model validation (Kupiec test, Basel traffic-light approach, backtesting the full distribution with ES), VaR mapping (principal, duration and cash-flow mapping), correlation modeling (mean reversion, Gaussian copula), the volatility smile, correlation swaps, term structure models (Models 1-4, Ho-Lee, Vasicek, CIR, Black-Karasinski), the convexity effect and Jensen's inequality, DV01 and regression hedging, and regulatory topics: stress testing, FRTB liquidity horizons, the trading versus banking book distinction, and stressed VaR. Common exam traps include mixing up normal and lognormal VaR formulas, misstating advantages of HS variants, mismatching the GEV tail parameter with distributions, and confusing backtest exception counts with capital multipliers.

concepts.title: 風險值 (VaR)
concepts.titleEn: Value at Risk (VaR)
concepts.explanation: VaR是在給定置信水平（如95%、99%）和持有期內，投資組合可能遭受的最大損失估計。要點：(1) VaR不說明超過閾值後損失有多大，即不描述尾部；(2) VaR不是一致性風險度量（不滿足次可加性），組合分散後VaR可能反而上升；(3) 置信水平越高、持有期越長，VaR越大。考試陷阱：題目給年化參數求1日期VaR時要除以√252；注意均值μ的符號處理（VaR通常取正數表示損失）。
concepts.explanationEn: VaR estimates the maximum loss expected on a portfolio over a given holding period at a stated confidence level (e.g., 95%, 99%). Key points: (1) VaR says nothing about the size of losses beyond the threshold (the tail); (2) VaR is not a coherent risk measure (it violates subadditivity), so diversification may not always reduce VaR; (3) VaR increases with confidence level and horizon. Exam trap: convert annualized moments to daily by dividing by √252, and handle the sign of the mean carefully since VaR is quoted as a positive loss.

concepts.title: 預期短缺 (Expected Shortfall, ES)
concepts.titleEn: Expected Shortfall (ES)
concepts.explanation: ES是損失超過VaR時的條件期望損失（尾部分布的平均損失）。要點：(1) ES比VaR更難計算、計算量更大，但糾正了VaR不反映尾部損失大小的缺陷；(2) ES是一致性風險度量，滿足次可加性；(3) ES對尾部建模敏感，在常態假設下可解析計算。譜風險度量（spectral risk measures）是ES的推廣，將風險厭惡程度（對不同分位虧損賦予不同權重）納入考量。考試陷阱：ES一定大於同置信水平的VaR；ES計算的是超過VaR部分的平均損失而非最大損失。
concepts.explanationEn: ES is the expected loss given that the loss exceeds VaR (the average loss in the tail). Key points: (1) ES is more complex and computationally intensive than VaR but corrects VaR's failure to reflect tail severity; (2) ES is a coherent risk measure satisfying subadditivity; (3) Under normality ES has a closed form. Spectral risk measures generalize ES by incorporating the manager's risk aversion through a weighting function over quantiles. Exam traps: ES is always at least as large as VaR at the same confidence level, and ES is an average beyond VaR, not a maximum.

concepts.title: 算術回報與幾何回報
concepts.titleEn: Arithmetic vs. Geometric Returns
concepts.explanation: 算術回報 r = (P1 − P0)/P0；幾何回報（對數回報）R = ln(1+r)。要點：(1) 幾何回報隱含假設中間支付持續再投資，且保證組合價值不為負，更具經濟意義；(2) 多期幾何回報可直接相加，方便處理多期問題；(3) 幾何回報均值低於算術回報均值（約差σ²/2）。考試陷阱：正態算術回報VaR與正態幾何（對數正態）回報VaR公式不同，不可混用；當μ與σ給定的是不同口徑時要分別對應。
concepts.explanationEn: Arithmetic return r = (P1 − P0)/P0; geometric (log) return R = ln(1+r). Key points: (1) Geometric returns implicitly assume continuous reinvestment and guarantee non-negative portfolio values, making them more economically meaningful; (2) Multi-period geometric returns are additive; (3) The mean geometric return is lower than the arithmetic mean (by roughly σ²/2). Exam trap: normal VaR on arithmetic returns and lognormal VaR on geometric returns use different formulas and must not be mixed.

concepts.title: 非參數法：歷史模擬
concepts.titleEn: Non-Parametric Approach: Historical Simulation
concepts.explanation: 歷史模擬將歷史損益數據排序，直接取分位點作為VaR。優點：直觀、計算簡單；不受偏態肥尾等參數假設違反的影響；避免複雜的方差-協方差矩陣；數據易得；可融入期限加權與波動率加權等改進。缺點：完全依賴歷史數據；波動期數據會高估VaR、平穩期會低估；難以察覺結構性/制度性變化；無法容納樣本期內未發生的大衝擊事件（鬼影效應ghost effects、遲滯效應）；新工具或新市場缺乏數據。考試陷阱：純歷史模擬無法估計大於樣本最大損失的損失，但波動率加權在一定程度上可以。
concepts.explanationEn: Historical simulation sorts historical P&L data and reads the VaR directly as a percentile. Advantages: intuitive and simple; no distributional assumptions (robust to skewness/fat tails); avoids the variance-covariance matrix; data readily available; adaptable to age-weighting and volatility-weighting. Disadvantages: relies solely on history; volatile periods overstate and calm periods understate VaR; hard to detect structural/regime changes; cannot capture large shocks absent from the sample (ghost effects and stale data); new instruments/markets lack data. Exam trap: plain HS cannot estimate losses larger than the worst in-sample loss, whereas volatility weighting can to some extent.

concepts.title: 年齡加權歷史模擬（混合法）
concepts.titleEn: Age-Weighted Historical Simulation (Hybrid Approach)
concepts.explanation: 對歷史觀測值按新舊賦予遞減權重（衰減因子λ，如0.99），越近的觀測權重越大。作用：緩解鬼影效應（舊事件長期滯留樣本）與遲滯效應（大衝擊隨時間被稀釋過慢），使VaR能及時反映近期大額損失。缺點：新數據進入時若VaR跳變可能顯得突兀；λ選擇帶有主觀性。考試陷阱：權重公式中λ的指數是i−1（最舊觀測）；該法屬於半參數法（hybrid approach）。
concepts.explanationEn: Assigns geometrically declining weights to historical observations (decay factor λ, e.g., 0.99) so recent data matter more. It mitigates ghost effects and stale-data effects, letting VaR respond quickly to recent large losses. Drawbacks: VaR can jump when new extreme data enter, and λ is subjective. Exam trap: the exponent on λ is i−1 for the oldest observation, and the method is the so-called hybrid (semi-parametric) approach.

concepts.title: 波動率加權歷史模擬
concepts.titleEn: Volatility-Weighted Historical Simulation
concepts.explanation: 用當前波動率與歷史各期波動率之比調整歷史收益：r* = (σ_T,i / σ_t,i) r_t,i，再對調整後收益取分位點。作用：(1) 解決歷史樣本過大或過小的問題；(2) 納入當前波動率背景，使VaR能反映市場狀態變化；波動率上升時VaR估計高於純歷史模擬。考試陷阱：調整的是收益而非權重（與年齡加權區別）；σ_T,i為當前（預測）波動率，σ_t,i為第t日對應資產的波動率。
concepts.explanationEn: Scales each historical return by the ratio of current to past volatility: r* = (σ_T,i / σ_t,i) r_t,i, then reads quantiles from the adjusted returns. It (1) addresses samples that are too large or too small and (2) incorporates the current volatility environment, producing higher VaR estimates when volatility rises. Exam trap: it adjusts returns, not weights (unlike age weighting); σ_T,i is today's forecast volatility and σ_t,i the volatility on the historical date.

concepts.title: 相關性加權與過濾歷史模擬
concepts.titleEn: Correlation-Weighted HS and Filtered Historical Simulation (FHS)
concepts.explanation: 相關性加權：將歷史收益乘以修訂後的相關矩陣（方差-協方差矩陣），得到最新相關性環境下的調整收益，比波動率加權更複雜。過濾歷史模擬（FHS）：將歷史模擬與GARCH等條件波動率模型結合，先擬合波動率模型提取標準化殘差，再對殘差進行自助法抽樣；是最全面也最複雜的非參數估計器，能捕捉條件波動率、波動率聚類及非對稱（槓桿）效應。考試陷阱：FHS屬於非參數+參數混合方法，兼顧傳統歷史模擬的直觀性與條件波動率的複雜性。
concepts.explanationEn: Correlation-weighted HS multiplies historical returns by a revised correlation (covariance) matrix to reflect the latest dependence environment; it is more complex than volatility weighting. Filtered Historical Simulation combines HS with conditional volatility models (GARCH or asymmetric GARCH): fit the volatility model, extract standardized residuals, then bootstrap them; it is the most comprehensive (and complicated) non-parametric estimator, capturing conditional volatility, volatility clustering and asymmetric leverage effects. Exam trap: FHS blends non-parametric resampling with parametric volatility filtering.

concepts.title: 極值理論：廣義極值分布 (GEV)
concepts.titleEn: Extreme Value Theory: Generalized Extreme Value (GEV) Distribution
concepts.explanation: 根據Fisher-Tippett定理，當樣本量趨於無窮時，區塊極大值（block maxima）的分布收斂於GEV分布。形狀參數ξ決定尾部：(1) ξ>0：Fréchet分布，厚尾，適合金融收益（實證常見0<ξ<0.35，如t分布、帕累托分布）；(2) ξ=0：Gumbel分布，薄尾，對應正態/對數正態；(3) ξ<0：Weibull分布，尾比正態更薄，很少適用於金融收益。GEV比POT多估一個參數，會損失有效數據。考試陷阱：ξ趨於0才是正態類薄尾，題目常設「ξ→∞變正態」的錯誤選項。
concepts.explanationEn: By the Fisher-Tippett theorem, the distribution of block maxima converges to the GEV distribution as the sample size grows. The shape parameter ξ determines the tail: (1) ξ>0: Fréchet, heavy tail, appropriate for financial returns (empirically often 0<ξ<0.35; like t and Pareto distributions); (2) ξ=0: Gumbel, light tails like normal/lognormal; (3) ξ<0: Weibull, tail lighter than the normal, rarely applicable to financial returns. GEV requires one more parameter than POT and wastes data. Exam trap: it is ξ→0 (not ξ→∞) that corresponds to a normal-like tail; watch distractor answers claiming otherwise.

concepts.title: 超閾值模型 (POT) 與廣義帕累托分布
concepts.titleEn: Peaks over Threshold (POT) and the Generalized Pareto Distribution
concepts.explanation: POT關注超過某一閾值u的損失分布：隨閾值u提高，超額損失分布收斂於廣義帕累托分布（GPD）。用POT參數可計算VaR與ES。要點：(1) GEV關注極大值，POT關注超閾值部分，POT數據利用率更高；(2) POT需要選擇閾值，引入額外不確定性；(3) 閾值越低超閾次數N_u越多、參數估計越可靠，但太低會違反GPD漸近性質；(4) GEV與POT的選擇取決於數據性質。考試陷阱：「提高閾值→收斂於GPD」是正確表述；「降低閾值→超閾次數減少」是錯誤表述（實為增加）。
concepts.explanationEn: POT models the distribution of losses exceeding a threshold u: as u increases, the distribution of excess losses converges to the Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD), from which VaR and ES are derived. Points: (1) GEV models block maxima while POT models exceedances, using data more efficiently; (2) POT requires choosing u, which introduces extra uncertainty; (3) A lower threshold raises the number of exceedances N_u and improves the reliability of estimates, though too low violates the asymptotic property; (4) The choice between GEV and POT depends on the data. Exam trap: 'raising u makes exceedances converge to GPD' is correct; 'lowering u reduces exceedances' is wrong (it increases them).

concepts.title: 多元極值理論與相依結構
concepts.titleEn: Multivariate EVT and Dependence Structure
concepts.explanation: 多元極值理論（MEVT）用於對多元分布的尾部建模，核心是極端事件的相依結構。在橢圓分布假設下（常以中心極限定理為依據），線性相關係數足以刻畫相依結構；但超出橢圓分布（尤其極端情形）時，線性相關不再足夠，必須使用Copula函數。考試陷阱：極端事件間的相關性往往高於正常時期（相依性增強），用線性相關外推尾部會低估聯合極端風險。
concepts.explanationEn: Multivariate EVT (MEVT) models the tails of multivariate distributions; the key issue is the dependence structure of extreme events. Under elliptical distributions (often justified by the central limit theorem), linear correlation suffices to capture dependence; beyond elliptical distributions—and especially for extremes—correlation no longer suffices and copulas are required. Exam trap: dependence among extremes is typically stronger than in normal times, so extrapolating with linear correlation understates joint extreme risk.

concepts.title: 高斯 Copula
concepts.titleEn: Gaussian Copula
concepts.explanation: 高斯Copula將各變量的邊際分布映射到標準正態分布（均值0、標準差1），是金融中應用最廣的Copula。違約時間高斯Copula：C_GD(u1,u2) = Φ2(Φ^{-1}(u1), Φ^{-1}(u2); ρ)，用於聯合違約建模（信用風險章節的CreditMetrics亦基於此）。考試陷阱：高斯Copula沒有尾部相依（tail dependence），極端行情下會低估聯合極端事件概率；但因其解析方便、與多元正態聯繫緊密而成為基準模型。
concepts.explanationEn: The Gaussian copula maps each variable's marginal distribution to the standard normal (mean 0, standard deviation 1) and is the most widely used copula in finance. The Gaussian default-time copula C_GD(u1,u2) = Φ2(Φ^{-1}(u1), Φ^{-1}(u2); ρ) underlies joint default modeling (also the basis of CreditMetrics). Exam trap: the Gaussian copula has no tail dependence and understates joint extreme events in stressed markets, but it remains the benchmark due to analytical tractability.

concepts.title: VaR回測：Kupiec檢驗
concepts.titleEn: Backtesting VaR: Kupiec Proportion-of-Failures (POF) Test
concepts.explanation: Kupiec失敗比例檢驗檢驗實際例外次數x是否與模型預期一致：原假設H0為模型正確（例外概率p = 1−置信水平）。統計量LR_POF服從χ²(1)，過大則拒絕模型。要點：(1) p=1−置信水平，T為總天數，x為例外次數；(2) 回測困難：VaR基於靜態組合，而實際組合隨價格變化與買賣不斷變動；實際損益受多風險因子影響而模型未必包含；回測樣本可能不代表真實風險；(3) 風險管理應同時跟蹤實際（actual）與假設（hypothetical）收益。考試陷阱：例外次數過多拒絕模型，例外過少同樣可能表明模型過於保守（統計上也可拒絕）。
concepts.explanationEn: The Kupiec POF test checks whether the observed number of exceptions x is consistent with the model's expected failure rate p = 1 − confidence level. The LR_POF statistic follows χ²(1); large values reject the model. Points: (1) T is the number of days and x the exceptions; (2) Backtesting is difficult because VaR assumes a static portfolio while actual portfolios change constantly; actual P&L reflects risk factors omitted from the model; and the backtest sample may not represent true risk; (3) Track both actual and hypothetical P&L. Exam trap: too many exceptions reject the model, but too few can also statistically reject it as overly conservative.

concepts.title: 巴塞爾交通燈區與監管回測懲罰
concepts.titleEn: Basel Traffic-Light Approach and Regulatory Backtesting Penalties
concepts.explanation: 以250天、99%置信水平VaR的例外次數劃分區域：綠色區0-4次（乘數k=3.0，正常）；黃色區5-9次（乘數從3.4遞增至3.85）；紅色區10次及以上（k=4，模型可能被否定）。銀行回測中過度例外會被提高資本乘數懲罰。考試陷阱：黃色區乘數不是線性3.4-3.85之外隨意取值；紅色區的懲罰是直接升至4；例外的計數基於一天內實際損失超過VaR的天數。
concepts.explanationEn: Exceptions (actual loss exceeding 99% one-day VaR) over 250 days define zones: green 0-4 exceptions (multiplier k = 3.0), yellow 5-9 exceptions (k rising from 3.4 to 3.85), red 10+ exceptions (k = 4, model potentially rejected). Excessive exceptions trigger a higher capital multiplier. Exam trap: yellow-zone multipliers increase progressively between 3.4 and 3.85, and the red zone jumps to 4; count exceptions as days on which the loss exceeds VaR.

concepts.title: 回測整條分布與ES回測
concepts.titleEn: Backtesting the Entire Forecasting Distribution and ES
concepts.explanation: 超越次數回測只使用一個分位點的信息；概率積分變換（PIT）/ Berkowitz等方法利用整條預測分布：若模型正確，經分布變換後的損益應服從獨立標準正態（或均勻分布）。ES回測更困難，因為ES是尾部的條件期望，單日觀測信息少，監管（FRTB）採用針對多層分位的ES回測。考試陷阱：Kupiec檢驗只檢驗例外比例，不檢驗例外出現的時間獨立性（需輔以Christoffersen獨立性檢驗）。
concepts.explanationEn: Exceedance-based backtests use only one quantile; probability integral transform (PIT)/Berkowitz-type tests exploit the entire forecasting distribution: if the model is correct, transformed P&L should be i.i.d. standard normal (or uniform). ES is harder to backtest since it is a conditional tail expectation with little daily information; FRTB therefore backtests ES at multiple quantile levels. Exam trap: Kupiec tests only the proportion of failures, not their time independence (add a Christoffersen independence test).

concepts.title: VaR映射與固定收益組合映射
concepts.titleEn: VaR Mapping and Fixed-Income Portfolio Mapping
concepts.explanation: 映射是用有限風險因子近似表達組合風險。固定收益證券三種映射方法：(1) 本金映射（principal mapping）：只考慮償還本金的風險，將組合映射為期限等於組合平均期限的零息債券，最粗糙、高估風險；(2) 久期映射（duration mapping）：將債券風險映射到與其久期相同的零息債券；(3) 現金流映射（cash flow mapping）：把每筆現金流現值分別映射到對應期限的零息債券並計入期限間相關性，最精確。考試陷阱：三種方法的風險由粗到細排序為本金<久期<現金流映射；現金流映射是唯一考慮相關性結構的方法。
concepts.explanationEn: Mapping approximates portfolio risk with a limited set of risk factors. Three fixed-income mapping methods: (1) Principal mapping: only principal repayment risk, mapping to a zero-coupon bond with maturity equal to the portfolio average maturity; crudest and overstates risk; (2) Duration mapping: maps to a zero-coupon bond of the same duration; (3) Cash flow mapping: maps the present value of each cash flow to zero-coupon bonds of matching maturities including inter-maturity correlations; most precise. Exam trap: precision ranks principal < duration < cash flow mapping; only cash flow mapping captures the correlation structure.

concepts.title: 相關性的實證性質與均值回復
concepts.titleEn: Empirical Properties of Correlation and Mean Reversion
concepts.explanation: 相關性具有時變性、週期性（遵循商業週期）、均值回復性，且在危機時趨近1（系統性因子主導）。均值回復的判斷：若變量變動（S_t − S_{t−1}）與該變量水平（S_{t−1}）之間存在負相關關係，則存在均值回復，模型 S_t = a(U_s − S_{t−1}) + S_{t−1}，U_s為長期均值水平。考試陷阱：a的符號與回復速度；判斷均值回復看「變動量與水平量」的關係，而非「變動量與變動量」。
concepts.explanationEn: Correlations are time-varying, cyclical (following the business cycle), mean-reverting, and tend toward 1 in crises as systematic factors dominate. Mean reversion exists when the change in a variable (S_t − S_{t−1}) is negatively related to its lagged level S_{t−1}, per S_t = a(U_s − S_{t−1}) + S_{t−1} with long-run level U_s. Exam trap: identify mean reversion from the change-vs-level relationship, not change-vs-change.

concepts.title: 波動率微笑
concepts.titleEn: Volatility Smile
concepts.explanation: 波動率微笑是期權隱含波動率對執行價格（常以K/S或期權delta表示）的函數圖形。外匯期權呈對稱微笑（兩翼上翹）；股票期權呈偏斜（smirk/skew）：低執行價（深度虛值看跌）隱含波動率高。解釋：(1) 槓桿效應——股價下跌時公司槓桿上升，股權波動率增大；(2) 崩盤恐懼（crashophobia，Rubinstein）——市場擔憂暴跌，深度虛值看跌期權溢價高，1987年股災後傾斜更明顯。利率期權呈現更具對稱性的微笑。考試陷阱：微笑的存在證明B-S對數正態假設不成立；比較隱含波動率時應以moneyness（K/S）而非絕對K比較。
concepts.explanationEn: The volatility smile plots implied volatility against strike (usually moneyness K/S or option delta). FX options show a symmetric smile; equity options show a skew (smirk): low-strike (deep OTM put) implied volatilities are high. Explanations: (1) leverage—as equity falls, leverage rises, raising equity volatility; (2) crashophobia (Rubinstein)—fear of crashes puts high premiums on deep OTM puts, more pronounced after the 1987 crash. Interest-rate options show a more symmetric smile. Exam trap: the smile disproves the Black-Scholes lognormal assumption; compare implied vols on moneyness, not absolute strikes.

concepts.title: 相關性互換
concepts.titleEn: Correlation Swap
concepts.explanation: 相關性互換用於交易固定相關性與實際（已實現）相關性之差。已實現相關性為組合n個資產兩兩相關係數的平均值；買方的支付=名義本金×（已實現相關性−固定相關性）。考試陷阱：已實現相關性的分母是n(n−1)/2（配對數）；買方在實際相關性上升時獲利（例如股市危機時買方獲得賠付）；注意題目給的是日對數收益的兩兩相關係數之和，需除以配對數。
concepts.explanationEn: A correlation swap trades a fixed correlation against the correlation actually realized. Realized correlation is the average pairwise correlation across n assets; the buyer's payoff = notional × (realized correlation − fixed correlation). Exam traps: divide the sum of pairwise correlations by the number of pairs n(n−1)/2; the buyer profits when realized correlation rises (e.g., in equity crises).

concepts.title: 利率期限結構模型：Model 1 與 Model 2
concepts.titleEn: Term Structure Models: Model 1 and Model 2
concepts.explanation: Model 1（零漂移）：dr = σdw，無漂移、常數波動率，隱含的遠期利率期限結構為水平線；dw = ε√dt。Model 2（常數漂移）：dr = λdt + σdw，加入常數漂移λ，λ反映風險溢價與短期利率預期變化的組合；期限結構可上傾或下傾。考試陷阱：Model 1中dw = ε√dt（ε~N(0,1)）；Model 2的λ是風險中性測度下的漂移，包含風險溢價，不等於真實世界預期。
concepts.explanationEn: Model 1 (zero drift): dr = σdw with constant volatility; the implied forward curve is flat; dw = ε√dt with ε~N(0,1). Model 2 (constant drift): dr = λdt + σdw where λ combines the risk premium and expected changes in the short rate, allowing upward- or downward-sloping curves. Exam trap: λ in Model 2 is under the risk-neutral measure and embeds the risk premium, so it is not the real-world expectation.

concepts.title: Ho-Lee 與 Vasicek 模型
concepts.titleEn: Ho-Lee and Vasicek Models
concepts.explanation: Ho-Lee模型：dr = λ(t)dt + σdw，漂移依賴時間（time-dependent drift），每期漂移同樣是風險溢價與預期利率變化的組合，可擬合任意初始期限結構。Vasicek模型：dr = κ(θ − r)dt + σdw，引入均值回復：κ為回復速度（越大回復越快），θ為風險中性下的長期利率水平，r為當前利率；長期水平與當前利率差距越大，本期調整幅度越大。考試陷阱：Vasicek可產生負利率；「κ越大調整越快」正確；Ho-Lee的λ(t)隨時間變化而非常數。
concepts.explanationEn: Ho-Lee: dr = λ(t)dt + σdw with a time-dependent drift that fits any initial term structure; the drift again combines risk premium and expected short-rate changes. Vasicek: dr = κ(θ − r)dt + σdw introduces mean reversion, where κ is the speed of reversion (higher κ, faster adjustment), θ the long-run risk-neutral rate, and r the current rate; the larger the gap between θ and r, the larger the adjustment. Exam traps: Vasicek can generate negative rates; 'higher κ means faster adjustment' is correct; Ho-Lee's λ(t) varies over time.

concepts.title: CIR、Model 3 與對數正態模型
concepts.titleEn: CIR, Model 3, and Lognormal Models
concepts.explanation: CIR模型：dr = k(θ − r)dt + σ√r dw，基點波動率與利率平方根成正比（利率越高波動率越大），且保持利率非負。Model 3：dr = λ(t)dt + σe^{−αt}dw，波動率隨時間指數衰減（β(t)=σe^{−αt}），隱含遠期波動率結構。Salomon Brothers模型（Model 4）：dr = ardt + σr dw，比例波動率。Black-Karasinski：d[ln(r)] = k(t)[lnθ(t) − ln(r)]dt + σ(t)dw，對數利率的均值回復模型，利率恆為正。考試陷阱：CIR的√r使利率不會為負；Black-Karasinski是對數正態+均值回復的組合。
concepts.explanationEn: CIR: dr = k(θ − r)dt + σ√r dw — basis-point volatility rises with the square root of the rate and rates stay non-negative. Model 3: dr = λ(t)dt + σe^{−αt}dw with exponentially decaying volatility. The Salomon Brothers model (Model 4): dr = ardt + σr dw with proportional volatility. Black-Karasinski: d[ln(r)] = k(t)[lnθ(t) − ln(r)]dt + σ(t)dw, a lognormal mean-reverting model guaranteeing positive rates. Exam traps: the √r term keeps CIR rates non-negative; Black-Karasinski combines lognormality with mean reversion.

concepts.title: 凸性效應與詹森不等式
concepts.titleEn: Convexity Effect and Jensen's Inequality
concepts.explanation: 詹森不等式的特例：E[1/(1+r)] > 1/E(1+r)，即預期折現因子的平均值大於用預期利率折現。這解釋了為何零息債券價格隱含的預期收益率低於遠期利率（凸性效應convexity effect）：凸性使長期債券價格對利率下降更敏感。要點：凸性價值隨到期期限增加而增加；隨波動率增大而增加。考試陷阱：凸性效應使「預期債券收益率」低於遠期利率，而非高於；利率波動率越大，凸性效應越顯著。
concepts.explanationEn: A special case of Jensen's inequality: E[1/(1+r)] > 1/E(1+r) — the expected discount factor exceeds the discount factor at the expected rate. This explains the convexity effect: expected bond returns are below forward rates because convexity makes bond prices respond asymmetrically to rate moves. Points: convexity value increases with maturity and with volatility. Exam trap: convexity makes expected bond yields lower than forwards, not higher; greater rate volatility strengthens the effect.

concepts.title: DV01對沖與對沖調整因子
concepts.titleEn: DV01 Hedging and the Hedge Adjustment Factor (Beta)
concepts.explanation: DV01（基點價值）= 債券價值對1個基點利率變動的敏感度。DV01對沖用名義債券對沖實際債券：F_N = F_R × (DV01_R / DV01_N)，再乘以對沖調整因子β修正兩券收益率變動非1:1的關係。要點：定義F_R、F_N為實際與名義債券面值；β由歷史回歸得出。考試陷阱：β是實際收益率變動對名義收益率變動的回歸係數；若兩券收益率變動完全同步，β=1，退回普通DV01對沖。
concepts.explanationEn: DV01 is the dollar sensitivity of a bond's value to a one-basis-point yield change. A DV01 hedge offsets a real bond with a nominal bond: F_N = F_R × (DV01_R/DV01_N), further scaled by the hedge adjustment factor beta to correct for non one-to-one yield changes between the two bonds. Exam traps: beta is the regression coefficient of real on nominal yield changes; if yields move identically, beta = 1 and the hedge reduces to a plain DV01 hedge.

concepts.title: 回歸對沖
concepts.titleEn: Regression Hedge
concepts.explanation: 回歸對沖在DV01對沖基礎上，用最小二乘回歸歷史數據得到實際收益率變動與名義收益率變動的關係：Δy_R = α + βΔy_N + ε，以β調整名義債券頭寸，反映預期的名義收益率變動與實際收益率變動之比。適用於實際與名義工具收益率並非一比一變動的情形（如通脹掛鉤債券對名義債券對沖）。考試陷阱：回歸對沖含截距α；β用歷史關係估計，可能不穩定（結構變化會使對沖失效）。
concepts.explanationEn: A regression hedge refines DV01 hedging by regressing historical real yield changes on nominal yield changes: Δy_R = α + βΔy_N + ε, scaling the nominal position by β to reflect projected nominal versus real yield changes. Suited to cases where the two yields do not move one-for-one (e.g., hedging inflation-linked bonds with nominals). Exam traps: the regression includes an intercept α; beta is estimated from history and may be unstable under structural change.

concepts.title: 壓力測試與壓力情景設計
concepts.titleEn: Stress Testing and Stress Scenario Design
concepts.explanation: 壓力測試評估極端情形下的損失。三類主要情景：(1) 歷史情景（historical scenarios）——重演過去市場數據；(2) 預設情景（predefined/scenario analysis）——評估給定風險因子不利變動的影響；(3) 機械搜索壓力測試（mechanical searches）——用自動程序搜尋風險因子的可能不利變動。銀行控股公司（BHC）應設計反映自身業務與脆弱性的企業層面情景；使用第三方情景的機構應按自身風險特徵進行調整。壓力測試結果用於確定資本充足性與流動性需求，並與VaR互補（捕捉VaR分布之外的肥尾與流動性危機）。考試陷阱：壓力測試不賦予概率（與VaR的區別）；情景應具備合理性與一致性（coherence）。
concepts.explanationEn: Stress testing evaluates losses under extreme moves. Three main scenario types: (1) historical scenarios replaying past market data; (2) predefined/scenario analysis of adverse moves in a given set of risk factors; (3) mechanical searches using automated programs to probe possible adverse factor changes. BHCs should design firmwide scenarios reflecting their own business and vulnerabilities; those using vendor scenarios should tailor them to their risk profile. Stress results inform capital adequacy and liquidity needs and complement VaR (capturing fat tails and liquidity crises). Exam traps: stress tests assign no probabilities; scenarios must be plausible and coherent.

concepts.title: FRTB與流動性期限
concepts.titleEn: FRTB and Liquidity Horizons
concepts.explanation: 交易賬簿基本審查（FRTB）將巴塞爾I/2.5的10天持有期改為按交易流動性區分的流動性期限（liquidity horizons），共五檔：10天、20天、60天、120天、250天；流動性差的頭寸適用更長期限，並使用流動性期限階梯法聚合風險。FRTB下內部模型法（IMA）採用ES（97.5%置信水平）替代VaR，並設置後備的標準化方法（SA）。考試陷阱：五檔流動性期限的具體數值；ES置信水平是97.5%（不是99%）。
concepts.explanationEn: The Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) replaces the 10-day horizon of Basel I/2.5 with liquidity horizons reflecting how quickly positions can be unwound: 10, 20, 60, 120 and 250 days; less liquid positions carry longer horizons, aggregated via a liquidity-horizon ladder. Under FRTB's internal models approach (IMA) the risk measure is ES at 97.5% confidence (not VaR), with a standardized approach (SA) as fallback. Exam traps: memorize the five horizons; ES is at 97.5%, not 99%.

concepts.title: 交易賬簿與銀行賬簿
concepts.titleEn: Trading Book vs. Banking Book
concepts.explanation: 交易賬簿資產定期按市價計量（mark-to-market），適用市場風險資本規則；銀行賬簿資產擬持有至到期、按成本計量，適用更嚴格的信用風險資本規則。規則差異催生監管套利：銀行傾向把依賴信用的資產放入交易賬簿以降低資本要求。分配到交易賬簿須滿足雙重標準：(1) 有意圖且有能力交易該資產；(2) 能在交易櫃台上實際管理相關風險。Basel 2.5的增量風險計提（IRC）針對交易賬簿信用敏感產品，覆蓋信用利差風險與違約跳躍風險（jump-to-default，IDR計提，基於一年期99.9% VaR）。考試陷阱：僅有交易意圖不足以劃入交易賬簿；IRC是一年期99.9%、含違約與遷移風險。
concepts.explanationEn: Trading-book assets are marked to market regularly and face market risk capital rules; banking-book assets are held to maturity at cost and face stricter credit risk capital rules. The difference enables regulatory arbitrage: banks may place credit-dependent assets in the trading book to lower capital. Assignment to the trading book requires a dual standard: (1) intent and ability to trade; (2) actual management of the related risks on the trading desk. Under Basel 2.5 the Incremental Risk Charge (IRC) covers credit-sensitive trading-book products, capturing credit spread risk and jump-to-default risk (an incremental default risk charge based on a one-year 99.9% VaR, applicable to all defaultable assets including equities). Exam traps: trading intent alone is insufficient; IRC is one-year 99.9% and includes default and migration risk.

concepts.title: 壓力 VaR (Stressed VaR)
concepts.titleEn: Stressed VaR (SVaR)
concepts.explanation: 金融危機前（2003-2006）多數銀行用歷史模擬（過去1-4年數據）計算監管VaR，低波動時期VaR偏低且危機爆發後一段時間仍偏低。巴塞爾委員會為此引入壓力VaR：以250天壓力市場期間（如2008年危機高點）的市場變動為基礎計算，而非過去1-4年。Basel 2.5市場風險資本 = 當前VaR部分 + 壓力VaR部分 + 特定風險計提（SRC）。考試陷阱：SVaR的數據窗口是壓力期的250天，不是最近250天；乘數要求與普通VaR相同（m≥3）。
concepts.explanationEn: Before the crisis (2003-2006) most banks computed regulatory VaR by historical simulation over the past 1-4 years; low-volatility periods produced too-low VaRs that stayed too low even after the crisis began. The Basel Committee therefore introduced stressed VaR, computed from how market variables moved during a 250-day stressed period (e.g., peak of the 2008 crisis) rather than the recent 1-4 years. Under Basel 2.5, market risk capital = current VaR component + stressed VaR component + specific risk charge. Exam traps: SVaR uses a 250-day stressed window, not the most recent 250 days; the multiplier requirement (m ≥ 3) mirrors regular VaR.

concepts.title: 風險聚合：自上而下與自下而上
concepts.titleEn: Risk Aggregation: Top-Down vs. Bottom-Up
concepts.explanation: 銀行資產可視為市場、信用、操作風險子組合的集合，但各類風險相互交織、難以截然分開。自上而下（top-down）假設銀行組合可按市場/信用/操作風險清晰切分後加總（常用簡化相關矩陣聚合）；自下而上（bottom-up）則嘗試刻畫各風險因子之間的相互作用（如聯合模擬）。考試陷阱：市場、信用、操作風險的VaR簡單相加會忽略分散化效應；聚合時需考慮風險間相關性（通常小於1）。
concepts.explanationEn: A bank's assets can be viewed as sub-portfolios of market, credit and operational risk, but these categories are intertwined and hard to separate. The top-down approach assumes the portfolio can be cleanly subdivided and aggregated (often with a simple correlation matrix); the bottom-up approach accounts for interactions among risk factors (e.g., joint simulation). Exam trap: summing stand-alone VaRs ignores diversification; aggregation must use inter-risk correlations below 1.

formulas.name: 正態VaR（算術回報）
formulas.description: 中文：μ為算術回報均值，σ為標準差，z_α為標準正態α分位數（95%對應1.645，99%對應2.33），P_{t−1}為前期組合價值。適用於算術回報服從正態分布的假設。坑點：年化參數轉日度需除以√252（σ除以√252，μ除以252）；VaR取正值表示損失；均值項在短持有期常可忽略。
formulas.descriptionEn: μ is the mean arithmetic return, σ the standard deviation, z_α the standard normal quantile (1.645 for 95%, 2.33 for 99%), and P_{t−1} the prior portfolio value. Assumes normally distributed arithmetic returns. Pitfalls: convert annualized moments to daily (σ/√252, μ/252); quote VaR as a positive loss; the mean term is often negligible over short horizons.

formulas.name: 對數正態VaR（幾何回報）
formulas.description: 中文：μ與σ為幾何（對數）回報的均值與標準差。對數正態VaR保證損失不超過100%（價格不為負），適用於長期限或高波動情形。坑點：與正態VaR公式混淆是經典陷阱；例：P=100、μ=10%、σ=20%、95%時VaR = 100×(1−e^{0.1−1.65×0.2}) = 20.55；指數中的參數必須是幾何回報口徑。
formulas.descriptionEn: μ and σ are the mean and standard deviation of geometric (log) returns. Lognormal VaR caps the loss at 100% (prices cannot go negative) and suits long horizons or high volatility. Pitfalls: do not confuse with normal VaR; e.g., P=100, μ=10%, σ=20%, 95%: VaR = 100×(1−e^{0.1−1.65×0.2}) = 20.55; the exponent must use geometric-return parameters.

formulas.name: 正態分布下的預期短缺 (ES)
formulas.description: 中文：φ(·)為標準正態密度函數，α為置信水平。正態假設下ES有解析解：ES總是大於VaR。坑點：ES是超過VaR的條件平均損失；若按損失為正的記號習慣，公式符號需相應調整；分布厚尾時正態ES會低估真實ES。
formulas.descriptionEn: φ(·) is the standard normal density and α the confidence level. Under normality ES has a closed form and always exceeds VaR. Pitfalls: ES is the conditional average loss beyond VaR; adjust signs for loss-positive conventions; fat tails make the normal ES understate the true ES.

formulas.name: 年齡加權權重（混合法）
formulas.description: 中文：λ為衰減因子（如0.99），i為觀測按新舊排序的序號（i=1最舊），n為樣本數；權重和為1。坑點：指數是i−1；λ越接近1權重越平緩；該法將歷史模擬轉化為加權分位數問題。
formulas.descriptionEn: λ is the decay factor (e.g., 0.99), i ranks observations from oldest (i=1), n is the sample size; weights sum to one. Pitfalls: the exponent is i−1; larger λ flattens weights; the method turns historical simulation into a weighted-quantile problem.

formulas.name: 波動率加權收益調整
formulas.description: 中文：σ_{T,i}為資產i當前（預測日T）的波動率，σ_{t,i}為歷史第t日資產i的波動率，r_{t,i}為歷史收益。調整後收益r*用於構建新樣本並取分位點。坑點：每項資產分別調整；當前波動率可由EWMA/GARCH預測；波動率加權能在樣本外產生比歷史數據更高的VaR估計。
formulas.descriptionEn: σ_{T,i} is asset i's current (forecast) volatility at date T, σ_{t,i} its volatility on historical date t, and r_{t,i} the historical return; quantiles are read from the scaled returns. Pitfalls: each asset is scaled separately; current volatility may come from EWMA/GARCH; volatility weighting can produce VaR estimates higher than anything in the raw sample.

formulas.name: 廣義極值 (GEV) 分布
formulas.description: 中文：ξ為形狀參數，μ為位置參數，σ為尺度參數（區塊極大值模型）。ξ>0厚尾（Fréchet）、ξ=0指數薄尾（Gumbel）、ξ<0有限上/下端點（Weibull）。金融收益實證常見0<ξ<0.35。坑點：ξ→∞並非正態；正態對應ξ=0；括號內為負時取0的約定。
formulas.descriptionEn: ξ is the shape parameter, μ the location and σ the scale (block maxima model). ξ>0 heavy tail (Fréchet), ξ=0 light exponential-type tail (Gumbel), ξ<0 finite endpoint (Weibull). Empirical financial returns often show 0<ξ<0.35. Pitfalls: ξ→∞ is not normal; the normal corresponds to ξ=0; the bracket is truncated at zero when negative.

formulas.name: POT模型下的VaR與ES
formulas.description: 中文：u為閾值，β為尺度參數，ξ為尾參數，n為觀測總數，N_u為超閾次數，CL為置信水平。隨u提高，超額損失信向GPD。坑點：ξ≥0.5時ES無窮大（方差無窮）；N_u隨閾值降低而增加，參數估計更可靠；ES公式僅對ξ<0.5有效。
formulas.descriptionEn: u is the threshold, β the scale, ξ the tail parameter, n the number of observations, N_u the exceedances, and CL the confidence level. As u rises, excess losses converge to the GPD. Pitfalls: ES is infinite for ξ≥0.5; lowering u raises N_u and improves estimation reliability; the ES formula is valid only for ξ<0.5.

formulas.name: 高斯違約時間 Copula
formulas.description: 中文：U_i為各變量（如生存概率）的均勻分布邊際，Φ^{-1}為標準正態分位數函數，Φ_2為二元標準正態分布（相關係數ρ）。用於聯合違約時間建模與CDO定價。坑點：高斯Copula無尾部相依，危機時低估聯合違約；ρ是Copula相關係數，不等於線性相關係數。
formulas.descriptionEn: U_i are uniform marginals (e.g., survival probabilities), Φ^{-1} the standard normal inverse CDF, and Φ_2 the bivariate standard normal CDF with correlation ρ. Used for joint default-time modeling and CDO pricing. Pitfalls: no tail dependence — understates joint defaults in crises; ρ is a copula parameter, not the linear correlation.

formulas.name: Kupiec 失敗比例檢驗統計量
formulas.description: 中文：p=1−置信水平為模型預期例外概率，T為總天數，x為實際例外次數；LR_POF漸近服從自由度1的卡方分布，超過臨界值（95%為3.84）則拒絕模型。坑點：例外過多或過少都可能拒絕；該檢驗不涉及例外的時間分布。
formulas.descriptionEn: p = 1 − confidence level is the model's expected exception rate, T the number of days, x the observed exceptions; LR_POF is asymptotically χ²(1) and the model is rejected above the critical value (3.84 at 95%). Pitfalls: both too many and too few exceptions can reject; the test ignores the timing of exceptions.

formulas.name: 巴塞爾市場風險資本（含回測乘數）
formulas.nameEn: Basel Market Risk Charge with Backtesting Multiplier
formulas.description: 中文：VaR_{t−1}為前一日VaR，VaR̅為過去60天平均VaR（99%置信、10天持有期），m_c為乘數（≥3，回測黃色區5-9次例外時由3.4升至3.85，紅色區≥10次時為4），SRC為特定風險計提。坑點：取「前一日VaR」與「60天均值×乘數」的較大者；例外按250天計。
formulas.descriptionEn: VaR_{t−1} is the previous day's VaR, the bar denotes the average VaR over the last 60 days (99%, 10-day), m_c the multiplier (≥3; rising from 3.4 to 3.85 across the yellow zone of 5-9 exceptions and 4 in the red zone of 10+), and SRC the specific risk charge. Pitfall: take the larger of yesterday's VaR and the multiplier times the 60-day average; exceptions counted over 250 days.

formulas.name: 均值回復檢驗模型
formulas.description: 中文：S_t為變量當期值，S_{t−1}為前期值，U_s為長期均值，a為回復係數。若「變動量（S_t−S_{t−1}）」與「前期水平（S_{t−1}）」呈負關係則存在均值回復。坑點：a<0時變量被拉回U_s；判斷依據是變動與水平的關係。
formulas.descriptionEn: S_t is the current value, S_{t−1} the lagged value, U_s the long-run level and a the reversion coefficient. Mean reversion exists when the change (S_t − S_{t−1}) is negatively related to the lagged level. Pitfall: a<0 pulls the variable back toward U_s; the diagnostic is change versus level.

formulas.name: 已實現相關性與相關性互換損益
formulas.nameEn: Realized Correlation and Correlation Swap Payoff
formulas.description: 中文：n為資產數，ρ_{ij}為資產i與j在互換期限內（日對數）收益的已實現相關係數，N_otional為名義本金。買方支付固定相關性、收取已實現相關性。坑點：分母是配對數n(n−1)/2；相關性上升利好買方（危機對沖）。
formulas.descriptionEn: n is the number of assets, ρ_{ij} the realized correlation of daily log returns between assets i and j over the swap term, and N the notional. The buyer pays fixed and receives realized correlation. Pitfalls: divide by the number of pairs n(n−1)/2; the buyer gains when correlation rises (crisis hedging).

formulas.name: Model 1：零漂移利率模型
formulas.description: 中文：σ為常數波動率，dw為維納過程增量。隱含遠期利率曲線為水平；歐式債券期權價格有解析解。坑點：無漂移意味著風險中性下利率預期不變；波動率恆定（基點波動率）。
formulas.descriptionEn: σ is constant volatility and dw a Wiener increment. The implied forward curve is flat; European bond options have closed-form prices. Pitfalls: zero drift implies unchanged rate expectations under risk neutrality; volatility is constant in basis points.

formulas.name: Model 2：常數漂移（含風險溢價）
formulas.nameEn: Model 2: Constant Drift with Risk Premium
formulas.description: 中文：λ為常數漂移，等於風險溢價與短期利率預期變化之和；σ為常數波動率。期限結構可上傾（λ>0）或下傾。坑點：λ是風險中性測度的漂移；與Ho-Lee的區別在於λ是否隨時間變化。
formulas.descriptionEn: λ is the constant drift, combining the risk premium with expected changes in the short rate; σ is constant volatility. The curve can slope up (λ>0) or down. Pitfalls: λ is a risk-neutral drift; the difference from Ho-Lee is time dependence.

formulas.name: Ho-Lee 模型
formulas.description: 中文：λ(t)為時間相依漂移，用於擬合初始期限結構；σ為常數波動率。坑點：漂移隨時間變化是其與Model 2的唯一區別；波動率仍為常數。
formulas.descriptionEn: λ(t) is the time-dependent drift used to fit the initial term structure; σ is constant volatility. Pitfall: the time-varying drift is its only difference from Model 2; volatility remains constant.

formulas.name: Vasicek 模型
formulas.description: 中文：κ為均值回復速度，θ為長期（風險中性）利率水平，r_t為當前利率，σ為常數波動率。κ越大回復越快；θ與r差距越大本期調整越大；可能出現負利率。坑點：均值回復項使利率被拉向θ；分布為正態。
formulas.descriptionEn: κ is the speed of mean reversion, θ the long-run (risk-neutral) rate, r_t the current rate, and σ constant volatility. Higher κ means faster reversion; a larger θ−r gap produces a larger adjustment; negative rates are possible. Pitfalls: the reversion term pulls rates toward θ; the distribution is normal.

formulas.name: Cox-Ingersoll-Ross (CIR) 模型
formulas.description: 中文：與Vasicek同樣均值回復，但波動率項為σ√r_t：基點波動率與利率平方根成正比，利率越高波動率越大，且利率不會為負。坑點：CIR在零利率附近波動率收縮；分布非正態（卡方類）。
formulas.descriptionEn: Like Vasicek with mean reversion, but the volatility term σ√r_t makes basis-point volatility proportional to the square root of the rate; rates stay non-negative. Pitfalls: volatility shrinks near zero; the distribution is non-normal (chi-square type).

formulas.name: Model 3、Salomon Brothers 與 Black-Karasinski 模型
formulas.nameEn: Model 3, Salomon Brothers, and Black-Karasinski Models
formulas.latex: $dr_t = \lambda(t)dt + \sigma e^{-\alpha t}dw_t \quad;\quad dr_t = a\,r_t dt + \sigma r_t dw_t \quad;\quad d[\ln r_t] = k(t)[\ln\theta(t)-\ln r_t]dt + \sigma(t)dw_t$
formulas.description: 中文：Model 3的波動率σe^{−αt}隨時間指數衰減（遠期波動率遞減）；Salomon Brothers模型為比例波動率（σr）；Black-Karasinski是對數利率的均值回復模型，利率恆正，k(t)為回復速度、θ(t)為長期水平。坑點：三個模型波動率設定各不相同；Black-Karasinski兼具對數正態與均值回復。
formulas.descriptionEn: Model 3 has exponentially decaying volatility σe^{−αt}; the Salomon Brothers model uses proportional volatility σr; Black-Karasinski models the log rate with mean reversion, guaranteeing positive rates, with k(t) the speed and θ(t) the long-run level. Pitfalls: the three models differ in volatility specification; Black-Karasinski combines lognormality with mean reversion.

formulas.name: 詹森不等式（凸性效應）
formulas.description: 中文：由於折現函數1/(1+r)是凸函數，預期折現因子大於用預期利率折現。因此零息債券的隱含預期收益率低於遠期利率（凸性效應）；凸性價值隨到期日與波動率增加。坑點：方向是「預期收益低於遠期利率」；利率波動越大效應越強。
formulas.descriptionEn: Because the discount function 1/(1+r) is convex, the expected discount factor exceeds the discount factor at the expected rate; hence implied expected bond yields are below forward rates (the convexity effect), and convexity value rises with maturity and volatility. Pitfall: expected returns are below forwards; higher rate volatility strengthens the effect.

formulas.name: DV01對沖與對沖調整因子β
formulas.nameEn: DV01 Hedge and Hedge Adjustment Factor (Beta)
formulas.description: 中文：F_R、F_N分別為實際債券與名義（對沖工具）債券的面值，DV01_R、DV01_N為相應基點價值，β為對沖調整因子（回歸係數）。坑點：β修正實際與名義收益率變動不同步的問題；β由Δy_R對Δy_N回歸得出。
formulas.descriptionEn: F_R and F_N are the face amounts of the real and nominal (hedging) bonds, DV01_R and DV01_N their DV01s, and β the hedge adjustment factor from regression. Pitfall: beta corrects for real and nominal yields not moving one-for-one; it is estimated by regressing Δy_R on Δy_N.

formulas.name: 回歸對沖方程
formulas.description: 中文：Δy_R為實際收益率變動，Δy_N為名義收益率變動，α為截距，β為斜率（對沖調整因子），ε為誤差項；用最小二乘估計歷史關係。坑點：回歸對沖假設歷史關係穩定；截距α通常假定為0（長期）。
formulas.descriptionEn: Δy_R is the real yield change, Δy_N the nominal yield change, α the intercept, β the slope (hedge adjustment factor) and ε the error term; estimated by least squares on history. Pitfalls: the hedge assumes a stable historical relationship; α is often assumed zero in the long run.

formulas.name: Basel 2.5 市場風險資本（含壓力VaR）
formulas.nameEn: Basel 2.5 Market Risk Charge with Stressed VaR
formulas.description: 中文：在1996年修正案基礎上加入壓力VaR部分：SVaR基於250天壓力期（如2008年危機）的市場變動；兩部分均取「前一日值」與「均值×乘數」較大者；SRC為特定風險計提。坑點：壓力窗口是歷史上壓力最大的250天，不是最近250天。
formulas.descriptionEn: Adds a stressed VaR component on top of the 1996 amendment: SVaR is based on market moves during a 250-day stressed period (e.g., 2008); both components take the larger of the previous day's value and the multiplier times the average; plus the specific risk charge. Pitfall: the stress window is the historically most stressful 250 days, not the most recent.

formulas.name: 兩資產組合VaR（分散化）
formulas.description: 中文：VaR_1、VaR_2為單獨資產的VaR，ρ_{12}為收益相關係數；ρ<1時分散化VaR小於未分散加總。坑點：未分散VaR = VaR_1+VaR_2；ρ=1時二者相等；多資產推廣需用協方差矩陣。
formulas.descriptionEn: VaR_1 and VaR_2 are stand-alone VaRs and ρ_{12} the return correlation; with ρ<1 the diversified VaR is below the sum. Pitfalls: undiversified VaR = VaR_1+VaR_2, equal to the diversified VaR only at ρ=1; multi-asset cases require the covariance matrix.

chapters.chapterName: 第二章 信用風險計量與管理
chapters.summary: 本章（權重20%）覆蓋：信用風險三要素（PD、LGD、EAD）與預期/非預期損失；授信敞口與交易對手敞口計量（PFE、EPE）；信用評級、遷移矩陣與信用評分模型（FICO、線性判別、邏輯回歸、Altman Z-score）；結構模型（Merton：股權=看漲期權、違約距離、KMV違約點）、簡化式模型（危險率/違約強度、累積/邊際/條件違約概率）；違約相關性、單因子模型與高斯Copula下的信用VaR（WCDR）；信用組合模型（CreditMetrics、CreditRisk+、KMV組合、CreditPortfolioView）；淨額結算與擔保、錯向風險、CVA/DVA/BCVA；信用衍生品（CDS、TRS、CLN、first-to-default）與結構化產品（CDO分層對違約率與相關性的敏感性、MBS提前償還CPR/SMM/PSA）；以及CCP違約瀑布和Basel II IRB信用資本。考試常見陷阱：Merton模型PD用μ（真實世界）而非r（風險中性）；CVA用風險中性PD；LGD=1−回收率；CDO高級層與相關性的正向關係；淨額結算因子與相關性的關係。
chapters.summaryEn: This chapter (20% weight) covers the credit risk components (PD, LGD, EAD) with expected and unexpected losses; exposure measurement (adjusted exposure, PFE, EPE); credit ratings, migration matrices and credit scoring (FICO, linear discriminant analysis, logistic regression, Altman's Z-score); structural models (Merton: equity as a call option, distance to default; KMV default point) and reduced-form models (hazard rate; cumulative, marginal and conditional default probabilities); default correlation, the single-factor model and credit VaR under the Gaussian copula (WCDR); portfolio credit models (CreditMetrics, CreditRisk+, KMV portfolio, CreditPortfolioView); netting and collateral, wrong-way/right-way risk, CVA/DVA/BCVA; credit derivatives (CDS, TRS, CLN, first-to-default) and structured products (CDO tranche sensitivity to PD and correlation, MBS prepayment CPR/SMM/PSA); the CCP loss waterfall and Basel II IRB credit capital. Exam traps: Merton PD uses μ (real world) not r; CVA uses risk-neutral PD; LGD = 1 − recovery rate; the senior tranche's positive relationship with correlation; and the netting factor's relationship with correlation.

concepts.title: 信用風險組成要素 (PD, LGD, EAD)
concepts.titleEn: Credit Risk Components (PD, LGD, EAD)
concepts.explanation: 違約概率PD（probability of default）：借款人在期限內違約的可能性；違約損失率LGD（loss given default）：違約後損失占敞口的比例，LGD = 1 − 回收率RR（recovery rate）；違約敞口EAD（exposure at default）：違約時的風險暴露金額。三者相乘得預期損失。信用風險分布呈高度右偏：最大收益限於收到承諾支付，而極端損失雖罕見但巨大，故信用損失常以Beta分布建模（質量集中於0-100%之間）。考試陷阱：LGD與RR互補但基準不同（敞口vs面值）；PD是概率、LGD是比率、EAD是金額。
concepts.explanationEn: PD (probability of default) is the likelihood a borrower defaults over the horizon; LGD (loss given default) is the loss fraction upon default, with LGD = 1 − recovery rate (RR); EAD (exposure at default) is the amount at risk at default. Expected loss multiplies the three. Credit loss distributions are highly skewed: gains are capped at promised payments while extreme losses are rare but severe, so the beta distribution (mass between 0% and 100%) is commonly used. Exam traps: LGD and RR are complements but measured on different bases; PD is a probability, LGD a ratio, EAD a dollar amount.

concepts.title: 預期損失 (Expected Loss, EL)
concepts.titleEn: Expected Loss (EL)
concepts.explanation: EL = PD × LGD × EAD，是信用業務的「正常成本」，應通過定價（利差）與撥備覆蓋，而非資本。非預期損失（UL）是超出EL的部分，由經濟資本吸收。考試陷阱：EL不需要資本覆蓋（定價覆蓋）；風險中性的EL（用風險中性PD）用於定價與CVA，真實世界的EL（用實際PD）用於撥備與業績考核。
concepts.explanationEn: EL = PD × LGD × EAD is a normal cost of the credit business, covered through pricing (spreads) and provisions rather than capital. Unexpected loss (UL), the excess over EL, is absorbed by economic capital. Exam traps: EL is priced, not capitalized; risk-neutral EL (risk-neutral PD) is used for pricing and CVA, real-world EL (actual PD) for provisions and performance.

concepts.title: 非預期損失 (Unexpected Loss, UL)
concepts.titleEn: Unexpected Loss (UL)
concepts.explanation: 單一資產UL = AE × √(PD·σ²_LGD + LGD²·σ²_PD)，衡量偏離EL的波動。若PD服從二項分布，σ_PD = √(PD(1−PD))。組合層面：UL_P = √(ΣΣ ρ_ij·UL_i·UL_j)（ρ為資產間違約相關）。信用VaR = 最壞情況損失（WCL）− EL。考試陷阱：組合UL不是單資產UL的簡單加總（分散化效應）；相關性越低組合UL越小；UL需要經濟資本覆蓋。
concepts.explanationEn: Stand-alone UL = AE × √(PD·σ²_LGD + LGD²·σ²_PD) measures volatility around EL; if PD is binomial, σ_PD = √(PD(1−PD)). At portfolio level UL_P = √(ΣΣ ρ_ij·UL_i·UL_j) with default correlations ρ. Credit VaR = worst-case loss (WCL) − EL. Exam traps: portfolio UL is less than the sum of stand-alone ULs (diversification); lower correlation lowers portfolio UL; UL requires economic capital.

concepts.title: 調整後敞口與授信使用 (OS, CMO, UGD)
concepts.titleEn: Adjusted Exposure (OS, CMO, UGD)
concepts.explanation: 調整後敞口 AE = OS + (CMO − OS)×UGD。其中OS（outstandings）為已提取貸款；CMO（committed amounts）為承諾授信總額；UGD（usage given default，記作α）為違約前未提取額度被提取的比例。承諾但未提取部分（CMO−OS）在違約時按UGD比例轉化為敞口。考試陷阱：EAD以調整後敞口為基準；UGD隨信用等級下降而上升（瀕危借款人趕緊提款）；期權類敞口另有加成係數。
concepts.explanationEn: Adjusted exposure AE = OS + (CMO − OS)×UGD, where OS is outstandings drawn, CMO the committed amount, and UGD (usage given default, α) the fraction of the undrawn commitment drawn before default. Exam traps: EAD is based on adjusted exposure; UGD rises as credit quality falls (distressed borrowers draw down); off-balance-sheet items carry credit conversion add-ons.

concepts.title: 交易對手敞口計量 (EFV, PFE, EPE, ENE)
concepts.titleEn: Counterparty Exposure Metrics (EFV, PFE, EPE, ENE)
concepts.explanation: EFV（expected future value）：未來時點的預期敞口；PFE（potential future exposure）：一定置信水平下的最大預期敞口（類似敞口的VaR）；EPE（expected positive exposure）：所有時點EFV正部的平均，是CVA計算的核心輸入；ENE（expected negative exposure）：負敞口平均（對應DVA）。互換敞口隨時間先增後減（攤還與到期效應）；交叉貨幣互換敞口最大（含本金交換，末期本金敞口巨大）；CDS賣方敞口在參照實體利差走闊時上升。考試陷阱：PFE對應VaR概念、EPE對應均值概念；交叉貨幣互換是敞口最大的常見產品。
concepts.explanationEn: EFV (expected future value) is the expected exposure at a future date; PFE (potential future exposure) is a high-quantile exposure (a VaR-like measure of exposure); EPE (expected positive exposure) averages positive EFV across dates and is the key input to CVA; ENE (expected negative exposure) mirrors it for DVA. Swap exposure rises then falls (diffusion vs amortization); cross-currency swaps carry the largest exposure due to final principal exchange; a CDS seller's exposure rises when the reference entity's spread widens. Exam traps: PFE is a quantile, EPE a mean; cross-currency swaps typically have the largest exposure.

concepts.title: 信用評級、發行評級與遷移矩陣
concepts.titleEn: Credit Ratings, Issue vs. Issuer Ratings, and Migration Matrices
concepts.explanation: 評級機構評級「通過週期」（through the cycle），變化相對不頻繁、偏穩定；內部評級多為「時點評級」（point in time）。發行評級（issue rating）就具體債務的實際質量客觀評定（如Moody's）；發行人評級（issuer rating）對主體整體償付能力評定，帶主觀性（如S&P、Fitch）。遷移矩陣（rating migration matrix）給出各評級在一定期限內轉移到其他評級（含違約）的相對頻率，可用於計算多期違約概率與組合信用VaR（CreditMetrics）。機構只覆蓋公開發債公司，中小企業無評級，銀行需內部評級（基於ROA、流動比率、負債/權益等財務比率並轉換為現金流分析）。考試陷阱：遷移矩陣行和為100%；用遷移矩陣計算兩期以上違約概率需矩陣乘方。
concepts.explanationEn: Agency ratings are 'through the cycle' and change infrequently, favoring stability; internal ratings are often 'point in time.' Issue ratings grade the specific debt's quality objectively (e.g., Moody's); issuer ratings assess the obligor overall (e.g., S&P, Fitch) with more judgment. A rating migration matrix gives the relative frequencies of moves between rating classes (including default) over a horizon and supports multi-period default probabilities and CreditMetrics-style portfolio credit VaR. Agencies rate only public issuers, so banks build internal ratings from ratios (ROA, current ratio, debt/equity) converted to cash-flow analysis. Exam traps: rows of the matrix sum to 100%; multi-period default probabilities require matrix multiplication.

concepts.title: 信用評分模型
concepts.titleEn: Credit Scoring Models
concepts.explanation: 信用局分數（credit bureau scores，如FICO，範圍300-850）適用於個人；銀行對公司客戶用池子模型（pooled，分行業）、定製模型（custom）等。有監督模型（因變量確定）：線性判別分析（LDA，找最優分數門檻cutoff區分違約/非違約）、邏輯回歸（logistic regression）；無監督模型（因變量不確定）：聚類分析（cluster analysis）、主成分分析（PCA）。啟發式方法：專家系統（expert systems，核心是前向鏈forward chaining與後向鏈backward chaining的推理機）；數值方法：神經網絡（neural networks，缺點是黑箱與過度擬合）。Altman Z-score為五因子判別函數：流動性（營運資本/總資產）、盈利性（留存收益/總資產、EBIT/總資產）、槓桿（股權市值/負債賬面值）、營運能力（銷售/總資產）；Z>3.0違約可能性低，1.8≤Z<2.7違約機會較大，Z<1.8財務困境概率高。考試陷阱：Z-score各係數與變量對應；cutoff分數（如680）用於二分決策。
concepts.explanationEn: Credit bureau scores (e.g., FICO, 300-850) apply to individuals; banks use pooled (by industry) and custom models for corporates. Supervised models (with a defined dependent variable): linear discriminant analysis (LDA, choosing an optimal cutoff score to separate defaulters/non-defaulters) and logistic regression. Unsupervised models: cluster analysis and principal component analysis (PCA). Heuristic approaches: expert systems (centered on forward and backward chaining inference); numerical approaches: neural networks (black box and overfitting are drawbacks). Altman's Z-score is a five-factor discriminant function covering liquidity (working capital/assets), profitability (retained earnings/assets; EBIT/assets), leverage (market equity/book liabilities) and activity (sales/assets); Z>3.0 unlikely to default, 1.8≤Z<2.7 a good chance of default, Z<1.8 high probability of financial embarrassment. Exam traps: match coefficients to variables; cutoff scores (e.g., 680) make binary decisions.

concepts.title: Merton結構模型
concepts.titleEn: Merton Structural Model
concepts.explanation: 將公司股權視為公司資產的看漲期權、債務面值K為執行價：Equity = V·N(d1) − K·e^{−rT}·N(d2)；Debt = K·e^{−rT} − Put = V·N(−d1) + K·e^{−rT}·N(d2)。假設：公司只有一筆零息債務、不分紅；市場完美（無稅、無破產成本）；公司價值V服從對數正態、波動率恆定、利率r恆定、連續交易。違約發生在V<K時。考試陷阱：用Merton算真實世界PD時用μ（資產回報期望），不是r；風險中性定價（如信用利差、CVA）才用r；公司價值波動率σ上升時債券價值下降、股權價值上升。
concepts.explanationEn: Equity is a call option on firm value with strike equal to debt face value K: Equity = V·N(d1) − K·e^{−rT}·N(d2); Debt = K·e^{−rT} − Put = V·N(−d1) + K·e^{−rT}·N(d2). Assumptions: a single zero-coupon debt issue, no dividends; perfect markets (no taxes or bankruptcy costs); firm value lognormal with constant volatility, constant r, continuous trading; default when V<K. Exam traps: real-world PD from Merton uses μ (expected asset return), not r; risk-neutral pricing (spreads, CVA) uses r; higher σ lowers debt value but raises equity value.

concepts.title: 違約距離 (DD) 與Merton違約概率
concepts.titleEn: Distance to Default (DD) and Merton PD
concepts.explanation: 違約距離DD = [ln(V/F) + (μ − σ²/2)T]/(σ√T)，是「到債務障礙的標準化距離」，代表公司進入財務困境並違約前所剩的緩衝；違約概率PD = N(−DD)。μ為「風險世界」的預期資產回報；T為剩餘期限；σ為公司價值年化波動率。DD越遠越好（違約概率越低）。考試陷阱：計算DD用μ、計算風險中性d1/d2用r；比較三家公司的違約可能性時直接比較DD大小；σ同時出現在分子（−σ²/2）與分母（σ√T）中。
concepts.explanationEn: Distance to default DD = [ln(V/F) + (μ − σ²/2)T]/(σ√T) is the standardized distance to the debt barrier beyond which the firm defaults; PD = N(−DD). μ is the expected asset return in the 'risky world', T the remaining maturity, σ the annualized firm-value volatility. A larger DD means a lower PD. Exam traps: use μ for real-world DD/PD and r for risk-neutral d1/d2; compare counterparties by ranking DD; σ enters both the numerator (−σ²/2) and the denominator (σ√T).

concepts.title: Moody's KMV 模型
concepts.titleEn: Moody's KMV Model
concepts.explanation: KMV直接從股權價格推斷違約概率，對資產價值分布無正態假設。違約點（default point）K：短期負債 + 0.5×長期負債（當長期負債<1.5×短期負債時）；否則K = STD + (0.7 − 0.3×STD/LTD)×LTD。違約距離DD = (E[V] − K)/(σ_V×V)（簡化形式=(V−K)/σ_V）。通過違約距離與歷史違約數據庫映射到預期違約頻率（EDF）。考試陷阱：KMV違約點不等於總負債；「DD=(A−K)/σ_A」的簡化式假設V已標準化；KMV的優勢是可用於上市公司實時監控。
concepts.explanationEn: KMV infers default probabilities directly from equity prices without assuming normality of asset value. The default point K = short-term debt + 0.5×long-term debt (when LTD < 1.5×STD); otherwise K = STD + (0.7 − 0.3×STD/LTD)×LTD. DD = (E[V] − K)/(σ_V×V), often simplified to (V−K)/σ_V. DD maps through an empirical database to an expected default frequency (EDF). Exam traps: the KMV default point is not total debt; the simplified formula assumes standardized V; KMV's strength is real-time monitoring of listed firms.

concepts.title: 信用利差與風險中性違約概率
concepts.titleEn: Credit Spreads and Risk-Neutral Default Probability
concepts.explanation: 從公司債價格推斷風險中性違約概率：考慮一年期債券，回收率RR、利差s = YTM − Rf，則風險中性PD ≈ s/LGD（當RR≠0且期限短）；無回收情形 p = 1 − (1+Rf)/(1+YTM)。信用利差補償違約損失（+流動性溢價與稅收效應）。Merton框架下利差隨槓桿上升、隨波動率上升；短期限利差趨於0（違約需要時間）。考試陷阱：風險中性PD高於真實世界PD（含風險溢價）；s ≈ PD×LGD僅是近似；題目常給RR與利差讓你反推PD。
concepts.explanationEn: Risk-neutral default probability inferred from corporate bond prices: for a one-year bond with recovery RR and spread s = YTM − Rf, PD ≈ s/LGD (short horizon); with zero recovery, p = 1 − (1+Rf)/(1+YTM). The spread compensates for default loss (plus liquidity premium and tax effects). In Merton, spreads rise with leverage and volatility and approach zero at very short maturities. Exam traps: risk-neutral PD exceeds real-world PD (risk premium); s ≈ PD×LGD is an approximation; problems often give RR and spread to back out PD.

concepts.title: 簡化式模型：危險率 (Hazard Rate)
concepts.titleEn: Reduced-Form Models: Hazard Rate (Default Intensity)
concepts.explanation: 危險率λ（又稱違約強度default intensity）是在已生存至t的條件下，短時間Δt內違約的條件概率密度。累積違約概率F(t) = 1 − e^{−λt}；生存概率S(t) = e^{−λt}；λ為常數時條件（前推）違約概率與t無關、只與區間長度有關——即「無記憶性」（指數分布性質）。RR=0時風險中性PD即1−e^{−λt}；RR≠0時用利差近似：λ ≈ s/(1−RR)。考試陷阱：無記憶性意味著「明年違約概率不依賴已存活年數」；λ是年化平均違約強度，題目常設「已存活越久違約概率越高」的干擾項。
concepts.explanationEn: The hazard rate λ (default intensity) is the conditional default probability density over a short Δt given survival to t. Cumulative default probability F(t) = 1 − e^{−λt}; survival probability S(t) = e^{−λt}; with constant λ the forward (conditional) probability depends only on the interval length — the memoryless property of the exponential. With RR = 0 the risk-neutral PD is 1 − e^{−λt}; with RR ≠ 0, λ ≈ s/(1−RR). Exam traps: memorylessness means next-year default risk does not depend on how long the firm has survived; λ is an annualized average intensity.

concepts.title: 累積、邊際、條件與前推違約概率
concepts.titleEn: Cumulative, Marginal, Conditional and Forward Default Probabilities
concepts.explanation: 累積（無條件）違約概率：從0到t違約的總概率，累積曲線單調上升。邊際違約概率：第t期當年違約概率 = 相鄰兩期生存概率之差（S_{t−1} − S_t）。條件（前推）違約概率：給定已生存到t，在下一區間違約的概率 = (S_t − S_{t+k})/S_t。違約概率曲線斜率：上傾利差曲線→前期累積概率上升慢、後期上升快；下傾曲線→前期上升快、後期慢（「熬過最難時期」）。平均違約率ADR滿足 (1−PD_cum) = e^{−ADR×t}。考試陷阱：邊際概率之和=累積概率；條件概率用生存率調整；曲線斜率與期限結構形狀的對應。
concepts.explanationEn: Cumulative (unconditional) PD is the total probability of default from 0 to t; the cumulative curve rises monotonically. Marginal PD is the probability of defaulting in period t alone = S_{t−1} − S_t. Conditional (forward) PD given survival to t = (S_t − S_{t+k})/S_t. Slope implications: an upward-sloping spread curve implies slowly rising early cumulative PD and faster later rises; a downward-sloping curve implies fast early rises that slow later ('surviving the difficult period'). The average default rate satisfies (1−PD_cum) = e^{−ADR×t}. Exam traps: marginal probabilities sum to the cumulative; conditional probabilities are adjusted by survival; map curve slopes to term-structure shapes.

concepts.title: 違約相關性
concepts.titleEn: Default Correlation
concepts.explanation: 設兩公司違約概率分別為π1、π2，聯合違約概率π12，則違約相關性 ρ = (π12 − π1π2)/√(π1(1−π1)π2(1−π2))。要點：ρ範圍受π1、π2限制（下界為max(0, (π1+π2−1))/(歸一化)，上界為√(π低(1−π高)/(π高(1−π低)))）；π12=0時ρ可能仍為負；信用組合的分散化取決於違約相關性。考試陷阱：π12 < π1π2時ρ<0；獨立違約指π12=π1π2（ρ=0）；例：π1=2%、π2=3%、π12=0.4%時ρ≈0.1424。
concepts.explanationEn: For firms with default probabilities π1 and π2 and joint default probability π12, the default correlation is ρ = (π12 − π1π2)/√(π1(1−π1)π2(1−π2)). Points: ρ is bounded by π1 and π2; π12 = 0 can still give negative ρ; portfolio diversification depends on default correlation. Exam traps: π12 < π1π2 implies ρ<0; independence means π12 = π1π2 (ρ=0); e.g., π1=2%, π2=3%, π12=0.4% gives ρ≈0.1424.

concepts.title: 單因子模型（CreditMetrics框架）
concepts.titleEn: Single-Factor Model (CreditMetrics Framework)
concepts.explanation: 公司資產回報 a_i = β_i·m + √(1−β_i²)·ε_i，m為共同系統性因子，ε_i為特質風險，兩者不相關。給定違約門檻K_i，條件違約概率 p_i = Φ((K_i − β_i·m)/√(1−β_i²))。組合內兩公司條件違約概率的相關由β（資產相關）驅動。CreditMetrics以此（配合遷移矩陣與Monte Carlo）計算組合信用VaR，是自下而上（bottom-up）的逐日盯市（mark-to-market）模型。考試陷阱：β越高對系統因子越敏感、違約相關性越高；該模型是CreditRisk+（保險精算式）與CreditPortfolioView（宏觀因子式）之外的第三種路線。
concepts.explanationEn: Firm asset return a_i = β_i·m + √(1−β_i²)·ε_i, where m is the common systematic factor and ε_i idiosyncratic (uncorrelated with m). Given default threshold K_i, the conditional default probability is p_i = Φ((K_i − β_i·m)/√(1−β_i²)). Conditional default correlations across firms are driven by the asset correlations β. CreditMetrics builds on this (with migration matrices and Monte Carlo) for a bottom-up, mark-to-market portfolio credit VaR. Exam traps: higher β means higher systematic sensitivity and default correlation; contrast with CreditRisk+ (actuarial, default-mode) and CreditPortfolioView (macro factors).

concepts.title: 信用VaR與最壞情況違約率 (WCDR)
concepts.titleEn: Credit VaR and Worst-Case Default Rate (WCDR)
concepts.explanation: 高斯Copula法：給定置信水平（如99.9%），最壞情況違約率 WCDR = Φ((Φ^{-1}(PD) + √ρ·Φ^{-1}(0.999))/√(1−ρ))，信用VaR（CVaR）= EAD × WCDR × LGD；WCL_{99.9%,1yr} ≈ Σ EAD_i×LGD_i×WCDR_i。相關性ρ越高，WCDR越遠離平均PD。Credit VaR = WCL − EL。考試陷阱：題目通常直接給WCDR（如11.92%），只需套CVaR公式；EL用平均PD、CVaR用WCDR；CVaR − EL = 非預期損失部分。
concepts.explanationEn: Gaussian copula approach: at confidence level 99.9% the worst-case default rate is WCDR = Φ((Φ^{-1}(PD) + √ρ·Φ^{-1}(0.999))/√(1−ρ)) and credit VaR = EAD × WCDR × LGD; WCL_{99.9%,1yr} ≈ Σ EAD_i×LGD_i×WCDR_i. Higher correlation ρ pushes WCDR further above the average PD. Credit VaR = WCL − EL. Exam traps: WCDR is often given (e.g., 11.92%) — just apply the CVaR formula; EL uses the average PD while CVaR uses WCDR; CVaR − EL is the unexpected-loss component.

concepts.title: 信用組合模型比較
concepts.titleEn: Comparison of Portfolio Credit Risk Models
concepts.explanation: 四大模型：(1) CreditMetrics™（J.P.摩根）：mark-to-market模型，自下而上，基於遷移矩陣與資產相關（單因子/Monte Carlo）；(2) CreditRisk+（瑞士信貸）：違約模式（default mode）模型，只有違約/不違約兩種狀態，用保險精算（泊松分布）框架；(3) KMV組合模型（穆迪）：直接從股票價格提取違約相關性；(4) CreditPortfolioView（麥肯錫）：自上而下（top-down），用宏觀經濟因子調整違約概率。考試陷阱：區分MTM vs DM模型（CreditMetrics是MTM、CreditRisk+是DM）；KMV獨特之處在於用市場股價信息；CPV是唯一明確宏觀驅動的模型。
concepts.explanationEn: Four models: (1) CreditMetrics™ (J.P. Morgan): mark-to-market, bottom-up, based on migration matrices and asset correlations (single-factor/Monte Carlo); (2) CreditRisk+ (Credit Suisse): a default-mode model with only default/no-default states, using an actuarial (Poisson) framework; (3) KMV portfolio model (Moody's): extracts default correlation directly from equity prices; (4) CreditPortfolioView (McKinsey): top-down, adjusting default probabilities with macroeconomic factors. Exam traps: MTM vs DM distinction (CreditMetrics is MTM; CreditRisk+ is DM); KMV's distinct use of equity market information; CPV is the explicitly macro-driven model.

concepts.title: 風險貢獻與信用經濟資本
concepts.titleEn: Risk Contribution and Credit Economic Capital
concepts.explanation: 資產i對組合非預期損失的貢獻 RC_i = UL_i × (Σ_j ρ_ij·UL_j)/UL_P，滿足ΣRC_i = UL_P（可加分解）。經濟資本EC按選定置信水平（如99.9%）覆蓋非預期損失；銀行整體EC需覆蓋市場+信用+操作風險的聚合。當組合內貸款同質且規模相近時，各貸款的風險貢獻近似相等並低於其獨立UL（分散化效應）。考試陷阱：RC不是獨立UL（因為分母含相關性）；組合高度分散時RC≈UL×(UL_P/ΣUL)的比例縮放。
concepts.explanationEn: Asset i's contribution to portfolio UL is RC_i = UL_i × (Σ_j ρ_ij·UL_j)/UL_P, with ΣRC_i = UL_P (additive decomposition). Economic capital covers unexpected losses at a chosen confidence level (e.g., 99.9%); firmwide EC aggregates market, credit and operational risk. For homogeneous loans of similar size, each loan's risk contribution is approximately equal and below its stand-alone UL (diversification). Exam traps: RC differs from stand-alone UL because correlations enter; in a well-diversified portfolio RC is roughly UL scaled by UL_P/ΣUL.

concepts.title: 淨額結算、擔保與淨額結算因子
concepts.titleEn: Netting, Collateral and the Netting Factor
concepts.explanation: 淨額結算（netting）允許同一對手方多筆交易的正負敞口互相抵消，降低信用敞口。淨額結算因子 NF = EE(netting)/EE(no netting) = √(n + n(n−1)ρ)/n：n為交易數，ρ為交易間相關性；ρ=1時NF=1（無收益），ρ=0時NF=1/√n，ρ=−1時NF=0（完全對沖）。擔保門檻：threshold=0（強擔保，超額部分需交擔保）、threshold<0（部分擔保/超額擔保overcollateralized按記號習慣）、threshold=∞（無擔保）。考試陷阱：NF隨相關性上升而上升（淨額結算收益下降）；多筆交易分散化的好處只在相關性低時顯著；「過度擔保」與門檻的符號約定。
concepts.explanationEn: Netting offsets positive and negative exposures across trades with the same counterparty, reducing credit exposure. The netting factor NF = EE(netting)/EE(no netting) = √(n + n(n−1)ρ)/n with n trades and trade correlation ρ: at ρ=1, NF=1 (no benefit); at ρ=0, NF=1/√n; at ρ=−1, NF=0 (perfectly offsetting). Collateral thresholds: threshold=0 (strongly collateralized), threshold<0 (partially/over-collateralized by convention), threshold=∞ (uncollateralized). Exam traps: NF rises with correlation (less netting benefit); diversification benefits are significant only at low correlations; mind the sign conventions for over-collateralization.

concepts.title: 錯向風險與正向風險 (WWR / RWR)
concepts.titleEn: Wrong-Way Risk and Right-Way Risk (WWR / RWR)
concepts.explanation: 錯向風險（WWR）：敞口與對手方信用質量之間存在不利的依賴關係——對手方越可能違約時敞口越大，會增加交易對手風險與CVA。典型例子：買入與自己高度相關銀行的股票看跌期權；買CDS保護；外匯遠期（新興市場）；利率互換固定端接收方（receiver）。正向風險（RWR）：依賴關係有利——違約概率上升時敞口下降，降低對手風險與CVA。例子：賣出股票看跌（buy equity call）；賣CDS保護；商品互換；利率互換固定端支付方（payer）。考試陷阱：判斷標準是「對手方違約概率上升時，我對它的敞口變大（WWR）還是變小（RWR）」；跨市場關聯（同業）是常見WWR情境。
concepts.explanationEn: Wrong-way risk (WWR): an unfavorable dependence between exposure and counterparty credit quality — exposure is high when default is more likely, increasing counterparty risk and CVA. Typical cases: a long put on a bank highly correlated with your counterparty; buying CDS protection; FX forwards in emerging markets; a fixed-rate receiver in interest rate swaps. Right-way risk (RWR): the dependence is favorable — exposure falls as default probability rises, reducing counterparty risk and CVA (e.g., equity call options, selling CDS protection, commodity swaps, fixed-rate payers). Exam trap: the test is whether exposure rises (WWR) or falls (RWR) as the counterparty's default probability rises; cross-market (same-industry) linkages are classic WWR settings.

concepts.title: CVA、DVA與BCVA
concepts.titleEn: CVA, DVA and BCVA
concepts.explanation: CVA（信用估值調整）：銀行因對手方違約而承擔的預期成本現值，CVA = LGD × Σ EE(t_i)×PD(t_{i−1},t_i)，近似 CVA ≈ EPE × 信用利差；使衍生品組合對銀行的價值降低。DVA（債務估值調整）：對手方因銀行違約的預期成本現值，是銀行的「收益」項（銀行可能不必履行支付），提高組合價值。雙邊BCVA = CVA − DVA。計算用風險中性違約概率。考試陷阱：CVA用風險中性PD與風險中性EE；WWR會提高CVA；DVA增加在銀行自身利差走闊時；CVA是資產端損失、DVA是負債端收益。
concepts.explanationEn: CVA (credit valuation adjustment) is the present value of the expected cost of counterparty default: CVA = LGD × Σ EE(t_i)×PD(t_{i−1},t_i), approximated by CVA ≈ EPE × credit spread; it lowers the value of the derivatives portfolio to the bank. DVA (debit valuation adjustment) is the present value of the expected cost to the counterparty of the bank's own default — a benefit to the bank that raises portfolio value. Bilateral BCVA = CVA − DVA. Both use risk-neutral default probabilities. Exam traps: CVA uses risk-neutral PD and EE; WWR raises CVA; DVA grows when the bank's own spread widens; CVA is an asset-side loss while DVA is a liability-side gain.

concepts.title: 當前敞口壓力測試的缺陷
concepts.titleEn: Shortcomings of Stress Testing Current Exposure
concepts.explanation: 對當前敞口做壓力測試的兩大問題：(1) 各對手方壓力敞口無法有意義地聚合——直接加總隱含「所有對手方同時違約」，高估損失；(2) 未考慮對手方信用質量——只計交易價值，不含對手方還款意願與能力的變化。因此壓力敞口只是「潛在需要」的粗略上限，須結合違約概率與相關性（如交易對手自身信用利差與我方利差的相關性）補充。考試陷阱：聚合需引入違約相關信息；壓力敞口不等於預期損失。
concepts.explanationEn: Stress testing current exposures has two problems: (1) stressed exposures across counterparties cannot be meaningfully aggregated — summing them implies every counterparty defaults simultaneously, overstating losses; (2) they ignore counterparty credit quality — they reflect only trade values, not the counterparty's willingness or ability to pay. Stressed exposures are thus a rough upper bound on potential needs and must be complemented with default probabilities and correlations (including the correlation between the counterparty's and the bank's own credit spreads). Exam traps: aggregation requires default correlation information; stressed exposure is not expected loss.

concepts.title: 信用衍生品：CDS、TRS、CLN與First-to-Default
concepts.titleEn: Credit Derivatives: CDS, TRS, CLN and First-to-Default
concepts.explanation: CDS（信用違約互換）：保護買方支付利差（CDS spread），在參照實體信用事件（違約）時獲得賠付；賣出保護≈持有無擔保敞口。TRS（總回報互換）：以債券/資產組合的總回報（利息+資本利得/損失）換取浮動利率+利差；支付方持有債券時可把信用風險轉給接收方，不持有时相當於做空債券。CLN（信用聯結票據）：嵌入信用風險的債券，投資者承擔投資風險換取更高票息。First-to-default籃子CDS：籃內首筆違約即賠付並終止，可降低組合敞口，其價值隨籃內違約相關性下降而上升。考試陷阱：CDS賣方敞口在利差走闊時上升（與保護買方相反）；TRS的支付方轉出的是信用+市場風險；first-to-default對相關性的敏感方向。
concepts.explanationEn: CDS: the protection buyer pays a spread and receives payment on a credit event; selling protection is like holding an unleveraged exposure. TRS (total return swap): exchanges the total return on a bond or portfolio (coupons, interest, and gains/losses) for a floating rate plus a spread; a payer who owns the bond passes credit risk to the receiver, and without owning it takes a short position. CLN (credit-linked note): a bond embedding credit risk; investors earn a higher coupon for bearing it. A first-to-default basket CDS pays on the first default and terminates; its value rises as basket default correlation falls. Exam traps: the CDS seller's exposure rises when spreads widen; TRS transfers both credit and market risk; note the sensitivity of first-to-default to correlation.

concepts.title: 結構化信用：CDO分層與相關性敏感性
concepts.titleEn: Structured Credit: CDO Tranches and Correlation Sensitivity
concepts.explanation: CDO將資產池現金流分層：權益層（equity，先吸收損失）、夾層（mezzanine）、高級層（senior）。固定PD、相關性上升時：均值不變，高級層價值下降（風險上升）、夾層上升後下降、權益層價值上升（相關性高時損失要麼很小要麼很大，權益層受益）；各層Credit VaR均上升。違約概率上升（相關性不變）時：各層價值均下降；權益層Credit VaR下降（已接近全損）、高級層Credit VaR上升、夾層先升後降。策略含義：預期PD下降+相關性上升→賣高級層保護（看空高級層價值）並買權益層。考試陷阱：高級層與相關性同向（相關性越高風險越大）；權益層對相關性的反應與高級層相反。
concepts.explanationEn: A CDO tranches the collateral cash flows: equity (first-loss), mezzanine, senior. With constant PD and rising correlation: the mean is unchanged; senior tranche value falls (risk rises), mezzanine rises then falls, equity rises (losses become bimodal — either small or total — benefiting equity); every tranche's credit VaR rises. With rising PD and constant correlation: all tranche values fall; equity credit VaR falls (near-total loss already), senior credit VaR rises, mezzanine rises then falls. Strategy implication: expecting PD down and correlation up → sell senior protection and buy the equity tranche. Exam traps: the senior tranche is positively related to correlation; equity reacts opposite to senior.

concepts.title: MBS提前償還：CPR、SMM與PSA
concepts.titleEn: MBS Prepayment: CPR, SMM and PSA
concepts.explanation: CPR（年化提前償還率）= 1 − (1−SMM)^12，SMM（單月死亡率）為當月提前償還占剩餘本金（扣除計劃還本後）的比例。PSA基準：100% PSA假設CPR從0開始、前30個月每月增加0.2%（第30個月達6%）後維持不變。提前償還使MBS存續期縮短、產生負凸性（再投資風險增加、價格上行受限）。WAL（加權平均壽命）按本金回收時間加權。考試陷阱：SMM是月度、CPR是年化，換算用12次方；100% PSA的0.2%是月增量；提前償還在利率下降時加快（負凸性來源）。
concepts.explanationEn: CPR (annualized prepayment rate) = 1 − (1−SMM)^12; SMM (single monthly mortality) is the monthly prepayment relative to the remaining balance net of scheduled principal. The PSA benchmark: 100% PSA assumes CPR starts at 0 and rises 0.2% per month for 30 months (to 6%) then stays flat. Prepayments shorten MBS duration and create negative convexity (reinvestment risk rises; price upside is capped). WAL (weighted average life) weights principal repayments by time. Exam traps: SMM is monthly, CPR annual — convert with the 12th power; the 0.2% in PSA is a monthly increment; prepayments accelerate when rates fall (source of negative convexity).

concepts.title: CCP違約瀑布 (Loss Waterfall)
concepts.titleEn: CCP Loss Waterfall
concepts.explanation: 中央對手方（CCP）違約管理的資源順序：(1) 違約方資源（defaulter-pay）：違約者的初始保證金與違約基金出資；(2) CCP「風險自留」股本（skin-in-the-game），激勵CCP控制損失；(3) 剩餘違約基金（default fund）——由全體結算會員集體出資（survivors-pay），損失分攤可按比例或其他規則（激勵會員在拍賣中積極出價）；(4) 評估權（rights of assessment）：對違約基金耗盡（如動用25%）的未撥付補充義務；(5) 變動保證金損益削減（VMGH）：獲利會員的盈利被削減而欠款會員仍須全額支付；(6) 撕毀（tear-up）：終止與違約者相反方向的交易使CCP回到配對賬本。考試陷阱：瀑布順序；VMGH與評估權的區別（前者削減盈利、後者是補充出資義務）。
concepts.explanationEn: The CCP default waterfall order: (1) defaulter-pay resources — the defaulter's initial margin and default fund contributions; (2) the CCP's 'skin-in-the-game' equity, incentivizing loss control; (3) the remaining default fund — a survivors-pay pool of all clearing members, allocated pro rata or by other rules (incentivizing proactive auction bids); (4) rights of assessment — an unfunded obligation to recapitalize a depleted default fund (often triggered when, say, 25% is used); (5) variation margin gains haircutting (VMGH) — members with gains since default are not fully paid while debtors pay in full; (6) tear-up — terminating opposite trades to return the CCP to a matched book. Exam traps: memorize the order; distinguish VMGH (haircutting gains) from assessment rights (additional contributions).

concepts.title: 泊松分布與指數違約時間
concepts.titleEn: Poisson Distribution and Exponential Default Time
concepts.explanation: 以強度λ的泊松過程刻畫違約：區間t內違約次數n的概率 P(n) = (λt)^n·e^{−λt}/n!；違約時間t*服從指數分布，累積分布 F(t) = P(t*<t) = 1 − e^{−λt}，生存函數 e^{−λt}。CreditRisk+用泊松分布刻畫違約次數（均值=方差=λt）。考試陷阱：泊松過程假設各期違約獨立；違約次數的期望與方差相等是泊松的標誌；指數分布的無記憶性。
concepts.explanationEn: Default is modeled as a Poisson process with intensity λ: the probability of n defaults in t is P(n) = (λt)^n·e^{−λt}/n!; the default time t* is exponentially distributed with CDF F(t) = 1 − e^{−λt} and survival e^{−λt}. CreditRisk+ uses the Poisson distribution for default counts (mean = variance = λt). Exam traps: the Poisson process assumes independent periods; equality of mean and variance is its signature; memorylessness of the exponential.

concepts.title: Basel II IRB與信用風險監管資本
concepts.titleEn: Basel II IRB and Credit Risk Regulatory Capital
concepts.explanation: Basel II三大支柱：P1最低資本要求（總資本≥8%×(信用RWA + 市場風險計提×12.5 + 操作風險計提×12.5)）；P2監督審查；P3市場紀律。內部評級法（IRB）下銀行自估PD/LGD/EAD，監管公式（含ASRF單因子與相關性函數）在99.9%一年期計算資本：WCL ≈ Σ EAD_i×LGD_i×WCDR_i。標準法（SA）按外部評級風險權重（0%/20%/50%/100%等）。信用等價物 = max(ΣV_i,0) + (0.4+0.6×NRR)×Σα_i L_i。考試陷阱：12.5 = 1/8%的倒數換算；IRB的WCDR由監管公式給定（內含相關性隨PD非單調變化）；A-IRB銀行自估LGD而SA不能。
concepts.explanationEn: Basel II's three pillars: P1 minimum capital (total capital ≥ 8% of [credit RWA + market risk charge × 12.5 + operational risk charge × 12.5]); P2 supervisory review; P3 market discipline. Under the internal ratings-based (IRB) approach banks estimate PD/LGD/EAD and the regulatory formula (an ASRF single-factor model with correlation functions) computes capital at 99.9% over one year: WCL ≈ Σ EAD_i×LGD_i×WCDR_i. The standardized approach (SA) uses external-rating risk weights (0%/20%/50%/100%...). Credit equivalent amount = max(ΣV_i,0) + (0.4 + 0.6×NRR)×Σα_i L_i. Exam traps: 12.5 is the reciprocal of 8%; the IRB WCDR comes from the regulatory formula with non-monotonic correlation in PD; A-IRB banks estimate LGD themselves while SA banks cannot.

formulas.name: 預期損失 (EL)
formulas.description: 中文：PD為違約概率，LGD=1−回收率RR，EAD為違約敞口。EL由撥備與定價覆蓋。坑點：單位一致性（PD為年化概率時EL為年化損失）；風險中性與真實世界PD的選擇。
formulas.descriptionEn: PD is the probability of default, LGD = 1 − recovery rate, and EAD the exposure at default; EL is covered by provisions and pricing. Pitfalls: keep horizons consistent; choose risk-neutral vs real-world PD appropriately.

formulas.name: 非預期損失 (UL) 單一與組合
formulas.description: 中文：AE為調整後敞口，σ_PD、σ_LGD分別為PD與LGD的標準差（PD二項時σ_PD=√(PD(1−PD))）；ρ_ij為違約相關。組合UL小於個體UL之和。坑點：UL圍繞EL波動；信用VaR=WCL−EL需要另行計算WCL。
formulas.descriptionEn: AE is adjusted exposure; σ_PD and σ_LGD are the standard deviations of PD and LGD (with binomial PD, σ_PD = √(PD(1−PD))); ρ_ij the default correlation. Portfolio UL is below the sum of stand-alone ULs. Pitfalls: UL is volatility around EL; credit VaR = WCL − EL requires computing WCL separately.

formulas.name: 調整後敞口
formulas.description: 中文：OS為已提取貸款餘額，CMO為承諾授信額，UGD（α）為違約前未提取部分的提取比例。坑點：UGD隨信用惡化而上升；表外項目另有信用轉換係數。
formulas.descriptionEn: OS is outstandings drawn, CMO the committed amount, and UGD (α) the fraction of the undrawn commitment drawn before default. Pitfalls: UGD rises as credit deteriorates; off-balance-sheet items use credit conversion factors.

formulas.name: Altman Z-score
formulas.description: 中文：X1=營運資本/總資產（流動性）、X2=留存收益/總資產（累計盈利）、X3=EBIT/總資產（盈利性）、X4=股權市值/負債賬面值（槓桿/償付）、X5=銷售/總資產（營運能力）。判斷：Z>3.0低風險；2.7≤Z≤3.0警戒；1.8≤Z<2.7違約機會較大；Z<1.8高概率財務困境。坑點：各係數與變量的配對；X4用市值而非賬面股權。
formulas.descriptionEn: X1 = working capital/total assets (liquidity), X2 = retained earnings/total assets (cumulative profitability), X3 = EBIT/total assets, X4 = market value of equity/book value of liabilities (leverage/solvency), X5 = sales/total assets (activity). Rule: Z>3.0 unlikely to default; 2.7≤Z≤3.0 on alert; 1.8≤Z<2.7 a good chance of default; Z<1.8 high probability of financial embarrassment. Pitfalls: match coefficients to variables; X4 uses market equity, not book.

formulas.name: Merton模型：股權與債務估值
formulas.nameEn: Merton Model: Equity and Debt Valuation
formulas.latex: $Equity = V\,N(d_1) - K e^{-rT} N(d_2) \quad;\quad Debt = K e^{-rT} - Put = V N(-d_1) + K e^{-rT} N(d_2)$
formulas.description: 中文：V為公司資產價值，K為債務面值，r為無風險利率，T為期限，N(·)為標準正態累積分布；d1 = [ln(V/K) + (r + σ²/2)T]/(σ√T)，d2 = d1 − σ√T。股權=看漲期權，債務=無風險債−看跌期權。坑點：風險中性定價用r；σ上升債務價值下降（違約概率上升）。
formulas.descriptionEn: V is firm asset value, K the debt face value, r the risk-free rate, T maturity, and N(·) the standard normal CDF; d1 = [ln(V/K) + (r + σ²/2)T]/(σ√T), d2 = d1 − σ√T. Equity is a call; debt equals a risk-free bond minus a put. Pitfalls: pricing uses r; higher σ lowers debt value (higher default probability).

formulas.name: Merton違約距離與違約概率
formulas.nameEn: Merton Distance to Default and PD
formulas.description: 中文：μ為真實世界預期資產回報，σ為資產波動率，F為債務面值，T為剩餘期限。PD=N(−DD)，DD越遠違約概率越低。坑點：計算真實PD用μ而非r；與風險中性d1/d2公式混淆是常見錯誤；比較不同公司違約可能性時比較DD。
formulas.descriptionEn: μ is the real-world expected asset return, σ the asset volatility, F the debt face value, and T remaining maturity; PD = N(−DD) with larger DD meaning lower PD. Pitfalls: use μ (not r) for real-world PD — confusing it with the risk-neutral d1/d2 is the classic error; compare counterparties via DD.

formulas.name: KMV違約點與違約距離
formulas.nameEn: KMV Default Point and Distance to Default
formulas.description: 中文：K為違約點：長期負債<1.5倍短期負債時 K=STD+0.5×LTD；否則 K=STD+(0.7−0.3×STD/LTD)×LTD。DD=（預期資產價值−違約點）/（波動率×資產價值），再經歷史數據映射為EDF。坑點：違約點不是總負債；DD簡化式(V−K)/σ_V僅在V標準化時成立。
formulas.descriptionEn: K is the default point: K = STD + 0.5×LTD when LTD < 1.5×STD; otherwise K = STD + (0.7 − 0.3×STD/LTD)×LTD. DD = (E[V] − K)/(σ_V×V), mapped through historical data to an EDF. Pitfalls: the default point is not total debt; the simplified (V−K)/σ_V holds only for standardized V.

formulas.name: 風險中性違約概率（債券利差法）
formulas.description: 中文：由公司債與無風險債利差推斷風險中性PD：s=YTM−Rf≈PD×LGD（近似）。無回收（RR=0）時 p = 1 − (1+Rf)/(1+YTM)。坑點：這是近似式；利差還含流動性與稅收成分；風險中性PD高於真實PD。
formulas.descriptionEn: Back out the risk-neutral PD from the corporate-Treasury spread: s = YTM − Rf ≈ PD×LGD (approximation); with zero recovery, p = 1 − (1+Rf)/(1+YTM). Pitfalls: it is an approximation; spreads also embed liquidity and tax effects; risk-neutral PD exceeds real-world PD.

formulas.name: 信用利差
formulas.description: 中文：y為公司債收益率，r_f為同期限無風險利率；利差補償預期違約損失（近似PD×LGD）。Merton框架下利差隨槓桿與波動率上升而上升，期限極短時趨近0。坑點：利差並非純違約補償；題目常給利差與LGD反推PD。
formulas.descriptionEn: y is the corporate yield and r_f the matching risk-free rate; the spread compensates expected default loss (≈ PD×LGD). In Merton, spreads rise with leverage and volatility and approach zero at very short maturities. Pitfalls: spreads are not purely default compensation; problems often give the spread and LGD to back out PD.

formulas.name: 指數違約時間分布
formulas.description: 中文：λ為危險率（違約強度），t*為違約時間。F(t)為0到t的累積違約概率，S(t)為生存概率。坑點：無記憶性——條件違約概率只依賴區間長度；λ恒定時可用利差近似λ≈s/(1−RR)。
formulas.descriptionEn: λ is the hazard rate (default intensity) and t* the default time; F(t) is the cumulative default probability over (0,t) and S(t) the survival probability. Pitfalls: memorylessness — conditional default probability depends only on the interval length; with constant λ, λ ≈ s/(1−RR) from spreads.

formulas.name: 邊際、條件（前推）與平均違約概率
formulas.nameEn: Marginal, Conditional (Forward), and Average Default Probabilities
formulas.description: 中文：邊際概率為當期新增違約概率（相鄰生存率之差）；條件（前推）概率以生存至t為條件；ADR為年化平均違約率。坑點：邊際概率之和=累積概率；條件概率需要除以生存率；前推概率隨生存而變（λ非恆定時）。
formulas.descriptionEn: The marginal PD is the incremental probability of defaulting in that period (difference of adjacent survival rates); the conditional (forward) PD conditions on survival to t; ADR is the annualized average default rate. Pitfalls: marginal probabilities sum to cumulative; conditional probabilities divide by survival; forward probabilities drift when λ is not constant.

formulas.name: 違約相關性
formulas.description: 中文：π1、π2為兩公司違約概率，π12為聯合違約概率。分子為實際聯合違約與獨立情形之差。坑點：ρ的取值範圍受限於π1、π2；π12=0可得負相關；獨立對應ρ=0（π12=π1π2）。
formulas.descriptionEn: π1 and π2 are the firms' default probabilities and π12 the joint default probability; the numerator is the deviation of the joint probability from independence. Pitfalls: ρ's range is bounded by π1, π2; π12 = 0 yields negative correlation; independence corresponds to ρ = 0 (π12 = π1π2).

formulas.name: 單因子模型（資產回報與條件違約概率）
formulas.nameEn: Single-Factor Model (Asset Return and Conditional PD)
formulas.description: 中文：m為系統性因子，ε_i為特質風險（與m不相關），β_i為資產相關，K_i為違約門檻，Φ為標準正態CDF。條件違約概率隨m惡化而上升。坑點：β越大對系統因子越敏感；模型是CreditMetrics與Basel IRB公式的基礎。
formulas.descriptionEn: m is the systematic factor, ε_i idiosyncratic risk (uncorrelated with m), β_i the asset correlation, K_i the default threshold, and Φ the standard normal CDF; conditional default probability deteriorates as m falls. Pitfalls: higher β means greater systematic sensitivity; this underlies CreditMetrics and the Basel IRB formula.

formulas.name: 高斯Copula WCDR與信用VaR
formulas.nameEn: Gaussian Copula WCDR and Credit VaR
formulas.description: 中文：WCDR為99.9%置信下一年期最壞情況違約率，ρ為Copula相關參數，CVaR為信用VaR。相關性越高WCDR越大。坑點：CVaR−EL=非預期部分；題目通常直接給WCDR（如11.92%），只需計算EAD×WCDR×LGD；回收率以(1−RR)=LGD代入。
formulas.descriptionEn: WCDR is the one-year worst-case default rate at 99.9% confidence, ρ the copula correlation, and CVaR the credit VaR; WCDR rises with ρ. Pitfalls: CVaR − EL is the unexpected component; WCDR is usually given (e.g., 11.92%) so only EAD×WCDR×LGD is needed; use LGD = 1 − RR.

formulas.name: 風險貢獻 (Risk Contribution)
formulas.description: 中文：RC_i為資產i對組合非預期損失的貢獻，滿足可加性。同質組合中各資產RC近似相等。坑點：RC不同於獨立UL；分散化使RC低於UL_i。
formulas.descriptionEn: RC_i is asset i's contribution to portfolio UL and the decomposition is additive; in homogeneous portfolios RCs are approximately equal. Pitfalls: RC differs from stand-alone UL; diversification makes RC below UL_i.

formulas.name: 淨額結算因子
formulas.description: 中文：n為與同一對手方的交易筆數，ρ為交易間相關係數。ρ=1時NF=1（無淨額收益）；ρ=0時NF=1/√n；ρ=−1時NF=0。坑點：NF隨ρ上升而上升；淨額結算降低敞口但不改變交易本身風險。
formulas.descriptionEn: n is the number of trades with the counterparty and ρ the trade correlation: NF = 1 at ρ = 1 (no benefit), 1/√n at ρ = 0, and 0 at ρ = −1. Pitfalls: NF rises with ρ; netting reduces exposure but not the riskiness of the trades themselves.

formulas.name: CVA（信用估值調整）
formulas.latex: $CVA = LGD \sum_{i=1}^{m} EE(t_i)\times PD(t_{i-1}, t_i) \;\approx\; EPE \times Spread$
formulas.description: 中文：EE(t_i)為第i期預期敞口，PD(t_{i−1},t_i)為該期風險中性違約概率，LGD為違約損失率；EPE×利差為近似式。坑點：用風險中性PD；WWR提高CVA；CVA是對手方違約的預期成本現值，降低衍生品價值。
formulas.descriptionEn: EE(t_i) is the expected exposure in interval i, PD(t_{i−1},t_i) the risk-neutral default probability over that interval, and LGD the loss given default; CVA ≈ EPE × spread is the approximation. Pitfalls: risk-neutral PD is required; WWR raises CVA; CVA is the PV of expected counterparty-default costs and reduces derivative value.

formulas.name: 雙邊CVA (BCVA)
formulas.latex: $BCVA = CVA - DVA \quad;\quad DVA = LGD \sum_{i} ENE(t_i)\times PD_{bank}(t_{i-1}, t_i)$
formulas.description: 中文：DVA為銀行自身違約給對手方造成的預期成本現值（對銀行是收益）；BCVA=CVA−DVA同時反映雙方違約。坑點：DVA在銀行自身利差走闊時增加；會計上DVA計入盈利但變現依賴存續。
formulas.descriptionEn: DVA is the PV of the expected cost to the counterparty of the bank's default (a gain to the bank); BCVA = CVA − DVA reflects both parties' default. Pitfalls: DVA rises when the bank's own spread widens; accounting gains from DVA are only realized if the bank survives.

formulas.name: CPR與SMM換算及PSA基準
formulas.description: 中文：SMM為單月提前償還率，CPR為年化提前償還率；100% PSA下CPR前30個月每月增加0.2%（第30個月為6%），之後不變。坑點：SMM→CPR用12次方；PSA百分比是相對於100%基準的倍數；提前償還加快縮短WAL。
formulas.descriptionEn: SMM is the single monthly mortality and CPR the annualized rate; under 100% PSA, CPR rises 0.2% per month for 30 months (to 6%) then stays flat. Pitfalls: raise SMM to the 12th power for CPR; PSA percentages are multiples of the 100% benchmark; faster prepayments shorten WAL.

formulas.name: 泊松違約次數分布
