formulas.description: 中文：λ為違約強度，N(t)為t時間內違約次數；期望=方差=λt。CreditRisk+以此刻畫組合違約次數。坑點：泊松假設各小區間違約獨立且強度恆定；違約次數不設上限。
formulas.descriptionEn: λ is the default intensity and N(t) the number of defaults in t; mean = variance = λt. CreditRisk+ uses it for portfolio default counts. Pitfalls: the Poisson process assumes independent intervals with constant intensity; the count is unbounded.

formulas.name: Basel II 信用風險資本（IRB）
formulas.description: 中文：IRB下銀行自估PD/LGD/EAD，監管公式給出99.9%、一年期的WCDR，加總得最壞情況損失並據此計算資本。坑點：WCDR內含相關性函數（隨PD先升後降）；WCL是資本基礎而非EL。
formulas.descriptionEn: Under IRB banks estimate PD/LGD/EAD and the regulatory formula supplies the one-year 99.9% WCDR; the sum gives the worst-case loss underlying capital. Pitfalls: the WCDR embeds a correlation function that is non-monotonic in PD; WCL underlies capital, not EL.

formulas.name: NRR與信用等價物
formulas.nameEn: Net Replacement Ratio and Credit Equivalent Amount
formulas.description: 中文：NRR為淨重置比率（淨額結算後正市值/無淨額正市值之和），越小淨額收益越大；信用等價物CE=當前淨敞口+潛在未來敞口加成（α_i L_i按剩餘期限分檔），並按(0.4+0.6NRR)調整。坑點：NRR=1表示無淨額結算收益；分子只取總和為正的情形。
formulas.descriptionEn: NRR is the net replacement ratio (net positive MTM over the sum of positive MTMs); lower NRR means more netting benefit. The credit equivalent CE = current net exposure plus potential future exposure add-ons (α_i L_i by remaining maturity), adjusted by (0.4 + 0.6×NRR). Pitfalls: NRR = 1 means no netting benefit; the numerator only applies when the net sum is positive.

chapters.chapterName: 第三章 操作風險與韌性
chapters.summary: 本章（權重20%）分兩大主線。操作風險管理：定義與Basel損失事件分類、風險治理與三道防線、風險文化與風險偏好、RCSA、KRI與損失數據收集、控制類別（預防/偵測/糾正/指導）、瑞士奶酪模型；操作風險資本方法（BIA、TSA、AMA/LDA、Basel III新標準化方法SMA的BIC與ILM）；操作風險壓力測試與情景分析；模型風險管理、外包與第三方風險、網絡風險與網絡安全信息共享、洗錢與資恐（ML/FT）。操作風險與綜合風險：RAROC與調整後RAROC、最低回報率（稅後加權平均股權成本）、經濟資本、資本充足流程（CAP）與宏觀審慎壓力測試（SCAP/CCAR/DFAST）；CoCo可轉換應急債券；巴塞爾協議演進（Basel I風險權重、1996修正案、Basel II三支柱、Basel 2.5、Basel III資本與流動性規則）、G-SIB附加與逆周期緩衝。考試常見陷阱：三道防線職責劃分、TSA各業務線β係數、SMA中ILM對大型銀行的約束、RAROC與ARAROC的接受準則、Basel III各層級資本比例數值。
chapters.summaryEn: This chapter (20% weight) has two themes. Operational risk management: definition and Basel loss-event taxonomy, risk governance and the three lines of defense, risk culture and risk appetite, RCSA, KRIs and loss-data collection, control categories (preventive/detective/corrective/directive), the Swiss cheese model; capital approaches (BIA, TSA, AMA/LDA, and the Basel III standardized approach with BIC and ILM); operational risk stress testing and scenario analysis; model risk management; outsourcing and third-party risk; cyber risk and cybersecurity information sharing; money laundering and terrorist financing (ML/FT). Operational and integrated risk: RAROC and adjusted RAROC, the hurdle rate (after-tax weighted-average cost of equity capital), economic capital, the capital adequacy process (CAP) and macro-prudential stress tests (SCAP/CCAR/DFAST); CoCo contingent convertible bonds; the Basel Accords' evolution (Basel I risk weights, the 1996 Amendment, Basel II pillars, Basel 2.5, Basel III capital and liquidity rules), G-SIB add-ons and the countercyclical buffer. Exam traps: allocating duties across the three lines of defense, TSA business-line betas, ILM's constraint on large banks, RAROC vs adjusted-RAROC decision rules, and Basel III capital ratio values.

concepts.title: 操作風險定義與Basel損失事件分類
concepts.titleEn: Operational Risk Definition and Basel Loss Event Taxonomy
concepts.explanation: Basel對操作風險的定義：因內部流程、人員、系統不完善或失靈，或外部事件造成損失的風險（含法律風險，不含戰略與聲譽風險）。Basel將損失事件分為7個Level 1類別（內部欺詐、外部欺詐、僱傭制度與工作場所安全、客戶產品與業務活動、實物資產損壞、業務中斷與系統故障、執行交割與流程管理），下設Level 2、Level 3細分，構成標準分類體系（taxonomy），用於損失數據收集與對標。考試陷阱：法律風險屬於操作風險、戰略/聲譽風險不屬於；分類時按事件直接原因歸類。
concepts.explanationEn: Basel defines operational risk as the risk of loss from inadequate or failed internal processes, people and systems, or from external events (including legal risk; excluding strategic and reputational risk). Loss events are classified into seven Level 1 categories (internal fraud; external fraud; employment practices and workplace safety; clients, products and business practices; damage to physical assets; business disruption and system failures; execution, delivery and process management), subdivided into Levels 2 and 3 — the standard taxonomy for loss-data collection and benchmarking. Exam traps: legal risk is operational risk, strategic/reputational risk is not; classify by the direct cause of the event.

concepts.title: 操作風險管理框架 (ORMF) 與治理
concepts.titleEn: Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF) and Governance
concepts.explanation: ORMF是一套管理操作風險的政策、流程與系統體系。董事會職責：確定企業願意承擔的重大風險性質與程度（設定風險偏好）、確保在偏好範圍內運營、驗證ORMF、定期修訂、獲取高管執行保證；並建立有效傳達的風險文化、確保各層面培訓充分。監管要求董事會對ORMF進行獨立審查。ORMF組件包括：治理、風險偏好、風險識別與評估（RCSA）、監測與報告（KRI、損失數據）、控制與緩釋、應急與業務連續性。考試陷阱：風險偏好由董事會設定而非高管；ORMF需周期性獨立審查（內審/第三方）。
concepts.explanationEn: The ORMF is the set of policies, processes and systems for managing operational risk. Board duties: determine the nature and extent of significant risks the firm is willing to take (set risk appetite), ensure operations stay within appetite, validate and periodically revise the ORMF, obtain assurance that senior management implements it at all decision levels, and build a well-communicated risk culture with adequate training. Regulators require independent review of the ORMF. Components include governance, risk appetite, identification and assessment (RCSA), monitoring and reporting (KRIs, loss data), control and mitigation, and contingency/business continuity. Exam traps: the board sets risk appetite, not senior management; the ORMF needs periodic independent review.

concepts.title: 三道防線 (Three Lines of Defense)
concepts.titleEn: Three Lines of Defense (3LoD)
concepts.explanation: 第一道：風險所有者（業務一線與前中台管理層），BCBS稱「業務單位管理」，對其風險承擔直接責任。第二道：對業務流程與風險管理政策執行提供獨立監督的職能（企業操作風險管理職能CORF、合規等），負責挑戰業務條線。第三道：內部審計，BCBS稱「獨立保證」，檢查前兩道的有效性並直接向董事會/審計委員會報告。ERM推廣時三道防線可延伸到企業整體風險（含信用、市場風險）。考試陷阱：業務線是風險的第一責任人（不是風險管理部門）；內審不參與日常風險管理（否則損害獨立性）；第二道設計框架、第一道執行。
concepts.explanationEn: First line: risk owners — front-line business and management ('business unit management' per BCBS) — directly responsible for their risks. Second line: functions providing independent risk oversight over business processes and policy implementation (the corporate operational risk function, CORF; compliance), challenging the business lines. Third line: internal audit ('independent assurance'), testing the first two lines and reporting to the board/audit committee. Under ERM, the 3LoD extends to firmwide risks including credit and market risk. Exam traps: business lines own their risks (not the risk function); internal audit must not run day-to-day risk management (independence); the second line designs the framework, the first line executes.

concepts.title: 風險治理、風險偏好與風險文化 (ERM)
concepts.titleEn: Risk Governance, Risk Appetite and Risk Culture (ERM)
concepts.explanation: 企業風險管理（ERM）框架的三個支柱：風險治理（組織架構、委員會、職責與問責）；風險偏好（董事會確定的願意承擔的風險總量與類型，通過限額與緩衝層層分解，並用壓力測試檢驗在極端情形下是否仍在偏好之內）；風險文化（全員對風險的態度與行為規範，由高層以身作則、績效與薪酬機制強化）。風險偏好陳述需可量化、可監測，並與資本計劃、戰略掛鉤。考試陷阱：壓力測試在風險偏好框架內的作用是檢驗「偏好能否在壓力下維持」；文化缺陷（如激勵過度冒險）是很多操作風險事件（如欺詐、合規違規）的根源。
concepts.explanationEn: Three pillars of an ERM framework: risk governance (structure, committees, responsibilities and accountability); risk appetite (the aggregate amount and type of risk the board is willing to assume, cascaded through limits and buffers and tested with stress testing under severe scenarios); risk culture (shared attitudes and behaviors, set from the top and reinforced through performance and incentive systems). Appetite statements must be quantifiable and monitorable and tie into capital planning and strategy. Exam traps: within the appetite framework, stress testing checks whether appetite can be maintained under stress; cultural flaws (e.g., incentives for excess risk) underlie many operational-loss events such as fraud and compliance breaches.

concepts.title: 風險與控制自我評估 (RCSA)
concepts.titleEn: Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA)
concepts.explanation: RCSA是機構/業務條線/部門對自身操作風險可能性與影響的系統評估過程，通常由第二道防線主持的工作坊式討論收集一線信息（大型機構可用問卷節省時間）。輸出：主要固有風險（inherent risks）、關鍵控制及其有效性、殘餘風險（residual risk，考慮控制環境後的風險水平）。RCSA結果應形成行動計劃並跟踪整改。考試陷阱：RCSA揭示的是固有風險→控制→殘餘風險的邏輯；主持方是第二道防線、參與方是一線。
concepts.explanationEn: RCSA is a structured process by which an organization, business line or department evaluates the likelihood and impact of its operational risks, typically via workshop-style discussions facilitated by the second line of defense to collect first-line input (questionnaires in the largest institutions to save time). Outputs: main inherent risks, key controls and their effectiveness, and residual risk (after the control environment). RCSA results should feed action plans tracked to closure. Exam traps: the logic is inherent risk → controls → residual risk; the second line facilitates while the first line participates.

concepts.title: 控制類別：預防、偵測、糾正與指導
concepts.titleEn: Control Categories: Preventative, Detective, Corrective and Directive
concepts.explanation: 四類控制：(1) 預防性控制（preventative）：降低風險發生可能性、緩解成因（如職責分離、密碼管理）；(2) 偵測性控制（detective）：事件發生中或之後盡早發現以減少影響（如對賬、異常監控），若偵測同時找出成因則兼有預防性質；(3) 糾正性控制（corrective）：減少或修正事件造成的負面影響（如災備恢復、回補流程）；(4) 指導性控制（directive）：以制度、程序與培訓規範行為、降低風險（如政策、行為準則）。考試陷阱：對賬屬於偵測性而非預防性；培訓與政策屬於指導性；災備屬於糾正性。
concepts.explanationEn: Four control types: (1) preventative controls reduce the likelihood of risks materializing by mitigating causes (e.g., segregation of duties, password management); (2) detective controls detect events during or soon after occurrence to reduce impact (e.g., reconciliations, exception monitoring) and carry a preventative element if they also identify causes; (3) corrective controls reduce or correct negative impacts of incidents (e.g., disaster recovery, restitution); (4) directive controls structure conduct via guidelines, procedures and training (e.g., policies, codes of conduct). Exam traps: reconciliation is detective, not preventative; training/policies are directive; disaster recovery is corrective.

concepts.title: 操作風險資本：BIA、TSA與AMA
concepts.titleEn: Operational Risk Capital: BIA, TSA and AMA
concepts.explanation: Basel II三種方法：(1) 基本指標法（BIA）：操作風險資本 = 15% × 近三年正的毛收入均值，最簡單、對風險不敏感；(2) 標準化法（TSA/ASA）：按八條業務線分別用β係數乘以各線毛收入、逐年取正加總後除以3（β：公司金融18%、交易與銷售18%、零售銀行12%、商業銀行15%、支付與清算18%、代理服務15%、資產管理12%、零售經紀12%）；(3) 高級計量法（AMA）：用內部模型計量一年期99.9%的非預期損失，允許風險緩釋。考試陷阱：BIA用「正毛收入均值」；TSA分子每年單獨取max(ΣβGI,0)再三年平均；AMA必須含內部數據、外部數據、情景分析與業務環境控制因素四要素。
concepts.explanationEn: Basel II's three approaches: (1) Basic Indicator Approach (BIA): capital = 15% of the average positive gross income over three years — simplest, least risk-sensitive; (2) Standardized Approach (TSA/ASA): business-line betas times gross income per line, summed per year (floored at zero) and averaged over three years (betas: corporate finance 18%, trading & sales 18%, retail banking 12%, commercial banking 15%, payment & settlement 18%, agency services 15%, asset management 12%, retail brokerage 12%); (3) Advanced Measurement Approach (AMA): internal models estimating one-year 99.9% unexpected loss, allowing risk mitigation. Exam traps: BIA averages positive gross income; TSA takes max(ΣβGI, 0) per year then divides by 3; AMA must combine internal data, external data, scenario analysis and business environment/internal control factors.

concepts.title: Basel III新標準化方法 (SMA)：BIC與ILM
concepts.titleEn: Basel III Standardized Approach (SMA): BIC and ILM
concepts.explanation: SMA以業務指標（BI）為基礎：BI按規模分桶後得出BIC（business indicator component）；操作風險資本 ORC = BIC × ILM，其中內部損失乘數 ILM = ln(e − 1 + (LC/BIC)^0.8)，損失組成 LC = 非預期損失IL + 預期損失EL（十年損失數據）。坑點：對最大 bucket（BI超過一定規模）的銀行ILM下限為1（歷史損失高會推高資本）；規模較小的銀行可直接用BIC（ILM=1）。SMA取代BIA/TSA/AMA，兼顧規模敏感性與損失敏感性。考試陷阱：ILM>1意味著歷史損失相對規模偏高、資本被上調；LC含EL與IL兩部分。
concepts.explanationEn: The SMA is based on the business indicator (BI): BI buckets map into the business indicator component (BIC); operational risk capital ORC = BIC × ILM, where the internal loss multiplier ILM = ln(e − 1 + (LC/BIC)^0.8) and the loss component LC = unexpected loss IL + expected loss EL (ten years of loss data). For the largest BI bucket, ILM is floored at 1 (high historical losses raise capital); smaller banks may use BIC alone (ILM = 1). The SMA replaces BIA/TSA/AMA, blending size sensitivity with loss sensitivity. Exam traps: ILM > 1 means above-average historical losses and higher capital; LC contains both EL and IL.

concepts.title: 損失分布法 (LDA)
concepts.titleEn: Loss Distribution Approach (LDA)
concepts.explanation: LDA是AMA的主要實現方式：分別對損失頻率（如泊松、負二項）與損失強度（如對數正態、帕累托、威布爾）建模，假設兩者獨立，通過卷積/Monte Carlo合成年度損失分布，取99.9%分位。約束與缺陷：(1) 頻率與強度獨立假設；(2) 數據按風險類別拆分後要求各類內部i.i.d.（無隱含相關）；(3) 操作風險損失極度右偏，LDA難以充分刻畫尾部，需用極值理論與情景數據補充高額損失。考試陷阱：LDA的獨立性假設（頻率×強度）；尾部需EVT/情景補充；99.9%分位點對數據質量極其敏感。
concepts.explanationEn: LDA is the main AMA implementation: model loss frequency (e.g., Poisson, negative binomial) and severity (e.g., lognormal, Pareto, Weibull) separately, assume independence, and combine them (convolution/Monte Carlo) into the annual loss distribution, reading the 99.9% quantile. Constraints and flaws: (1) independence between frequency and severity; (2) data split into risk classes must be i.i.d. within class (no implicit correlation); (3) operational losses are extremely skewed, so LDA cannot fully capture the tail — extreme value theory and scenario data are needed to complete the tail. Exam traps: the independence assumptions; tail completion via EVT/scenarios; the 99.9% quantile is highly sensitive to data quality.

concepts.title: 操作風險壓力測試與情景分析
concepts.titleEn: Operational Risk Stress Testing and Scenario Analysis
concepts.explanation: 操作風險壓力測試方法包括：宏觀經濟壓力測試（macroeconomic stress testing，把宏觀變量與損失聯繫）、參數壓力測試（parameter stress testing，直接調整模型參數如頻率/強度）、情景壓力測試（scenario stress testing，設計極端事件情景）。情景研討會（scenario workshops）開發極端操作風險事件情景時應遵循最佳實踐：多元參與（業務、風險、審計）、假設合理且一致（coherence）、情景相互獨立不重疊、結果可校驗；內審應審查情景開發流程。考試陷阱：情景假設需具備合理性（plausibility）與一致性；情景之間不應有隱含重疊；內審的角色是審查而非主持。
concepts.explanationEn: Operational risk stress testing approaches include macroeconomic stress testing (linking macro variables to losses), parameter stress testing (adjusting model parameters such as frequency/severity directly), and scenario stress testing (designing extreme-event scenarios). Best practices for scenario workshops developing extreme events: diverse participation (business, risk, audit), plausible and coherent assumptions, mutually exclusive/non-overlapping scenarios, and verifiable outputs; internal audit reviews the scenario-development process. Exam traps: assumptions must be plausible and coherent; scenarios should not implicitly overlap; internal audit reviews rather than facilitates.

concepts.title: 瑞士奶酪模型 (Swiss Cheese Model)
concepts.titleEn: Swiss Cheese Model
concepts.explanation: Reason的瑞士奶酪模型把事故視為多層防禦「切片」上的孔洞對齊的結果：每一層（組織因素、監督、不安全行為的前因、不安全行為本身）都有缺陷（孔洞），當各層孔洞恰好對齊時風險穿透防線造成損失。管理含義：通過增加防禦層、縮小各層孔洞（加強控制與培訓）降低事故概率。考試陷阱：該模型強調「多重防禦層對齊失效」，而非單一原因；控制結構的縱深防禦是其核心。
concepts.explanationEn: Reason's Swiss cheese model views accidents as the alignment of 'holes' across successive defense layers (organizational influences, supervision, preconditions for unsafe acts, unsafe acts): each layer has weaknesses, and when the holes line up, the hazard penetrates all defenses and losses occur. Managerial implication: add defense layers and shrink the holes (stronger controls and training) to cut accident probability. Exam traps: the model stresses aligned multi-layer failures rather than a single cause; defense in depth is the core.

concepts.title: 操作韌性與影響容忍度 (Operational Resilience)
concepts.titleEn: Operational Resilience and Impact Tolerances
concepts.explanation: 操作韌性是「在除最極端情形外的所有條件下維持關鍵業務服務的能力」（BCBS 2021）。與傳統業務連續性管理（BCM）的關鍵區別：BCM聚焦每個流程在既定時間框架內的連續與恢復（恢復時間目標RTO）；韌性聚焦「重要業務服務」（important business services，如對客戶的服務）在「影響容忍度」（impact tolerances，相當於RTO的容忍上限，可含時間等多種度量）內的連續與恢復。實踐：識別IBS→設定各容忍度指標→映射支撐的人員/流程/技術/設施→測試極端但合理的情景→投資消除薄弱環節。考試陷阱：韌性管理的是服務而非流程；影響容忍度是「最大可容忍中斷水平」；提升系統帶寬與災備能力是典型合規動作。
concepts.explanationEn: Operational resilience is 'the ability to maintain critical business services in all but the most extreme conditions' (BCBS, 2021). The key difference from traditional business continuity management (BCM): BCM focuses on the continuity and recovery of each process within a set timeframe (recovery time objective, RTO), while resilience focuses on the continuity and recovery of 'important business services' (e.g., services to customers) within 'impact tolerances' (the maximum tolerable level of disruption, measured in time plus other metrics). Practice: identify IBS → set tolerance metrics → map the people/processes/technology/facilities that deliver them → test against severe-but-plausible scenarios → invest to remediate weak points. Exam traps: resilience manages services, not processes; impact tolerances cap tolerable disruption; raising bandwidth and backup capability is a typical compliance action.

concepts.title: 模型風險與模型風險管理
concepts.titleEn: Model Risk and Model Risk Management
concepts.explanation: 模型風險的兩大來源：(1) 模型可能有根本性錯誤——相對設計目標與預期用途產出不準確（錯誤可發生在理論選擇、樣本設計、輸入選擇與估計、信息系統實現的任何環節）；(2) 模型被錯誤使用——即使根本健全、輸出準確的模型，被用於非設計用途（misapplication）也會產生高模型風險。模型本質是對現實的簡化。管理實踐：獨立驗證（開發與驗證職責分離）、定期復檢（含敏感性分析，識別模型可能失效的市場環境並在該環境下限制使用）、模型清單與使用範圍管控。考試陷阱：把成功回測的房貸模型直接用於商業貸款是「誤用」；敏感性分析應周期性重複。
concepts.explanationEn: Two sources of model risk: (1) fundamental model errors — inaccurate outputs relative to the design objective and intended uses (errors can arise at any point from theory choice and sample design through inputs, estimation and IT implementation); (2) misapplication — even a fundamentally sound model with accurate outputs can exhibit high model risk if used outside its design objective. Models are simplifications of reality. Management practice: independent validation (segregation of development and validation), periodic review including sensitivity analysis to identify conditions where the model may perform poorly (constraining use then), model inventory and usage controls. Exam traps: applying a backtested mortgage model to commercial loans is misapplication; sensitivity analysis should be repeated periodically.

concepts.title: 外包與第三方服務提供商風險管理
concepts.titleEn: Outsourcing and Service Provider Risk Management
concepts.explanation: 服務提供商風險管理方案要素：風險評估、盡職調查與服務商選擇、合同條款與考量、激勵薪酬審查、對服務商的監督與監測、業務連續性與應急計劃。要點：(1) 銀行應審閱服務商公開可得的所有審計報告；(2) 不應讓服務商銷售人員的報酬主要依賴銀行產品銷售佣金（利益衝突）；(3) 不必完全禁止第三方接觸關鍵流程（可用控制補償）；(4) 應急計劃應要求服務商具備/參與，而非由銀行代為開發；(5) 合同需含審計權、數據安全、退出安排。考試陷阱：外包不免除銀行自身合規與風險管理責任；「防範第三方的關鍵流程接觸」過於極端；銀行不能替服務商制定其內部應急計劃。
concepts.explanationEn: Elements of a service provider risk management program: risk assessments; due diligence and provider selection; contract provisions and considerations; incentive compensation review; oversight and monitoring; business continuity and contingency plans. Points: (1) review all publicly available audit reports of the provider; (2) avoid provider sales representatives compensated mainly by commissions on the bank's products (conflict of interest); (3) banning all third-party access to critical processes is impractical (compensating controls instead); (4) contingency planning should require the provider to maintain/participate, not be developed by the bank on its behalf; (5) contracts need audit rights, data security and exit provisions. Exam traps: outsourcing does not transfer regulatory responsibility; the bank cannot develop the provider's internal contingency process for it.

concepts.title: 網絡風險與網絡安全信息共享
concepts.titleEn: Cyber Risk and Cybersecurity Information Sharing
concepts.explanation: 網絡風險是操作風險的重要組成。網絡安全信息共享的五條渠道：(1) 銀行之間（peer banks）：通過既定渠道共享，使同業能及時應對相似威脅；(2) 銀行→監管者：限於監管報告要求的網絡事件；(3) 監管者之間：按強制或自願安排（境內與跨境）共享；(4) 監管者→銀行：澳、中、韓、土、美等已建立標準與實踐指引；(5) 與安全機構共享：網絡事件可能跨行業，及時溝通可提升整體防禦。考試陷阱：銀行→監管者的共享受限於監管報告要求；與安全機構共享的價值在於跨行業威脅感知。
concepts.explanationEn: Cyber risk is a major component of operational risk. Five channels of cybersecurity information sharing: (1) among banks — through established channels so peers can respond promptly to similar threats; (2) banks to regulators — generally limited to cyber-incidents required by regulatory reporting; (3) among regulators — domestic and cross-border, via mandatory or voluntary arrangements; (4) regulators to banks — countries such as Australia, China, Korea, Turkey and the US have issued standards and practices; (5) with security agencies — incidents may affect other sectors, so timely communication broadens awareness and defenses. Exam traps: bank-to-regulator sharing is constrained by reporting requirements; sharing with security agencies enhances cross-sector threat awareness.

concepts.title: 洗錢與資恐風險 (ML/FT) 管理
concepts.titleEn: Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (ML/FT) Risk Management
concepts.explanation: ML/FT風險管理最佳實踐：董事會與高管層建立合規文化；基於風險的客戶盡職調查（KYC/CDD，高風險客戶強化盡調EDD）；交易監控與可疑活動報告（SAR）；三道防線中一線負責識別、二線合規監督、內審獨立檢查；用USAA銀行等案例吸取教訓——控制與程序薄弱（如未及時報告可疑活動）會導致監管處罰。考試陷阱：合規職能屬第二道防線；風險為本（risk-based）而非一刀切；「加強對員工培訓」與「獨立測試AML程序」是典型正確選項。
concepts.explanationEn: ML/FT best practices: board and senior management set the compliance culture; risk-based customer due diligence (KYC/CDD with enhanced due diligence for higher-risk customers); transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting (SAR); within the 3LoD the first line identifies, compliance (second line) oversees, and internal audit independently tests. Cases such as USAA Bank show that weaknesses in controls and processes (e.g., late suspicious activity reporting) lead to regulatory fines. Exam traps: compliance sits in the second line; the approach is risk-based, not one-size-fits-all; 'strengthen training' and 'independently test AML procedures' are typical correct actions.

concepts.title: RAROC與最低回報率 (Hurdle Rate)
concepts.titleEn: RAROC and the Hurdle Rate
concepts.explanation: RAROC（風險調整後資本回報率）= 風險調整後回報 ÷ 經濟資本；風險調整後回報 = 收入 + 經濟資本回報 − 費用 − 預期損失（稅後則整體乘(1−稅率)）。決策準則：RAROC > 最低回報率（hurdle rate）→創造價值、接受；RAROC < hurdle →拒絕。多數公司對所有業務使用單一hurdle rate = 稅後加權平均股權資本成本（WACC）。RAROC用途：資本預算與績效評估、業務線配置資本、薪酬輸入；使管理層在風險與回報之間做有效權衡。考試陷阱：RAROC分子要減EL、加EC的無風險回報；hurdle用稅後；貸款定價題（如日元貸款）按上述要素逐項代入。
concepts.explanationEn: RAROC (risk-adjusted return on capital) = risk-adjusted return ÷ economic capital, where risk-adjusted return = revenues + return on EC − expenses − expected loss (after tax, multiply the whole numerator by (1−t)). Decision rule: RAROC > hurdle rate adds value and is accepted; RAROC < hurdle destroys value and is rejected. Most firms use a single hurdle for all activities: the after-tax weighted-average cost of equity capital. Uses: capital budgeting and performance evaluation, allocating capital across business lines, and input to compensation — enabling efficient risk-reward trade-offs. Exam traps: subtract EL and add the return on EC in the numerator; use the after-tax hurdle; loan-pricing problems plug each component in.

concepts.title: 調整後RAROC (Adjusted RAROC)
concepts.titleEn: Adjusted RAROC (ARAROC)
concepts.explanation: 普通RAROC的缺點：未調整業務的系統性風險（與市場組合的相關性）。調整後RAROC：ARAROC = RAROC − β×(E(R_M) − r_f)，即從RAROC中扣除按CAPM要求的超額回報（β×市場風險溢價）。決策準則：ARAROC > r_f →接受（項目創造價值）；ARAROC < r_f →拒絕。考試陷阱：比較基準是無風險利率r_f而不是E(R_M)；β越高扣減越多；例：RAROC=12%、β=1.6、市場回報10%、r_f=4% → ARAROC = 12% − 1.6×6% = 2.4% > 4%? 否→拒絕（注意計算結果與r_f比較）。
concepts.explanationEn: Plain RAROC ignores systematic risk (correlation with the market). Adjusted RAROC: ARAROC = RAROC − β×(E(R_M) − r_f), deducting the CAPM-required excess return (β times the market risk premium). Decision rule: accept if ARAROC > r_f (value-creating); reject if ARAROC < r_f. Exam traps: compare to the risk-free rate r_f, not E(R_M); higher β means a larger deduction; e.g., RAROC 12%, β 1.6, market 10%, r_f 4% → ARAROC = 12% − 1.6×6% = 2.4% < 4% → reject.

concepts.title: 應急可轉換債券 (CoCos)
concepts.titleEn: Contingent Convertible Bonds (CoCos)
concepts.explanation: CoCos在金融機構財務困難時自動轉換為股權。吸引力：(1) 對銀行——平常是債務、維持高ROE；困難時轉股、補充股本緩衝、避免破產；(2) 對監管——避免政府救助（bailout）。常見觸發條件：一級股權資本/RWA比率、股權市值/資產賬面值比率。風險：若在壓力時期觸發，轉股稀釋原股東；市場懷疑觸發可靠性時CoCo利差飆升。巴塞爾III下CoCo發行規模巨大（估計超1萬億美元）。考試陷阱：CoCo轉股對普通股股東是稀釋；「高CoCo發行量的破產銀行」案例指向觸發機制與資本質量問題。
concepts.explanationEn: CoCos automatically convert into equity when the institution experiences financial difficulty. Appeal: (1) for banks — debt in normal times (high ROE), converting in distress to replenish the equity cushion and avoid insolvency; (2) for regulators — avoiding bailouts. Popular triggers: the ratio of Tier 1 equity capital to RWAs and the ratio of the market value of equity to book assets. Risks: conversion dilutes existing shareholders precisely in stress; spreads spike when markets doubt the trigger. Under Basel III issuance was enormous (over USD 1 trillion estimated). Exam traps: conversion dilutes common shareholders; failed banks with heavy CoCo issuance point to trigger and capital-quality issues.

concepts.title: 巴塞爾協議演進：從Basel I到Basel III
concepts.titleEn: Evolution of the Basel Accords: Basel I to Basel III
concepts.explanation: Basel I（1988）：按資產類別給風險權重（現金/黃金/對OECD政府債權0%；對OECD銀行20%；住房抵押貸款50%；其他100%），總資本≥8% RWA。1996修正案：加入市場風險計提（MRC = max(VaR_{t−1}, m×60日均VaR) + SRC）。Basel II（三大支柱）：最低資本要求（信用+市場+操作）、監督審查、市場紀律；信用風險引入標準法與IRB。Basel 2.5：壓力VaR、增量風險計提IRC（交易賬簿信用產品一年期99.9%）、綜合風險度量CRM。Basel III：資本定義與要求提升（CET1≥4.5%、一級≥6%、總資本≥8%，加2.5%資本保存緩衝CCB後為7%/8.5%/10.5%）、0-2.5%逆周期緩衝、槓桿率、LCR/NSFR流動性規則、G-SIB附加資本；2017年12月修訂進一步完善標準化方法與輸出下限。考試陷阱：各項比例的具體數值；12.5=1/8%；CCB導致的緩衝疊加。
concepts.explanationEn: Basel I (1988): risk weights by asset class (cash/gold/claims on OECD governments 0%; OECD banks 20%; residential mortgages 50%; all other 100%), total capital ≥ 8% of RWA. The 1996 Amendment added the market risk charge (MRC = max(VaR_{t−1}, m×60-day average VaR) + SRC). Basel II: three pillars — minimum capital (credit, market, operational), supervisory review, market discipline; standardized and IRB approaches for credit. Basel 2.5: stressed VaR, the incremental risk charge (IRC, one-year 99.9% for credit-sensitive trading-book products), and the comprehensive risk measure. Basel III: stronger capital definitions and requirements (CET1 ≥ 4.5%, Tier 1 ≥ 6%, total ≥ 8%; with the 2.5% capital conservation buffer 7%/8.5%/10.5%), a 0-2.5% countercyclical buffer, the leverage ratio, LCR/NSFR liquidity rules, and G-SIB surcharges; the December 2017 revisions refined the standardized approach and output floor. Exam traps: memorize the ratios; 12.5 = 1/8%; buffers stack on top of minimums.

concepts.title: 資本充足流程 (CAP) 與資本計劃壓力測試
concepts.titleEn: Capital Adequacy Process (CAP) and Capital Plan Stress Testing
concepts.explanation: CAP組成：(1) 內部控制要求——董事會與高管對資本計劃流程的有力監督；(2) 風險識別流程——確保評估資本需求時涵蓋所有風險；(3) 管理層監督——建立融入整體風險管理的全面資本計劃流程；(4) 資本政策——資本目標與風險偏好、風險狀況及內外部利益相關者預期一致。宏觀審慎壓力測試演進：2009年SCAP（首次監督式、自上而下、公開結果）→DFAST/CCAR（年度、要求銀行自報與監管模型並行、資本行動計劃）。BHC應設計反映自身業務與脆弱性的企業級情景；使用第三方情景需按自身風險特徵調整。考試陷阱：「風險識別流程需涵蓋所有風險」是CAP要求，「強監督」屬於內部控制要求；SCAP的首創性在於公開結果與統一假設。
concepts.explanationEn: CAP components: (1) internal controls — strong board and senior management oversight of capital planning; (2) risk identification processes ensuring all risks are accounted for when assessing capital needs; (3) management oversight — a comprehensive capital planning process integrated into broader risk management; (4) capital policy — capital goals aligned with risk appetite, risk profile and stakeholder expectations. Macro-prudential stress testing evolution: the 2009 SCAP (first supervisory, top-down, results published) → DFAST/CCAR (annual; bank-provided projections run alongside supervisory models; capital action plans). BHCs should design firmwide scenarios reflecting their own business and vulnerabilities; vendor scenarios must be tailored. Exam traps: 'risk identification covers all risks' is a CAP requirement while 'strong oversight' is an internal-control requirement; SCAP's novelty was publishing results with common assumptions.

concepts.title: 經濟資本框架與最佳實踐
concepts.titleEn: Economic Capital Framework and Best Practices
concepts.explanation: 經濟資本（EC）是銀行在既定置信水平（如99.9%）與期限內覆蓋非預期損失所需的資本。經濟資本框架審查要點：(1) 治理——董事會與高管對EC方法的批准與監督、職責分離；(2) 方法論——覆蓋市場/信用/操作風險及聚合、參數與假設（如利率風險在銀行賬簿IRRBB的處理）有依據；(3) 驗證——獨立驗證假設與模型、定期回顧；(4) 應用——限額設定、業績評估（RAROC）、資本配置。銀行賬簿利率風險（IRRBB）建模假設（如存款行為、提前償還）需定期驗證。考試陷阱：EC不是監管資本；治理缺陷（缺乏董事會批准、模型假設未驗證）是內審關注的重點。
concepts.explanationEn: Economic capital (EC) is the capital a bank needs to cover unexpected losses at a stated confidence level (e.g., 99.9%) over a horizon. Framework review points: (1) governance — board/senior management approval and oversight, segregation of duties; (2) methodology — coverage of market/credit/operational risk and aggregation, justified parameters and assumptions (e.g., interest rate risk in the banking book, IRRBB); (3) validation — independent validation of assumptions and models with periodic review; (4) use — limit setting, performance measurement (RAROC), capital allocation. IRRBB modeling assumptions (deposit behavior, prepayments) require periodic validation. Exam traps: EC is not regulatory capital; governance deficiencies (unapproved models, unvalidated assumptions) are internal audit's focus.

concepts.title: Basel III槓桿率與緩衝資本
concepts.titleEn: Basel III Leverage Ratio and Capital Buffers
concepts.explanation: 槓桿率 = 一級資本 ÷ 總敞口（表內+表外，不做風險加權），要求≥3%，作為風險加權資本要求的後盾（backstop），防止模型低估風險；對G-SIB另有更高要求。資本保存緩衝（CCB）2.5%：突破緩衝會觸發利潤分配限制（分紅、回購、獎金受限）而非立即注資。逆周期緩衝（0-2.5%）：監管在信貸過快增長時期啟用。G-SIB附加資本按系統重要性分檔（1%-2.5%或更高）。考試陷阱：槓桿率分母是未加權總敞口；CCB的懲罰是分配限制；G-SIB附加與CCB、逆周期緩衝可以疊加。
concepts.explanationEn: The leverage ratio = Tier 1 capital ÷ total exposure (on- and off-balance-sheet, unweighted), required at ≥3% as a backstop to risk-weighted requirements, guarding against model understatement of risk; G-SIBs face higher requirements. The 2.5% capital conservation buffer (CCB): breaching it triggers restrictions on distributions (dividends, buybacks, bonuses) rather than immediate recapitalization. The countercyclical buffer (0-2.5%) is activated when credit grows too fast. G-SIB surcharges scale with systemic importance (1%-2.5% or more). Exam traps: the leverage-ratio denominator is unweighted total exposure; breaching the CCB restricts distributions; G-SIB add-ons stack with the CCB and countercyclical buffer.

formulas.name: 基本指標法 (BIA)
formulas.description: 中文：GI為近三年中為正的年度毛收入（取正年份平均），α=15%固定係數。最簡單但對風險敏感性最低。坑點：虧損年份毛收入取0後平均；不反映銀行控制環境改善。
formulas.descriptionEn: GI is the average positive annual gross income over three years (loss years contribute zero) and α = 15%. Simplest but least risk-sensitive. Pitfalls: zero out loss years before averaging; unresponsive to improved controls.

formulas.name: 標準化法 (TSA)
formulas.description: 中文：八條業務線各有β：公司金融18%、交易與銷售18%、零售銀行12%、商業銀行15%、支付與清算18%、代理服務15%、資產管理12%、零售經紀12%；每年各線β×毛收入加總（為負取0）後三年平均。坑點：max按年取而非按線取；β係數的記憶題很常見。
formulas.descriptionEn: Eight business lines carry betas: corporate finance 18%, trading & sales 18%, retail banking 12%, commercial banking 15%, payment & settlement 18%, agency services 15%, asset management 12%, retail brokerage 12%; per year sum β×GI by line (floored at zero), then average over three years. Pitfalls: the max is per year, not per line; beta recall questions are common.

formulas.name: 高級計量法 (AMA)
formulas.description: 中文：AMA用內部模型計量一年期99.9%置信水平的非預期損失作為操作風險資本，須綜合內部數據、相關外部數據、情景分析與業務環境及內部控制因素。坑點：99.9%與一年期是硬性要求；可認可風險緩釋（如保險）。
formulas.descriptionEn: AMA uses internal models to estimate one-year 99.9% unexpected loss as operational risk capital, combining internal data, relevant external data, scenario analysis, and business environment and internal control factors. Pitfalls: the 99.9% one-year horizon is mandatory; risk mitigation (e.g., insurance) may be recognized.

formulas.name: Basel III新標準化法 (SMA)
formulas.latex: $ORC = BIC \times ILM \quad;\quad ILM = \ln\!\left(e - 1 + \left(\frac{LC}{BIC}\right)^{0.8}\right) \quad;\quad LC = IL + EL$
formulas.description: 中文：BIC由業務指標BI分桶得出；ILM為內部損失乘數；LC為損失組成（非預期損失+預期損失，十年數據）。最大桶銀行ILM下限為1。坑點：ILM>1表示歷史損失相對偏高；小銀行ILM取1、資本=BIC。
formulas.descriptionEn: BIC comes from business indicator buckets; ILM is the internal loss multiplier; LC is the loss component (unexpected plus expected losses over ten years). For the largest bucket ILM is floored at 1. Pitfalls: ILM > 1 signals above-average historical losses; smaller banks set ILM = 1 so capital = BIC.

formulas.name: 損失分布法 (LDA) 年度損失合成
formulas.nameEn: Loss Distribution Approach (LDA) Annual Loss Composition
formulas.latex: $L_{year} = \sum_{i=1}^{N} X_i,\quad N \sim f_{freq},\; X_i \sim f_{sev},\; N \perp X$
formulas.description: 中文：N為年度損失事件次數（頻率分布），X_i為每次損失金額（強度分布），假設頻率與強度獨立、類別內i.i.d.，通過卷積或Monte Carlo得年度損失分布並取99.9%分位。坑點：尾部極偏需EVT與情景補充；獨立性假設是主要缺陷。
formulas.descriptionEn: N is the annual event count (frequency distribution) and X_i the severity of each loss; frequency and severity are assumed independent and i.i.d. within risk classes; convolution or Monte Carlo yields the annual loss distribution whose 99.9% quantile is the capital. Pitfalls: the extremely skewed tail needs EVT and scenario data; independence is the key flaw.

formulas.name: RAROC
formulas.latex: $RAROC = \frac{Revenues + Return\ on\ EC - Expenses - EL}{EC} \quad;\quad RAROC_{after\text{-}tax} = \frac{(Revenues - Expenses - EL + Return\ on\ EC)(1-t)}{EC}$
formulas.description: 中文：EC為經濟資本，EL為預期損失，t為稅率；Return on EC通常按無風險利率投資EC所得。與hurdle rate（稅後加權平均股權成本）比較決策。坑點：分子必須扣EL；稅後口徑與稅後hurdle比較；貸款題逐項代入（利息收入−資金成本−操作成本−EL±轉移成本）。
formulas.descriptionEn: EC is economic capital, EL expected loss, and t the tax rate; return on EC is typically the risk-free return on invested capital. Compare with the hurdle rate (after-tax weighted-average cost of equity capital). Pitfalls: subtract EL; compare after-tax figures; loan-pricing problems plug in each component (interest income − funding cost − operating cost − EL ± transfer costs).

formulas.name: 調整後RAROC (ARAROC)
formulas.latex: $ARAROC = RAROC - \beta\left(E(R_M) - r_f\right) \quad;\quad Accept\ if\ ARAROC > r_f$
formulas.description: 中文：β為業務的權益beta，E(R_M)為市場組合預期回報，r_f為無風險利率；從RAROC中扣除系統性風險要求的超額回報後與r_f比較。坑點：準則是與r_f比較（不是與E(R_M)）；例：12% − 1.6×(10%−4%) = 2.4% < 4% → 拒絕。
formulas.descriptionEn: β is the business's equity beta, E(R_M) the expected market return, and r_f the risk-free rate; deduct the systematic-risk-required excess return from RAROC and compare with r_f. Pitfalls: the benchmark is r_f, not E(R_M); e.g., 12% − 1.6×(10%−4%) = 2.4% < 4% → reject.

formulas.name: 最低回報率 (Hurdle Rate)
formulas.latex: $Hurdle\ Rate = WACC_{after\text{-}tax} = w_e k_e + w_d k_d (1-t)$
formulas.description: 中文：多數公司對所有業務採用單一hurdle rate＝稅後加權平均股權資本成本（實務常以稅後WACC近似）。RAROC>hurdle接受、<hurdle拒絕。坑點：題目常直接給hurdle（如10%）；稅後口徑要一致；「單一hurdle對所有業務」是其簡化特徵。
formulas.descriptionEn: Most firms use a single hurdle for all activities — the after-tax weighted-average cost of equity capital (often proxied by the after-tax WACC). Accept when RAROC > hurdle; reject when below. Pitfalls: problems often state the hurdle directly (e.g., 10%); keep after-tax consistency; a single hurdle for all businesses is its simplifying feature.

formulas.name: Basel II 最低資本要求
formulas.description: 中文：Basel II下總資本（一級+二級）須≥信用風險加權資產、市場風險計提×12.5與操作風險計提×12.5之和的8%；12.5是8%的倒數換算（把「資本計提」轉為「RWA當量」）。坑點：市場與操作風險計提按VaR類金額×12.5併入RWA；8%對應總資本比率。
formulas.descriptionEn: Total capital (Tier 1 + Tier 2) must be at least 8% of the sum of credit RWA, the market risk charge ×12.5, and the operational risk charge ×12.5; 12.5 is the reciprocal of 8%, converting a capital charge into RWA-equivalents. Pitfalls: market and operational charges enter as amounts ×12.5; the 8% applies to total capital.

formulas.name: Basel III 資本比例與緩衝
formulas.nameEn: Basel III Capital Ratios and Buffers
formulas.description: 中文：Basel III資本層級：普通股一級（CET1）≥4.5%、一級資本≥6%、總資本≥8%；加上2.5%資本保存緩衝後分別為7%、8.5%、10.5%；逆周期緩衝0-2.5%由監管視信貸週期啟用；G-SIB附加1%-2.5%+。坑點：數值記憶是常考點；緩衝突破時限制分配而非立即違規；緩衝可疊加。
formulas.descriptionEn: Basel III hierarchy: CET1 ≥ 4.5%, Tier 1 ≥ 6%, total ≥ 8%; with the 2.5% capital conservation buffer these become 7%, 8.5% and 10.5%; the countercyclical buffer (0-2.5%) is activated over the credit cycle; G-SIB surcharges run 1%-2.5%+. Pitfalls: memorize the numbers; breaching buffers restricts distributions rather than breaching minimums immediately; buffers stack.

formulas.name: Basel III 槓桿率
formulas.description: 中文：分母為未風險加權的總敞口（表內資產+表外敞口，經統一計量），作為風險加權資本要求的後盾。坑點：與風險加權比率不同——不做風險加權；G-SIB要求更高。
formulas.descriptionEn: The denominator is unweighted total exposure (on-balance-sheet assets plus off-balance-sheet exposures under a unified measure), serving as a backstop to risk-weighted requirements. Pitfalls: no risk weighting — unlike risk-weighted ratios; G-SIBs face higher requirements.

chapters.chapterName: 第四章 流動性與國庫風險計量與管理
chapters.chapterNameEn: Liquidity and Treasury Risk Measurement and Management
chapters.summary: 本章（權重15%）強調資產負債的模型化定量管理，內容廣且與實務結合緊密。主線包括：融資流動性與市場流動性的區分；流動性調整VaR（清算成本、買賣價差、壓力市場）；流動性轉移定價（LTP）；ALCO治理與銀行資金來源；巴塞爾III兩大流動性比率（LCR與NSFR）；央行工具（貼現窗口、公開市場操作、美元互換額度）與2007-09美元短缺危機；資產負債管理的缺口模型（利率敏感性缺口、久期缺口、槓桿調整久期缺口、淨利息差、資金邊際成本與有效成本率）；交易商銀行與回購融資；應急資金計劃（CFP）與早期預警指標（EWI）、流動性危機團隊等四個關鍵角色；流動性壓力測試；正/負反饋交易者與流動性黑洞；非流動性資產的回報偏差（平滑、生存偏差、樣本選擇偏差、不頻繁交易）與unsmoothing效果及其對組合配置的影響。考試常見陷阱：LCR分子分母的細節（流入上限75%）、NSFR方向、久期缺口與ΔE的符號、LVaR的兩種市場狀態公式、EWI的辨識（利差走闊是信號、獲得更多授信不是）。
chapters.summaryEn: This chapter (15% weight) emphasizes modeled, quantitative asset-liability management and closely reflects practice. Themes: funding versus market liquidity; liquidity-adjusted VaR (cost of liquidation, bid-offer spreads, stressed markets); liquidity transfer pricing (LTP); ALCO governance and bank funding sources; the Basel III liquidity ratios (LCR and NSFR); central bank tools (discount window, open market operations, dollar swap lines) and the 2007-09 U.S. dollar shortage; ALM gap models (interest-sensitive gap, duration gap, leverage-adjusted duration gap, net interest margin, marginal cost and effective cost of funds); dealer banks and repo financing; the contingency funding plan (CFP) with early warning indicators (EWIs), the liquidity crisis team and the four key roles; liquidity stress testing; positive/negative feedback traders and liquidity black holes; and illiquid-asset return biases (smoothing, survivorship, sample selection, infrequent trading), unsmoothing, and their portfolio-allocation implications. Exam traps: LCR mechanics (75% inflow cap), NSFR direction, the sign of ΔE with duration gaps, the two LVaR formulas, and EWI identification (widening spreads signal risk; increased credit lines do not).

concepts.title: 融資流動性與市場（資產）流動性
concepts.titleEn: Funding Liquidity vs. Market (Asset) Liquidity
concepts.explanation: 融資流動性（funding liquidity）：機構以合理成本及時獲得現金履行支付義務的能力，取決於資金來源的穩定性與期限結構。市場/資產流動性（market liquidity）：資產以接近公允價值的價格快速變現的能力，取決於買賣價差、市場深度、彈性。二者相互強化：危機中資產流動性下降→擔保品價值縮水→融資流動性惡化（流動性螺旋）。流動性風險的特殊性：流動性不足是很多銀行倒閉的直接原因（即使資本充足）；「流動性風險管理不當」往往先於償付能力問題爆發。考試陷阱：區分兩種流動性的定義與衡量；銀行insolvency（技術性資不抵債）≠failure（倒閉），流動性注入可救insolvency。
concepts.explanationEn: Funding liquidity: a firm's ability to raise cash at reasonable cost to meet obligations on time, driven by the stability and maturity structure of funding. Market liquidity: the ability to sell assets quickly near fair value, driven by bid-offer spreads, depth and resilience. They reinforce each other: falling market liquidity cuts collateral values and worsens funding liquidity (the liquidity spiral). Liquidity risk is special: illiquidity directly caused many bank failures even with adequate capital; insolvency (temporarily negative net worth) is not failure — a liquidity injection can cure it.

concepts.title: 清算成本與流動性調整VaR (LVaR)
concepts.titleEn: Cost of Liquidation and Liquidity-Adjusted VaR (LVaR)
concepts.explanation: 清算成本LC：正常市場 LC = 0.5×Σ α_i×s_i，其中α_i為第i項頭寸市值，s_i為比例買賣價差；壓力市場 LC = Σ 0.5×α_i×(μ_i + λσ_i)，μ_i、σ_i為價差的均值與標準差，λ對應價差的置信水平。LVaR = VaR + LC（把清算成本加到傳統VaR上）。要點：分散化降低市場風險但不必然降低流動性交易風險（多頭寸價差成本疊加）；壓力情形下價差走闊由λ刻畫。考試陷阱：0.5來自「中間價買賣各承擔一半價差」；正常市場用s、壓力市場用μ+λσ；LVaR總不小於VaR。
concepts.explanationEn: Cost of liquidation (LC): in normal markets LC = 0.5×Σ α_i×s_i with α_i the position value and s_i the proportional bid-offer spread; in stressed markets LC = Σ 0.5×α_i×(μ_i + λσ_i), where μ_i and σ_i are the spread's mean and standard deviation and λ the required confidence for the spread. LVaR = VaR + LC. Diversification reduces market risk but not necessarily liquidity trading costs (spreads add up across positions). Exam traps: the 0.5 reflects transacting at mid-market; use s in normal markets and μ+λσ under stress; LVaR ≥ VaR.

concepts.title: 比例買賣價差與流動性持續期
concepts.titleEn: Proportional Bid-Offer Spread and Liquidity Duration
concepts.explanation: 比例買賣價差 s = (offer − bid)/[(offer + bid)/2]，即價差除以中間價。流動性持續期（liquidity duration）LD_i = Q_i/(0.15×V_i)：在不衝擊市場的前提下按每日成交量的15%出售持倉所需天數，Q_i為持股數量、V_i為日均成交量；LD越大說明頭寸越難清算、應計提更高流動性成本。考試陷阱：s的分母是中間價（不是offer）；0.15是「每日可賣量占比」的慣例假設；LD與成交量成反比。
concepts.explanationEn: The proportional spread s = (offer − bid)/[(offer + bid)/2] divides the spread by the mid-price. Liquidity duration LD_i = Q_i/(0.15×V_i): days needed to liquidate a position of Q_i shares selling at most 15% of daily volume V_i without moving the market; larger LD means harder liquidation and a higher liquidity cost. Exam traps: the denominator is the mid-price, not the offer; 0.15 is the conventional daily-participation assumption; LD falls with volume.

concepts.title: 流動性轉移定價 (LTP)
concepts.titleEn: Liquidity Transfer Pricing (LTP)
concepts.explanation: LTP把流動性的成本、收益與風險分配給銀行內部各業務單位：向資金使用方（資產/貸款）收取流動性成本，向資金提供方（負債/存款）支付流動性收益，把流動性成本與收益匯集到集中管理的資金池（FTP池）。最佳實踐：轉移價格應反映銀行整體（as a whole）的成本、收益與風險；對或有負債（承諾授信額度、抵押品追加義務）的LTP應在放款前即計提（而非首次提款後）；長期資金最能降低流動性緩衝的真實成本；簡單的「平均資金池成本」法不夠精確。考試陷阱：「pooled average cost最準確」是錯誤說法；「或有負債只能在首筆提款後定價」是錯誤說法；「轉移價格反映全行成本收益風險」是正確說法。
concepts.explanationEn: LTP attributes the costs, benefits and risks of liquidity to business units: it charges liquidity users (assets/loans) for the cost of liquidity and credits providers (liabilities/deposits) for the benefit, pooling them centrally. Best practices: the transfer price should reflect the costs, benefits and risks of the bank as a whole; contingent obligations (committed lines, collateral calls) should be priced before any drawdown; long-term funding best reduces the true cost of the liquidity cushion; a pooled average-cost approach is not the most accurate formula. Exam traps: 'pooled average cost is most accurate' is wrong; 'contingent obligations priced only after first drawdown' is wrong; 'the transfer price reflects the whole bank' is correct.

concepts.title: ALCO與流動性治理
concepts.titleEn: ALCO and Liquidity Governance
concepts.explanation: 資產負債委員會（ALCO）職責：制定、審查並批准流動性壓力測試政策；建議並批准流動性風險情景（含重大變更）；依壓力測試結果設定流動性限額並上報例外。流動性風險偏好由董事會批准，ALCO在偏好框架內管理。治理鏈條：董事會→風險委員會→ALCO→國庫（執行）→內審（獨立檢查）。考試陷阱：ALCO是「管理層委員會」，最終偏好由董事會定；壓力測試政策與限額的批准權在ALCO層面。
concepts.explanationEn: The asset-liability committee (ALCO): establishes, reviews and approves the liquidity stress testing policy; suggests and approves liquidity risk scenarios (including major changes to scenarios and assumptions); sets liquidity risk limits dependent on stress-test outcomes and escalates exceptions. The board approves the liquidity risk appetite and ALCO manages within it. Chain: board → risk committee → ALCO → treasury (execution) → internal audit (independent review). Exam traps: ALCO is a management committee; final appetite rests with the board; approval of the stress-testing policy and limits sits with ALCO.

concepts.title: 銀行資金來源與資金穩定性
concepts.titleEn: Bank Funding Sources and Funding Stability
concepts.explanation: 資金來源：核心存款（core deposits，零售活期與儲蓄，最穩定、成本最低）、大額存單（CD）、同業拆借與回購（批發融資，敏感、易流失）、長期債券與股權。穩定性排序：零售核心存款 > 批發無擔保 > 有擔保（回購，受擔保品折價與市場情緒影響）。存款保險增強零售存款穩定性但帶來道德風險。分數準備金銀行（fractional reserve）以短期負債支持長期資產，天然存在期限錯配。大額存單等非存款負債的有效成本需計入非利息成本。考試陷阱：批發資金在壓力期最先流失；「穩定負債支持的快速資產增長」不是流動性風險信號，而「波動負債支持的快速增長」是。
concepts.explanationEn: Funding sources: core deposits (retail demand and savings — most stable, cheapest), certificates of deposit, interbank borrowing and repos (wholesale funding — flighty), and longer-term debt and equity. Stability ranking: retail core deposits > unsecured wholesale > secured (repo, exposed to haircuts and sentiment). Deposit insurance stabilizes retail funding but creates moral hazard. Fractional-reserve banking funds long-term assets with short-term liabilities — inherent maturity mismatch. Effective costs of nondeposit liabilities include noninterest costs. Exam traps: wholesale funding flees first in stress; rapid asset growth funded by stable liabilities is not a warning sign, growth funded by volatile liabilities is.

concepts.title: 流動性覆蓋比率 (LCR)
concepts.titleEn: Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR)
concepts.explanation: LCR = 優質流動性資產（HQLA）÷ 未來30天淨現金流出 ≥ 100%，針對短期壓力（30天）生存能力。淨流出 = 總流出 − min(總流入, 75%×總流出)：流入最多只能抵扣75%的流出，防止銀行完全依賴流入。HQLA分Level 1（現金、央行準備、主權債，無折價）與Level 2（高評級公司債、部分MBS，有折價且上限40%）。壓力假設含零售存款流失率、批發融資流失、承諾額度提取等。考試陷阱：75%流入上限是必考細節；HQLA須無變現障礙；LCR衡量的是30天壓力、NSFR衡量的是一年期結構。
concepts.explanationEn: LCR = high-quality liquid assets (HQLA) ÷ net cash outflows over 30 days ≥ 100%, targeting short-term survival under stress. Net outflows = total outflows − min(total inflows, 75% of outflows): inflows can offset at most 75% of outflows, preventing full reliance on inflows. HQLA splits into Level 1 (cash, central bank reserves, sovereigns — no haircut) and Level 2 (high-grade corporates, some MBS — haircuts and a 40% cap). Stress assumptions include retail run-off rates, wholesale outflows and committed-line drawdowns. Exam traps: the 75% inflow cap is a favorite; HQLA must be unencumbered; LCR covers a 30-day stress while NSFR covers a one-year structure.

concepts.title: 淨穩定資金比率 (NSFR)
concepts.titleEn: Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR)
concepts.explanation: NSFR = 可用穩定資金（ASF）÷ 所需穩定資金（RSF）≥ 100%，衡量一年期限的結構性流動性：ASF按負債與資本的穩定性賦係數（資本100%、零售存款高係數、批發短期融資低係數）；RSF按資產的流動性賦係數（現金低、貸款中等、難變現資產高）。NSFR引導銀行以長期穩定資金支持長期資產。LCR與NSFR互補：LCR管30天衝擊、NSFR管長期結構。考試陷阱：ASF/RSF的歸屬（負債端→ASF、資產端→RSF）；比率≥100%的要求方向；NSFR不是現金流指標而是結構指標。
concepts.explanationEn: NSFR = available stable funding (ASF) ÷ required stable funding (RSF) ≥ 100%, measuring one-year structural liquidity: ASF factors liabilities and capital by stability (capital 100%, retail deposits high, short-term wholesale low); RSF factors assets by liquidity (cash low, loans medium, illiquid assets high). NSFR pushes banks to fund long-term assets with stable long-term funding. LCR and NSFR complement: 30-day stress vs one-year structure. Exam traps: ASF is the liability/capital side and RSF the asset side; the ratio must be ≥ 100%; NSFR is structural, not a cash-flow measure.

concepts.title: 央行工具與最後貸款人
concepts.titleEn: Central Bank Tools and the Lender of Last Resort
concepts.explanation: 央行流動性工具：貼現窗口（discount window，以合格擔保品向存款機構放貸）、公開市場操作（OMO，買賣證券調節準備金）、常備/定期便利、準備金要求、以及美元流動性互換額度（swap lines，外國央行以本幣換美元再貸給本國銀行）。針對美元短缺的措施：擴大互換額度規模與期限、降低利率、允許更廣泛擔保品。央行是insolvency（暫時資不抵債）銀行的「最後救命稻草」，但對failure（徹底失敗）無能為力。考試陷阱：互換額度的機制（外國央行承擔本國銀行的信用風險）；貼現窗口有擔保要求與污名效應（stigma）。
concepts.explanationEn: Central bank liquidity tools: the discount window (lending to depositories against eligible collateral), open market operations (buying/selling securities to adjust reserves), standing/term facilities, reserve requirements, and U.S. dollar swap lines (foreign central banks exchange their currency for dollars and lend to domestic banks). Responses to dollar shortages: larger and longer swap lines, lower pricing, broader collateral. The central bank is the last resort for insolvent-but-liquid banks, not for failed ones. Exam traps: swap-line mechanics (the foreign central bank bears its banks' credit risk); the discount window requires collateral and suffers from stigma.

concepts.title: 2007-09美元短缺危機的成因
concepts.titleEn: Causes of the 2007-2009 U.S. Dollar Shortage
concepts.explanation: 成因：(1) 銀行美元資產與負債的期限錯配及資金缺口擴大，短期融資中斷、通過貨幣互換獲取美元困難；(2) 貨幣市場撤出銀行發行的票據，央行同時大量撤出美元外匯儲備；(3) 美元資產到期需續接，但銀行難以在不虧損的情況下出售流動性差的美元資產（含結構化產品），資產持有期拉長而融資期限縮短，形成美元資金缺口；(4) 真實缺口規模難以估計——若銀行實際滾續融資，缺口會被資產減記金額低估。應對：美聯儲擴大互換額度等。考試陷阱：缺口估計的偏差方向（滾續假設下低估）；危機中「資產持有期延長+融資期限縮短」的組合。
concepts.explanationEn: Causes: (1) maturity mismatch between banks' dollar assets and liabilities and a rising funding gap, disrupting short-term funding and making dollars via currency swaps hard to obtain; (2) money markets withdrawing from bank-issued paper while central banks drew down sizable dollar FX reserves; (3) as dollar assets matured, banks could not sell less-liquid dollar assets (including structured products) without significant losses, lengthening asset holding periods while funding maturities shortened — a dollar funding gap; (4) the true gap is hard to measure — assuming banks rolled over positions, the gap is underestimated by asset write-downs. Responses included expanded Fed swap lines. Exam traps: the direction of the estimation bias; the combination of longer asset holding and shorter funding.

concepts.title: 利率敏感性缺口 (Interest-Sensitive Gap)
concepts.titleEn: Interest-Sensitive Gap (ISG)
concepts.explanation: 利率敏感性資產（ISA）與負債（ISL）指在既定時間窗內會重新定價的資產/負債。缺口 = ISA − ISL：正缺口（資產多）時利率上升有利於淨利息收入、下降不利；負缺口相反。若管理層認為利率風險暴露過大，會盡量使同期間可重定價的資產與負債規模匹配（缺口≈0）。對淨利息收入的影響：ΔNII ≈ 缺口 × Δ利率。考試陷阱：先判斷缺口方向再判斷利率變動方向對NII的影響；缺口是金額概念、久期缺口是時間加權概念。
concepts.explanationEn: Interest-sensitive assets (ISA) and liabilities (ISL) reprice within a given window. The gap = ISA − ISL: a positive gap (more assets) benefits net interest income when rates rise and hurts when rates fall; a negative gap the reverse. Managers worried about rate exposure match the volume of repricing assets and liabilities over the same window (gap ≈ 0). Impact on income: ΔNII ≈ gap × Δrate. Exam traps: first identify the gap's sign, then the rate direction; the ISG is a dollar concept, the duration gap a time-weighted one.

concepts.title: 久期缺口與槓桿調整久期缺口
concepts.titleEn: Duration Gap and Leverage-Adjusted Duration Gap
concepts.explanation: 完全對沖利率波動要求美元加權資產久期 ≈ 美元加權負債久期，即久期缺口（D_A − D_L）接近0。由於資產規模通常大於負債（否則破產），須對槓桿調整：槓桿調整久期缺口 DGAP = D_A − D_L×(L/A)。經濟價值變動 ΔE = −DGAP×A×ΔR/(1+R)：DGAP>0時利率上升侵蝕淨值。管理策略：預期利率上升且DGAP>0→縮短資產久期/延長負債久期。投資期限策略（investment maturity strategy）依利率預期與資金狀況選擇：階梯式（laddered）、前置（front-loaded）、後置（back-loaded）、槓鈴（barbell）。考試陷阱：DGAP公式中負債項要乘L/A；ΔE與ΔR、DGAP的符號關係；「資產規模>負債規模」是槓桿調整的原因。
concepts.explanationEn: Full hedging requires dollar-weighted asset duration ≈ dollar-weighted liability duration, i.e., a duration gap (D_A − D_L) near zero. Since assets usually exceed liabilities (otherwise insolvent), adjust for leverage: DGAP = D_A − D_L×(L/A). The change in economic value ΔE = −DGAP×A×ΔR/(1+R): with DGAP>0, rising rates erode net worth. Strategy: expecting higher rates with DGAP>0 → shorten asset duration/lengthen liability duration. Investment maturity strategies (laddered, front-loaded, back-loaded, barbell) are chosen by rate expectations and balance-sheet conditions. Exam traps: multiply the liability term by L/A; the signs of ΔE with ΔR and DGAP; assets exceed liabilities, motivating the leverage adjustment.

concepts.title: 淨利息差 (NIM)
concepts.titleEn: Net Interest Margin (NIM)
concepts.explanation: NIM = (貸款與投資利息收入 − 存款與其他借款利息支出) ÷ 總盈利資產。衡量銀行資產負債管理創造利差的能力；受缺口結構、利率水平與競爭影響。存款保險與監管影響負債成本；資產質量影響利息收入。考試陷阱：分母是「盈利資產」不是總資產；NIM是比率而非金額；缺口正負與利率方向共同決定NIM變化。
concepts.explanationEn: NIM = (interest income from loans and investments − interest expense on deposits and other borrowed funds) ÷ total earning assets. It measures the spread-generation ability of ALM and depends on gap structure, rate levels and competition. Exam traps: the denominator is earning assets, not total assets; NIM is a ratio; the gap sign and rate direction jointly drive NIM changes.

concepts.title: 資金邊際成本與有效成本率
concepts.titleEn: Marginal Cost and Effective Cost Rate of Funds
concepts.explanation: 邊際成本 = 總成本變化 = 新利率×新利率下籌集的資金 − 舊利率×舊利率下籌集的資金；邊際成本率 = 總成本變化 ÷ 新增籌資額。用於決定「是否再籌一單位資金」（當邊際成本低於新資產預期回報時籌資有利）。有效成本率（存款與非存款來源）=（當前借入資金利息成本 + 獲取資金的非利息成本）÷ 該來源淨可投資資金。非利息成本（廣告、人員、存款保險費）使有效成本高於票面利率。考試陷阱：淨可投資資金要扣除法定準備金與浮存；比較的是「新增」資金成本而非平均成本。
concepts.explanationEn: Marginal cost = change in total cost = new rate × funds raised at the new rate − old rate × funds raised at the old rate; the marginal cost rate = change in total cost ÷ additional funds raised. It governs whether to raise one more unit of funds (raise when the marginal cost is below the expected return on new assets). The effective cost rate (deposit and nondeposit sources) = (current interest cost on amounts borrowed + noninterest costs incurred to access these funds) ÷ net investable funds raised. Noninterest costs (advertising, staff, deposit insurance) push the effective rate above the stated rate. Exam traps: net investable funds deduct required reserves and float; compare marginal, not average, costs.

concepts.title: 交易商銀行與回購融資
concepts.titleEn: Dealer Banks and Repo Financing
concepts.explanation: 交易商銀行（dealer banks）主要業務：做市（證券與衍生品）、承銷、回購融資（repo）、證券借貸、場外衍生品交易。主要風險：回購市場擠兌（擔保品折價上升、期限縮短）、擔保品價值下跌、交易對手風險、流動性螺旋。危機教訓（Bear Stearns、Lehman）：批發回購融資可在數日內枯竭，交易商需高質量流動性緩衝與CFP。考試陷阱：回購=賣出+約定買回（本質為擔保借款）；折價（haircut）上升等同融資能力下降；交易商的「日內流動性」管理很關鍵。
concepts.explanationEn: Dealer banks' main businesses: market making (securities and derivatives), underwriting, repo financing, securities lending, and OTC derivatives. Key risks: repo runs (rising haircuts, shortened maturities), collateral value declines, counterparty risk and liquidity spirals. Crisis lessons (Bear Stearns, Lehman): wholesale repo funding can evaporate within days, so dealers need high-quality liquidity buffers and a CFP. Exam traps: a repo is a sale plus agreed repurchase (a collateralized loan); higher haircuts mean less funding capacity; intraday liquidity management matters for dealers.

concepts.title: 應急資金計劃 (CFP)
concepts.titleEn: Contingency Funding Plan (CFP)
concepts.explanation: CFP是應對極端流動性壓力（高嚴重性、低頻率事件）的預案：明確觸發機制（限額與升級層級）、可用應急資金來源（變現資產、回購、央行便利）、決策權與溝通流程。CFP與流動性壓力測試的關係：壓力測試結果是CFP的輸入；二者通過限額結構（limits）與升級水平（escalation levels）聯動；正常時期的流動性風險計量是制定早期預警指標（EWI）的基線。有效CFP的關鍵組成：治理與角色、觸發器與升級、應急資金來源清單及可行性、溝通計劃、定期測試與更新。考試陷阱：CFP用於高嚴重性低頻率事件（不是高頻）；「通過限額結構與壓力測試聯動」是正確表述；「壓力時期計量作為EWI基線」是錯誤表述（應為正常時期）。
concepts.explanationEn: A CFP is the plan for extreme liquidity stress (high-severity, low-frequency events): triggers (limits and escalation levels), available contingent funding sources (asset sales, repos, central bank facilities), decision rights and communication. Link to liquidity stress testing: stress results are inputs to the CFP; the two connect through limit structures and escalation levels; liquidity measures from normal times are the baseline for developing early warning indicators (EWIs). Key CFP components: governance and roles, triggers and escalation, a vetted inventory of contingent funding sources, communication plans, and periodic testing and updating. Exam traps: CFPs address high-severity low-frequency events; 'linked through limit structures' is correct; 'measures from stressed times are the EWI baseline' is wrong (normal times).

concepts.title: 早期預警指標 (EWI)
concepts.titleEn: Early Warning Indicators (EWI)
concepts.explanation: 典型EWI：貸款方減少融資供給；發行長期債務的條件更苛刻；即將到來的監管變化；CAMELS評級下調；固定收益與互換產品利差走闊；股價下跌（自身相對同業）；正常市場條件下借款利率升高；組合經理與基金存款減少；保證金要求提高。判斷原則：反映「市場對本行信心的喪失」與「融資可得性下降」的指標才是強信號。考試陷阱：同業股價下跌但本行沒跌、獲得更多授信額度、以穩定負債支持的資產增長都不是流動性風險信號；本行債務與CDS利差走闊是最強信號之一。
concepts.explanationEn: Typical EWIs: reduced financing from lenders; more stringent terms to issue long-term debt; forthcoming regulatory changes; CAMELS downgrades; widening spreads on fixed income and swap products; falling stock prices (own shares relative to peers); higher borrowing rates in normal conditions; reduced deposits by portfolio managers and funds; higher margin requirements. The principle: strong signals reflect lost market confidence in the bank and reduced funding availability. Exam traps: peers' stock falling while own shares do not, increased credit lines, and asset growth funded by stable liabilities are NOT liquidity warning signals; widening own debt and CDS spreads is among the strongest.

concepts.title: 流動性治理的四個關鍵角色
concepts.titleEn: The Four Key Roles in Liquidity Governance
concepts.explanation: (1) 公司國庫（corporate treasury）：日常對風險、資金與流動性的監督角色；基於微觀/宏觀分析與壓力測試結果，必要時啟動CFP並召集流動性危機團隊；(2) 流動性危機團隊（LCT）：協調與溝通（對內對外利益相關者），持續監測流動性；成員含高管、業務負責人等；與國庫及管理委員會共同就CFP實施提供建議；(3) 管理委員會（management committee）：由高管組成，危機期管理LCT，與董事會溝通、分析流動性、批准CFP實施建議；(4) 董事會：危機中為LCT與管理委員會提供領導；熟悉CFP的董事最能就實施提供建議。考試陷阱：角色分工——國庫是日常監測、LCT是危機協調、管理委員會批准、董事會領導。
concepts.explanationEn: (1) Corporate treasury: day-to-day oversight of risk, funding and liquidity; may activate the CFP and convene the liquidity crisis team based on macro/micro analysis and stress-test results. (2) Liquidity crisis team (LCT): general coordination and communication with internal and external stakeholders plus ongoing liquidity monitoring; members include executives and business-unit leaders; suggests CFP implementation with treasury and the management committee. (3) Management committee: senior management; manages the LCT in crisis, liaises with the board, analyzes liquidity, and approves CFP implementation recommendations. (4) Board of directors: provides leadership to the LCT and management committee during a crisis; board members versed in the CFP advise best. Exam traps: allocate roles — treasury monitors daily, the LCT coordinates in crisis, the committee approves, the board leads.

concepts.title: 流動性壓力測試
concepts.titleEn: Liquidity Stress Testing
concepts.explanation: 流動性壓力測試估計壓力情形下的現金流缺口：情景分機構特定（機構自身評級下調、存款流失、額度被提取）與市場整體（利率衝擊、市場冻结）；期限從日內、30天到一年以上；輸出為現金流缺口與存活天數，並據此設定限額與緩衝。壓力測試須定期執行、假設更新，並與CFP、EWI聯動。ALCO批准情景與政策、設定限額。考試陷阱：壓力測試是「事前」工具，結果支撐限額設定與CFP；機構特定與市場情景須同時考慮（疊加壓力）。
concepts.explanationEn: Liquidity stress testing estimates cash-flow gaps under stress: scenarios are institution-specific (own downgrade, deposit run-off, line drawdowns) and market-wide (rate shocks, market freezes); horizons span intraday, 30 days and beyond one year; outputs are cash-flow gaps and survival days, feeding limits and buffers. Tests must be run regularly with updated assumptions and linked to the CFP and EWIs; ALCO approves scenarios and policies and sets limits. Exam traps: stress testing is ex-ante and underpins limits and the CFP; consider institution-specific and market scenarios together (combined stress).

concepts.title: 正/負反饋交易者與流動性黑洞
concepts.titleEn: Positive/Negative Feedback Traders and Liquidity Black Holes
concepts.explanation: 負反饋交易者（negative feedback traders）：跌時買、漲時賣，把價格拉回合理水平，其主導時市場流動性好；正反饋交易者（positive feedback traders，趨勢追蹤、止損、追加保證金）：跌時賣、漲時買，主導時價格不穩定、市場單邊化並失去流動性——形成流動性黑洞（liquidity black hole）。監管者（如以風險加權資本要求的順周期性）與一致性行為（追逐同一基準）會放大正反饋。監測流動性黑洞的指標：價差、成交量、換手率、波動率與市場深度的突變。考試陷阱：負反饋穩定市場、正反饋破壞市場；「監管資本規則的順周期性」會加劇流動性黑洞；基準化的投資行為使交易同向。
concepts.explanationEn: Negative feedback traders buy when prices fall and sell when they rise, restoring reasonable prices — their dominance keeps markets liquid. Positive feedback traders (trend followers, stop-losses, margin calls) sell on falls and buy on rises; when they dominate, prices become unstable, markets one-sided and illiquid — a liquidity black hole. Procyclical regulation (risk-weighted capital) and herding around benchmarks amplify the feedback. Indicators to monitor: sudden changes in spreads, volume, turnover, volatility and depth. Exam traps: negative feedback stabilizes, positive feedback destabilizes; procyclical capital rules worsen black holes; benchmarked investing makes trades one-directional.

concepts.title: 非流動性資產的回報偏差與Unsmoothing
concepts.titleEn: Illiquid Asset Return Biases and Unsmoothing
concepts.explanation: 三大偏差：(1) 生存偏差（survivorship bias）：表現差的基金停止報告或清盤，導致回報被高估；(2) 樣本選擇偏差（sample selection bias）：資產（如房地產）多在高價時交易、回報按高價計算，回報被高估；(3) 不頻繁交易（infrequent trading）：估值滯後（stale prices），使波動率、Beta與相關性被低估。平滑回報（smoothing，如房地產估值）同樣低估風險。Unsmoothing（去平滑）：r*_t = (r_t − ρ·r_{t−1})/(1−ρ)，恢復真實波動與相關性（效果：波動率與相關性上升、與上市資產相關性上修）。考試陷阱：私募基金因業績差退出報告→生存偏差；unsmoothing提高測得的波動率與相關性；不頻繁交易低估風險（不是高估）。
concepts.explanationEn: Three biases: (1) survivorship bias — poor funds stop reporting or fail, overstating returns; (2) sample selection bias — assets like real estate trade when values are high, overstating returns; (3) infrequent trading — stale valuations understate volatility, betas and correlations. Smoothed reported returns (e.g., appraised real estate) do the same. Unsmoothing: r*_t = (r_t − ρ·r_{t−1})/(1−ρ), restoring true risk (higher volatility and correlations with traded assets). Exam traps: a fund quitting reporting after poor returns is survivorship bias; unsmoothing raises measured volatility and correlations; infrequent trading understates risk.

concepts.title: 非流動性資產的組合配置影響
concepts.titleEn: Impact of Allocating Illiquid Assets to a Portfolio
concepts.explanation: 把非流動資產納入組合的影響：(1) 表面分散化收益（報告相關性低）因不頻繁交易被誇大，真實相關性更高；(2) 再平衡成本高——流動性差使機械再平衡困難、成本高，需更寬的再平衡區間；(3) 交易成本高（長鎖定期、較寬價差）侵蝕淨回報；(4) 最優配置比例應在計入上述流動性成本與風險低估修正後確定，通常低於僅看均值-方差的結果；(5) unsmoothing後波動率上修會降低配置吸引力。考試陷阱：報告相關性低估真實相關性；鎖定期妨礙再平衡；「高報告收益+低報告波動」的表面優勢部分是偏差。
concepts.explanationEn: Allocating to illiquid assets: (1) apparent diversification (low reported correlations) is overstated by infrequent trading — true correlations are higher; (2) rebalancing is costly and hard, requiring wider rebalancing bands; (3) high transaction costs (lock-ups, wide spreads) erode net returns; (4) the optimal allocation should account for liquidity costs and bias corrections and is typically below the naive mean-variance answer; (5) unsmoothing raises measured volatility and reduces appeal. Exam traps: reported correlations understate true ones; lock-ups impede rebalancing; attractive reported risk-return partly reflects bias.

concepts.title: 銀行投資組合與投資期限策略
concepts.titleEn: Bank Investment Portfolio and Maturity Strategies
concepts.explanation: 銀行國庫管理投資組合（流動性緩衝）：權衡收益、流動性與利率風險。投資期限策略依資產負債狀況與經濟條件選擇：(1) 階梯式（laddered）：到期日均勻分布，流動性穩定、利率風險分散；(2) 前置（front-loaded）：多投短期，適合預期利率上升或流動性需求大；(3) 後置（back-loaded）：多投長期，適合預期利率下降、鎖定收益；(4) 槓鈴（barbell）：短長兩端，兼顧流動性與收益。選擇還受資金來源穩定性（高利率風險、負債敏感→偏短期）影響。考試陷阱：預期利率上升→縮短組合久期（前置/階梯）；負債對利率敏感且資產不敏感時也應縮短資產期限；流動性需求高→保留更多短期資產。
concepts.explanationEn: Treasury manages the investment portfolio (liquidity buffer), trading off return, liquidity and rate risk. Maturity strategies by balance-sheet condition and economic outlook: (1) laddered — evenly spaced maturities, stable liquidity, diversified rate risk; (2) front-loaded — mostly short maturities, suited to rising rate expectations or high liquidity needs; (3) back-loaded — mostly long maturities to lock in yields when rates are expected to fall; (4) barbell — short and long ends, balancing liquidity and yield. Funding stability also matters (high liability rate sensitivity → shorter assets). Exam traps: expecting higher rates → shorten duration (front-loaded/laddered); liability-sensitive balance sheets also argue for shorter assets; high liquidity needs → keep more short assets.

formulas.name: 清算成本 (Cost of Liquidation)
formulas.description: 中文：α_i為第i項資產（組合）市值，s_i為正常市場下第i項的比例買賣價差；壓力市場用價差均值μ_i加λ倍標準差σ_i（λ為價差置信水平）。0.5表示以中間價成交、買賣各承擔一半價差。坑點：分散化降低市場風險但不降低價差成本總和；λ越大壓力清算成本越高。
formulas.descriptionEn: α_i is the value of position i and s_i its proportional bid-offer spread in normal markets; under stress use the spread mean μ_i plus λ standard deviations (λ the required confidence for the spread). The 0.5 reflects transacting at mid-market. Pitfalls: diversification does not reduce the sum of spread costs; higher λ raises stressed liquidation cost.

formulas.name: 流動性調整VaR (LVaR)
formulas.description: 中文：LVaR = 傳統VaR + 清算成本LC（正常或壓力市場口徑對應F057的兩種LC）。坑點：LVaR總≥VaR；壓力市場下LVaR隨λ上升；題目常要求把兩部分分別算出再相加。
formulas.descriptionEn: LVaR = conventional VaR + LC (normal or stressed market version per F057). Pitfalls: LVaR ≥ VaR; stressed LVaR rises with λ; problems often require computing the two parts separately then adding.

formulas.name: 比例買賣價差與流動性持續期
formulas.description: 中文：s為以中間價標準化的價差；LD_i為按每日成交量15%清倉Q_i股所需天數，V_i為日均成交量。坑點：分母是中間價；LD越大流動性越差；0.15是慣例參與率假設。
formulas.descriptionEn: s is the spread normalized by the mid-price; LD_i is the days needed to liquidate Q_i shares selling at most 15% of daily volume V_i. Pitfalls: the denominator is the mid-price; larger LD means worse liquidity; 0.15 is the conventional participation rate.

formulas.name: 流動性覆蓋比率 (LCR)
formulas.description: 中文：HQLA為優質流動性資產（Level 1無折價、Level 2有折價且≤40%）；30天淨流出中流入最多抵75%的流出。坑點：75%上限是必考點；HQLA須無變現障礙且未質押；零售/批發流失率按監管壓力係數。
formulas.descriptionEn: HQLA comprises Level 1 (no haircut) and Level 2 assets (haircuts, ≤40% cap); inflows offset at most 75% of 30-day outflows. Pitfalls: the 75% cap is frequently tested; HQLA must be unencumbered; run-off rates follow supervisory stress factors.

formulas.name: 淨穩定資金比率 (NSFR)
formulas.description: 中文：ASF按負債與資本的穩定性賦權（資本100%、零售存款高、短期批發低）；RSF按資產流動性賦權（現金低、貸款中、難變現資產高）。衡量一年期結構性流動性。坑點：方向——ASF在分子（負債端）、RSF在分母（資產端）；NSFR與LCR互補（30天vs一年）。
formulas.descriptionEn: ASF weights liabilities and capital by stability (capital 100%, retail deposits high, short-term wholesale low); RSF weights assets by liquidity (cash low, loans medium, illiquid assets high). Measures one-year structural liquidity. Pitfalls: ASF sits in the numerator (liability side) and RSF in the denominator (asset side); NSFR complements the LCR (30 days vs one year).

formulas.name: 利率敏感性缺口與淨利息收入變動
formulas.nameEn: Interest-Sensitive Gap and Change in Net Interest Income
formulas.description: 中文：ISA/ISL為既定期間內可重定價的資產/負債金額；正缺口下利率上升增加NII、下降減少NII。坑點：先定缺口符號再定利率方向；缺口按時間窗分檔（1個月、3個月等）。
formulas.descriptionEn: ISA/ISL are the volumes of assets/liabilities repricing within the window; with a positive gap, higher rates raise NII and lower rates reduce it. Pitfalls: determine the gap sign first, then the rate direction; gaps are banded by time window (1 month, 3 months, etc.).

formulas.name: 槓桿調整久期缺口
formulas.description: 中文：D_A、D_L為美元加權資產/負債久期，L/A為負債佔資產比例。DGAP≈0時經濟價值對利率變動近似免疫。坑點：負債久期必須乘L/A；因資產>負債才需槓桿調整。
formulas.descriptionEn: D_A and D_L are dollar-weighted asset/liability durations and L/A the liabilities-to-assets ratio; DGAP ≈ 0 immunizes economic value approximately. Pitfalls: multiply the liability duration by L/A; the leverage adjustment exists because assets exceed liabilities.

formulas.name: 經濟價值變動 (ΔE)
formulas.description: 中文：ΔE為淨值（資產−負債）的變動；DGAP>0且利率上升→ΔE<0（淨值受損）。坑點：負號來自債券價格與利率的反向關係；R為當前收益率水平；多期變動可近似疊加。
formulas.descriptionEn: ΔE is the change in net worth (assets − liabilities); with DGAP > 0 and rising rates, ΔE < 0. Pitfalls: the negative sign reflects the inverse price-rate relation; R is the prevailing yield; changes across rate scenarios approximate additively.

formulas.name: 淨利息差 (NIM)
formulas.latex: $NIM = \frac{\text{Interest income from loans and investments} - \text{Interest expense on deposits and other borrowed funds}}{Total\ Earning\ Assets}$
formulas.description: 中文：衡量盈利資產創造淨利差的能力。坑點：分母是總盈利資產（earning assets）而非總資產；缺口、利率週期與資產質量共同決定NIM。
formulas.descriptionEn: Measures the net spread generated on earning assets. Pitfalls: the denominator is total earning assets, not total assets; the gap, rate cycle and asset quality jointly drive NIM.

formulas.name: 資金邊際成本與邊際成本率
formulas.nameEn: Marginal Cost and Marginal Cost Rate of Funds
formulas.latex: $MC = r_{new}\times F_{new} - r_{old}\times F_{old} \quad;\quad MCR = \frac{\Delta Total\ Cost}{Additional\ Funds\ Raised}$
formulas.description: 中文：MC為總成本變化（新利率×新籌集額−舊利率×舊籌集額）；MCR為單位新增資金的成本，與新資產預期回報比較決定是否擴張籌資。坑點：比較邊際而非平均；F_new/F_old是不同利率下的籌資總額。
formulas.descriptionEn: MC is the change in total cost (new rate × funds raised at the new rate − old rate × funds at the old rate); MCR is the cost per additional dollar, compared with the expected return on new assets to decide whether to raise more. Pitfalls: compare marginal, not average, costs; F_new/F_old are totals raised at each rate.

formulas.name: 有效成本率 (Effective Cost Rate)
formulas.latex: $Effective\ Cost\ Rate = \frac{\text{Current interest cost} + \text{Noninterest costs}}{\text{Net investable funds raised}}$
formulas.description: 中文：分子含利息成本與獲取資金的非利息成本（廣告、人員、存款保險費等）；分母為淨可投資資金（扣除法定準備金與浮存）。坑點：有效成本率高於票面利率；不同來源（存款vs非存款）比較時用此口徑。
formulas.descriptionEn: The numerator adds noninterest costs of accessing funds (advertising, staff, deposit insurance) to interest cost; the denominator is net investable funds (net of required reserves and float). Pitfalls: the effective rate exceeds the stated rate; use this basis to compare deposit and nondeposit sources.

formulas.name: Unsmoothing（去平滑）
formulas.description: 中文：r_t為報告（平滑）回報，ρ為報告回報的一階自相關係數，r*_t為去平滑後的真實回報估計。效果：波動率上升、與流動資產的相關性上升、序列相關性下降。坑點：ρ越大平滑越嚴重；unsmoothing後再計算組合風險才是真實風險。
formulas.descriptionEn: r_t is the reported (smoothed) return, ρ the first-order autocorrelation of reported returns, and r*_t the unsmoothed true-return estimate. Effects: higher volatility, higher correlations with traded assets, lower serial correlation. Pitfalls: larger ρ means heavier smoothing; portfolio risk should be computed on unsmoothed returns.

chapters.chapterName: 第五章 風險管理與投資管理
chapters.summary: 本章（權重25%，二級權重最大）圍繞投資管理行業的風險管理展開：買方與賣方的差異；收益計量（時間加權TWR與金額加權DWR）；風險調整後業績指標（Sharpe、Treynor、Jensen's alpha、信息比率）；組合VaR體系（個體VaR、分散化VaR、邊際VaR MVaR、增量VaR、成分VaR與業績貢獻）；風險預算與最優組合條件；絕對/相對風險與政策混合/主動管理風險；資金風險與盈餘風險（DB/DC、Surplus at Risk）；CAPM假設與風險源、有效市場理論、多因子模型（FF3、Carhart）；主動管理基本定律（IR≈IC×√BR）；主動風險厭惡、精煉alpha與交易成本、無交易區間；組合構建技術（篩選、分層、線性規劃、二次規劃）；業績評估與市場擇時（Treynor-Mazuy、Henriksson-Merton）與風格分析；對沖基金行業演進、數據偏差與盡職調查；Alpha-Beta分離與可移植Alpha；低風險異象；私人信用等前沿主題。考試常見陷阱：MVaR/CVaR與beta的換算、分散化VaR公式、IR與IC的關係、DWR與TWR適用場景、市場擇時項的符號與顯著性判斷。
chapters.summaryEn: This chapter (25% weight — the largest in Part II) covers risk management in investment management: buy-side vs sell-side characteristics; return measurement (time-weighted vs money-weighted returns); risk-adjusted performance measures (Sharpe, Treynor, Jensen's alpha, information ratio); the portfolio VaR system (individual, diversified, marginal MVaR, incremental, and component VaR with performance contribution); risk budgeting and the optimal-portfolio condition; absolute vs relative risk and policy-mix vs active-management risk; funding risk and surplus risk (DB/DC, Surplus at Risk); CAPM assumptions and the source of risk, efficient market theory, and multifactor models (FF3, Carhart); the fundamental law of active management (IR ≈ IC×√BR); active risk aversion, refining alpha, transaction costs and the no-trade region; portfolio construction techniques (screening, stratification, linear and quadratic programming); performance evaluation and market timing (Treynor-Mazuy, Henriksson-Merton) with style analysis; hedge fund industry evolution, data biases and due diligence; alpha-beta separation and portable alpha; the low-risk anomaly; and frontier topics such as private credit. Exam traps: converting between MVaR/CVaR and beta, the diversified-VaR formula, the IR-IC relationship, choosing DWR vs TWR, and reading market-timing terms.

concepts.title: 買方與賣方的風險管理特徵
concepts.titleEn: Buy Side vs. Sell Side Risk Management Characteristics
concepts.explanation: 投資管理行業是華爾街的「買方」（buy side），銀行是「賣方」（sell side），VaR由賣方開發、在銀行業被快速接受，但在買方傳播較慢。特徵對比：持有期限——賣方短期（天）vs買方長期（月或以上）；換手率——快vs慢；槓桿——高vs低；風險度量——賣方用VaR，買方用壓力測試與跟蹤誤差、資產配置；風險控制——賣方用頭寸限額、VaR限額、止損規則，買方用分散化、基準對標與投資指引。考試陷阱：記憶對比表的六個維度；買方核心風險是相對基準的主動風險（tracking error）。
concepts.explanationEn: The investment management industry is Wall Street's 'buy side' while banks are the 'sell side'; VaR was developed by the sell side, accepted quickly by banks, and spread more slowly to investment managers. Comparison: horizon — sell side short-term (days) vs buy side long-term (months+); turnover — fast vs slow; leverage — high vs low; risk measures — VaR for the sell side vs stress tests, tracking error and asset allocation for the buy side; risk controls — position limits, VaR limits and stop-loss rules vs diversification, benchmarking and investment guidelines. Exam traps: memorize the six dimensions; the buy side's core risk is active risk versus the benchmark (tracking error).

concepts.title: 時間加權與金額加權收益率
concepts.titleEn: Time-Weighted (TWR) vs. Money-Weighted (DWR) Returns
concepts.explanation: 金額（美元）加權收益率DWR：組合的內部收益率IRR，把期初價值與期間存入視為流入、提取與期末價值視為流出，受現金流時點影響。時間加權收益率TWR：各期收益的幾何平均，衡量複合增長、不受資金進出時點影響，適合評價經理人能力（基金業績報告基準）。要點：TWR適合經理人評價（剔除客戶申贖影響）；DWR反映投資者實際體驗。考試陷阱：現金流大且時點不利時DWR可能為負而TWR為正；「經理業績比較」選TWR。
concepts.explanationEn: The money-weighted (dollar-weighted) return is the portfolio's internal rate of return: the beginning value and deposits are inflows, withdrawals and the ending value outflows — sensitive to cash-flow timing. The time-weighted return is the geometric average of sub-period returns, measuring compound growth independent of cash-flow timing — the standard for manager evaluation. Points: use TWR to judge managers (removes client flow effects) and DWR for the investor's actual experience. Exam traps: large ill-timed flows can make DWR negative while TWR is positive; manager comparisons use TWR.

concepts.title: 風險調整後業績指標
concepts.titleEn: Risk-Adjusted Performance Measures
concepts.explanation: 四大量表：Sharpe比率=(R_p−r_f)/σ_p（總風險，適合未分散組合/單一基金）；Treynor比率=(R_p−r_f)/β_p（系統風險，適合已充分分散組合）；Jensen's alpha α_p = R_p − [r_f + β_p(R_m − r_f)]（相對CAPM的超額）；信息比率IR = α_p/σ(α_p) = 主動回報/跟蹤誤差（衡量單位主動風險的主動回報）。分散化基金用Sharpe與合适指標的選擇：高度分散→Treynor/Jensen；集中→Sharpe。比率越高業績越好。考試陷阱：Sharpe用總波動率、Treynor用beta；IR的分母是跟蹤誤差（主動風險），不是總風險；負alpha時比率解讀要小心。
concepts.explanationEn: Four measures: Sharpe = (R_p−r_f)/σ_p (total risk — suitable for undiversified portfolios/funds); Treynor = (R_p−r_f)/β_p (systematic risk — suitable for well-diversified portfolios); Jensen's alpha α_p = R_p − [r_f + β_p(R_m−r_f)] (excess over CAPM); and the information ratio IR = α_p/σ(α_p) = active return over tracking error (return per unit of active risk). For highly diversified portfolios Treynor/Jensen discriminate better; for concentrated ones use Sharpe. Higher is better. Exam traps: Sharpe uses total volatility, Treynor uses beta; IR's denominator is tracking error, not total risk; interpret ratios carefully when alpha is negative.

concepts.title: 投資組合VaR：個體與分散化
concepts.titleEn: Portfolio VaR: Individual and Diversified
concepts.explanation: Delta-normal法下：個體（individual）VaR_i = z×σ_i×|V_i| = z×σ_i×|w_i|×V_P；未分散（undiversified）VaR = ΣVaR_i（簡單加總）；分散化（diversified）VaR_P = z×σ_P×V_P（用組合波動率），兩資產形式 VaR_P = √(VaR_1²+VaR_2²+2ρVaR_1VaR_2)。組合方差 σ_P² = w_1²σ_1²+w_2²σ_2²+2w_1w_2σ_1σ_2ρ_{1,2}。分散化收益 = 未分散 − 分散化VaR。考試陷阱：ρ<1時分散化VaR<未分散VaR；ρ=1時二者相等；傳統組合分析基於方差-協方差矩陣（協方差矩陣法）。
concepts.explanationEn: Under delta-normal: individual VaR_i = z×σ_i×|V_i| = z×σ_i×|w_i|×V_P; undiversified VaR = ΣVaR_i; diversified VaR_P = z×σ_P×V_P, or for two assets VaR_P = √(VaR_1²+VaR_2²+2ρVaR_1VaR_2) with σ_P² = w_1²σ_1²+w_2²σ_2²+2w_1w_2σ_1σ_2ρ_{1,2}. Diversification benefit = undiversified − diversified VaR. Exam traps: with ρ<1 diversified VaR < undiversified; equal at ρ=1; traditional analysis is the covariance-matrix (delta-normal) method.

concepts.title: 邊際VaR、增量VaR與成分VaR
concepts.titleEn: Marginal, Incremental and Component VaR
concepts.explanation: 邊際VaR（MVaR）：組合VaR對某頭寸價值的偏導數 MVaR_i = ∂VaR_P/∂V_i = z×σ_i×ρ_{iP}（ρ_{iP}為資產i與組合的相關）；也等於 z×Cov(R_i,R_P)/σ_P。增量VaR（IVaR）：新增一個頭寸後VaR的變化（新組合重估VaR − 原VaR），近似≈MVaR×w。成分VaR（CVaR_i）：頭寸i對組合VaR的貢獻 CVaR_i = MVaR_i×V_i = VaR_P×w_i×β_i，其中β_i = ρ_{iP}σ_i/σ_P；ΣCVaR_i = VaR_P（可加性）；CVaR_i/VaR_P = w_i×β_i（百分比貢獻）。由於分散化，成分VaR小於該頭寸獨立的VaR。考試陷阱：MVaR含相關係數ρ_{iP}；成分VaR可加、增量VaR不可加；「全部成分VaR之和=組合VaR」是檢查點。
concepts.explanationEn: Marginal VaR (MVaR): the partial derivative of portfolio VaR with respect to position value, MVaR_i = ∂VaR_P/∂V_i = z×σ_i×ρ_{iP} (correlation of asset i with the portfolio), equivalently z×Cov(R_i,R_P)/σ_P. Incremental VaR (IVaR): the change in VaR from adding a new position (revalued new VaR minus prior VaR), approximately MVaR×w. Component VaR (CVaR_i): position i's contribution, CVaR_i = MVaR_i×V_i = VaR_P×w_i×β_i with β_i = ρ_{iP}σ_i/σ_P; the CVaRs sum to VaR_P (additivity) and CVaR_i/VaR_P = w_i×β_i. Due to diversification, component VaR is below the position's stand-alone VaR. Exam traps: MVaR embeds ρ_{iP}; component VaRs add up, incremental VaRs do not; ΣCVaR_i = VaR_P is the checkpoint.

concepts.title: 風險預算 (Risk Budgeting)
concepts.titleEn: Risk Budgeting
concepts.explanation: 風險預算是自上而下分配風險的過程：第一步確定企業願意接受的總風險（如以VaR計）；第二步在該風險暴露下選擇最優資產配置。與市值分配不同——它分配的是「風險」。應用：(1) 資產間分配（用MVaR/成分VaR檢驗各頭寸風險貢獻）；(2) 經理間分配（用信息比率與跟蹤誤差：經理i管理的組合權重 ∝ IR_i/TE_i，即 w_i = (IR_i×TE_P)/(IR_P×TE_i)）。考試陷阱：風險預算≠資金預算；經理分配用IR/TE排序（IR越高、TE越低權重越大）；加入新頭寸是否超預算要看增量VaR。
concepts.explanationEn: Risk budgeting is a top-down process allocating risk: first determine the total risk the firm will accept (e.g., measured by VaR); second choose the optimal asset allocation for that risk exposure. Unlike market-value allocation, it allocates risk. Applications: (1) across assets (using MVaR/component VaR to check each position's contribution); (2) across managers (weights ∝ IR/TE: w_i = (IR_i×TE_P)/(IR_P×TE_i)). Exam traps: a risk budget is not a cash budget; managers are ranked by IR/TE (higher IR, lower TE → larger weight); whether a new position fits the budget depends on incremental VaR.

concepts.title: MVaR最優組合條件
concepts.titleEn: MVaR Optimality Condition
concepts.explanation: 組合VaR最小化（全局最小VaR組合）的條件：各頭寸的MVaR相等（MVaR_i = MVaR_j）。更一般的投資者最優條件：(r_i − r_f)/MVaR_i 對所有頭寸相等——即每單位邊際VaR帶來的超額回報相同；若不相等，賣出比值低的資產、買入比值高的資產可提升效用。考試陷阱：判斷是否應加入新資產X或Y：比較加入後組合VaR是否超過風險預算（如99% VaR≤2億）；或比較兩資產的 MVaR加權超額回報。
concepts.explanationEn: The global minimum-VaR portfolio equates marginal VaRs across positions (MVaR_i = MVaR_j). The general investor optimality condition: (r_i − r_f)/MVaR_i equal across all positions — each position's excess return per unit of MVaR is identical; otherwise selling the low-ratio asset and buying the high-ratio asset raises utility. Exam traps: to decide whether adding asset X or Y stays within the risk budget, check whether post-addition portfolio VaR breaches the limit (e.g., 99% VaR ≤ 200 million) or compare the excess-return-to-MVaR ratios.

concepts.title: 絕對風險、相對風險與政策混合/主動風險
concepts.titleEn: Absolute vs. Relative Risk; Policy-Mix vs. Active-Management Risk
concepts.explanation: 絕對風險：一元（每美元）損失的風險，用絕對VaR；相對風險：相對基準損失的風險，用主動收益的正態近似 VaR_相對 = z×σ(主動收益)×V。風險分解：政策混合風險（policy-mix risk）——選擇資產類別權重偏離引起的風險；主動管理風險（active-management risk）——經理偏離政策權重與選券的風險。總超額收益可分解為政策混合貢獻+主動管理貢獻（兩者近似不相關時方差可加）。多數被認為「保守」的虧損來自主動管理風險；總VaR越小主動風險越小。考試陷阱：相對風險用跟蹤誤差刻畫；政策混合是長期SAA決策、主動管理是偏離決策。
concepts.explanationEn: Absolute risk: the risk of losing dollars per unit invested (absolute VaR). Relative risk: the risk of losses versus the benchmark, approximated by VaR_relative = z×σ(active return)×V using tracking error. Risk decomposition: policy-mix risk arises from chosen asset-class weights; active-management risk from manager deviations and security selection. Total excess return decomposes into policy-mix and active-management contributions (variances add when approximately uncorrelated). Most 'conservative' losses trace to active-management risk. Exam traps: relative risk is tracked by tracking error; policy mix is the long-run SAA decision, active management the deviations.

concepts.title: 資金風險與盈餘 (Funding Risk and Surplus)
concepts.titleEn: Funding Risk and the Surplus
concepts.explanation: 資金風險：資產價值不足以覆蓋負債的風險，應在資產負債管理（ALM）框架下衡量。DB（確定給付）養老金承諾固定支付流，資產不足時由基金出資人補足（風險在僱主）；DC（確定繳費）把風險轉給員工。盈餘 Surplus = 資產 − 負債；ΔSurplus = A×R_A − L×R_L；σ_Surplus = √(A²σ_A² + L²σ_L² − 2ALσ_Aσ_Lρ)；盈餘風險值 SaR = |E(ΔSurplus) − z_c×σ_surplus|；年末盈餘置信區間 [E(S_1) − zσ_s, E(S_1) + zσ_s]。負債近似於債券多頭（利率下降負債價值上升）。考試陷阱：資產與負債相關性越高盈餘波動越小（對沖）；SaR的z與置信水平對應；DB vs DC的風險承擔方。
concepts.explanationEn: Funding risk: the risk that asset values will not cover liabilities — measured in an asset-liability management (ALM) framework. A defined-benefit (DB) plan promises fixed payments and the sponsor absorbs shortfalls; defined-contribution (DC) plans put the risk on employees. Surplus = assets − liabilities; ΔSurplus = A×R_A − L×R_L; σ_Surplus = √(A²σ_A² + L²σ_L² − 2ALσ_Aσ_Lρ); surplus at risk SaR = |E(ΔSurplus) − z_c×σ_surplus|; the end-of-year surplus confidence interval is [E(S_1) − zσ_s, E(S_1) + zσ_s]. Liabilities behave like a long bond (values rise as rates fall).
