Exam traps: higher asset-liability correlation lowers surplus volatility (hedging); SaR's z matches the confidence level; know who bears risk in DB vs DC.

concepts.title: CAPM假設、結論與風險源
concepts.titleEn: CAPM Assumptions, Implications and the Source of Risk
concepts.explanation: CAPM假設：投資者是只依據期望收益與標準差決策的風險厭惡效用最大化者；單一持有期；同質預期；所有資產可無限細分、可賣空；投資者能以無風險利率借貸；無稅與交易成本；市場完美。結論：E(R_i) = R_f + β_i[E(R_m) − R_f]；市場組合的風險溢價 E(R_m) − R_f = γ×σ_m²（γ為市場投資者平均風險厭惡係數、σ_m為市場組合波動率）——風險源於市場組合的方差乘以平均厭惡度。考試陷阱：風險源公式把「風險溢價」與「風險厭惡×方差」聯繫；β_i是系統性風險敞口；假設中「以無風險利率借貸」與「賣空不受限」常被考。
concepts.explanationEn: CAPM assumptions: investors are risk-averse expected-utility maximizers choosing on mean and standard deviation; single period; homogeneous expectations; assets infinitely divisible and shortable; borrowing/lending at the risk-free rate; no taxes or transaction costs; perfect markets. Implications: E(R_i) = R_f + β_i[E(R_m) − R_f], and the market risk premium E(R_m) − R_f = γ×σ_m², where γ is the average market investor's risk aversion and σ_m market volatility — risk stems from market variance times average aversion. Exam traps: the risk-premium identity links aversion and variance; β_i is the systematic exposure; borrowing at the risk-free rate and unrestricted shorting are classic assumptions.

concepts.title: 有效市場理論 (EMH)
concepts.titleEn: Efficient Market Theory (EMH)
concepts.explanation: 若所有相關信息都已反映在證券價格中，市場即有效。按信息集分：弱式（weak form）——反映歷史價格與成交量，技術分析無效；半強式（semi-strong）——反映所有公開信息（財報、分紅、管理層變動、收盤價等），基本面分析無效；強式（strong）——連內幕信息也反映，內部人無法獲取超額收益（強式包含半強與弱式）。檢驗對應：股價動量/反轉→弱式；α能否被基本面因子持續解釋→半強式；公告前量價異動→違反半強式。有效市場中投資者無法持續獲得超額收益。考試陷阱：各形式的信息集邊界；「技術分析在弱式有效下失效」；強式≠現實（內幕交易仍存在）。
concepts.explanationEn: A market is efficient if all relevant information is reflected in security prices. By information set: weak form — past prices and volume; technical analysis cannot earn abnormal profits. Semi-strong — all public information (financial statements, dividends, management changes, closing prices); fundamental analysis cannot earn abnormal profits. Strong form — even private information; insiders cannot earn abnormal returns (strong encompasses semi-strong and weak). Tests: momentum/reversals probe weak form; persistent factor alphas probe semi-strong; pre-announcement volume/price moves violate semi-strong. Exam traps: the boundaries of each information set; technical analysis fails under weak-form efficiency; strong form is an idealization.

concepts.title: 多因子模型：Fama-French與Carhart
concepts.titleEn: Multifactor Models: Fama-French and Carhart
concepts.explanation: 多因子模型：E(R_i) = R_f + Σ β_{i,k}E(f_k)。Fama-French三因子：市場因子MKT + 規模因子SMB（小盤減大盤）+ 價值因子HML（高賬面市值比減低賬面市值比）；β_{SMB}>0表示收益與小盤股同向。Carhart四因子再加動量因子WML（贏者減輸者）。用途：解釋橫截面收益差異、評估基金業績（多因子α更嚴格）。考試陷阱：SMB/HML/WML的定義方向；「三因子中不含動量」；因子暴露的符號解讀（如β_SMB<0意味著與大盤股同向）。
concepts.explanationEn: Multifactor model: E(R_i) = R_f + Σ β_{i,k}E(f_k). Fama-French three factors: the market factor MKT plus size SMB (small minus big) and value HML (high minus low book-to-market); β_{SMB} > 0 means returns co-move with small caps. Carhart adds the momentum factor WML (winners minus losers). Uses: explaining cross-sectional return differences and stricter performance evaluation (multi-factor alpha). Exam traps: the direction of each factor; the three-factor model has no momentum; interpret exposure signs (β_SMB < 0 co-moves with large caps).

concepts.title: 主動管理基本定律 (Grinold)
concepts.titleEn: Fundamental Law of Active Management (Grinold)
concepts.explanation: 組合經理通過偏離基準的下注創造潛在alpha；Grinold基本定律：IR ≈ IC×√BR。IC（information coefficient）：經理預測與實際收益的相關係數（預測能力）；BR（breadth）：每年可獨立下注的次數。假設：各次預測相互獨立。含義：提升預測質量或增加獨立下注廣度都可提高IR；該定律不提供尋找高IR策略的工具，而是系統性評估策略的機制。考試陷阱：√BR（不是BR）；IC是相關係數（-1到1）；假設「每次預測獨立於其他預測與該證券後續時期的預測」。
concepts.explanationEn: Managers create potential alpha by betting away from the benchmark; Grinold's fundamental law: IR ≈ IC×√BR, where IC (information coefficient) is the correlation of the manager's forecasts with actual returns and BR (breadth) the number of independent bets per year, assuming independence across forecasts. Implication: better forecasts or more independent bets raise IR; the law does not find high-IR strategies but systematizes their evaluation. Exam traps: it is √BR, not BR; IC is a correlation (−1 to 1); the independence assumption across bets and over time.

concepts.title: 主動風險厭惡與增值效用
concepts.titleEn: Active Risk Aversion and Value Added
concepts.explanation: 最優組合需要主動風險厭惡係數λ_A作為輸入，實務中經理對λ_A缺乏直覺但對IR與主動風險水準有直覺：λ_A = IR/(2×σ_α)。增值（效用）：Utility = α_p − λ_A×σ_α²（α_p為組合主動回報、σ_α為跟蹤誤差）。含特定資產類別時：Utility = α_p − (λ_{A,CF}×σ_{A,CF}² + λ_{A,SP}×σ_{A,SP}²)，對不同資產設不同主動厭惡度。考試陷阱：λ_A公式中分母是2×σ_α；效用對主動風險的懲罰是二次的（λ_A×σ_α²）；「經理對IR和TE有直覺」是為何用該公式反推λ_A。
concepts.explanationEn: The optimal portfolio needs the active risk aversion λ_A, which managers lack intuition for but they know their IR and active risk: λ_A = IR/(2×σ_α). Value added: Utility = α_p − λ_A×σ_α² (α_p active return, σ_α tracking error). With asset classes: Utility = α_p − (λ_{A,CF}×σ_{A,CF}² + λ_{A,SP}×σ_{A,SP}²), setting separate aversion per class. Exam traps: the denominator is 2×σ_α; the penalty on active risk is quadratic; the formula infers λ_A from IR and TE because managers lack direct intuition for it.

concepts.title: 精煉Alpha (Refining Alpha)
concepts.titleEn: Refining Alpha
concepts.explanation: 為滿足特定限制（不允許賣空、組合現金額度、流動性）而精煉alpha的三步：(1) 縮放alpha：α = σ_殘差 × IC × Score，Score為均值0、標準差1的標準化預測分數——把預測轉化為與殘差風險一致的alpha；(2) 修訂異常值（outliers）：剝離超規模的異常預測，避免組合被單點扭曲；(3) alpha中性化：若原始alpha隱含基準暴露，重新定位alpha剔除基準成分（中性化後僅保留真正主動觀點）。考試陷阱：縮放公式把IC與Score相乘；中性化的目的是「去掉基準alpha」；異常值處理在縮放之前或之後的順序題。
concepts.explanationEn: Three steps refine alpha for constraints (no shorting, cash limits, liquidity): (1) scale alpha: α = σ_residual × IC × Score, where Score is a standardized forecast with mean 0 and standard deviation 1 — converting forecasts into alpha consistent with residual risk; (2) trim outliers: strip oversized forecasts that would distort the portfolio; (3) neutralize alpha: if raw alpha embeds benchmark exposure, re-anchor it to remove the benchmark component, keeping only the genuine active views. Exam traps: the scaling formula multiplies IC by Score; neutralization removes benchmark alpha; watch the order of steps.

concepts.title: 交易成本與無交易區間
concepts.titleEn: Transaction Costs and the No-Trade Region
concepts.explanation: 調倉前比較股票n的邊際貢獻與交易成本：MCVAn = α_n − 2×λ_A×σ_α×MCVA_n（MCVA_n為該資產對主動風險的邊際貢獻）。非交易區間：賣出成本SC_n ≤ MCVAn ≤ 買入成本PC_n時不調倉；MCVAn < SC_n賣出、> PC_n買入。決定非交易區間寬度的因素：交易成本、風險厭惡係數、alpha與資產的風險程度。考試陷阱：2×λ_A×σ_α是主動風險的影子價格；成本越高區間越寬（換手越低）；區間內「持有不動」。
concepts.explanationEn: Before rebalancing, compare asset n's marginal contribution with its trading cost: MCVAn = α_n − 2×λ_A×σ_α×MCVA_n, where MCVA_n is the asset's marginal contribution to active risk. The no-trade region: do nothing when selling cost SC_n ≤ MCVAn ≤ purchase cost PC_n; sell below SC_n, buy above PC_n. Width drivers: transaction costs, risk aversion, and the riskiness of alpha and assets. Exam traps: 2×λ_A×σ_α is the shadow price of active risk; higher costs widen the region (lower turnover); within the region, hold.

concepts.title: 組合構建技術：篩選、分層、線性規劃與二次規劃
concepts.titleEn: Portfolio Construction: Screening, Stratification, LP and QP
concepts.explanation: 四種技術：(1) 篩選（screening）：按alpha排序分為買入/持有/賣出層；優點簡單穩健，缺點忽略排序之外的信息、拒絕低beta資產；風險管理靠充分持股，成本靠控制換手。(2) 分層（stratification）：把資產劃為互斥類別確保每類都有持有，分散化控制風險。(3) 線性規劃（LP）：以多個風險特徵（行業、規模、波動率、beta）為約束，最大化alpha減交易成本、保持接近基準的風險特徵；考慮所有alpha信息與交易成本；缺點難以事先指定持倉數量、風險特徵約束不應與alpha交叉使用。(4) 二次規劃（QP）：充分考慮所有因素（含協方差），最全面但輸入多、噪音多。考試陷阱：LP優於分層之處在於同時使用多個風險特徵；QP輸入最多、噪音最大。
concepts.explanationEn: Four techniques: (1) screening — rank by alpha into buy/hold/sell buckets; simple and robust but ignores information beyond ranking and rejects low-beta assets; risk managed by broad holdings, costs by turnover control. (2) Stratification — mutually exclusive categories ensuring each is held, controlling risk through diversification. (3) Linear programming — optimizes with multiple risk characteristics (industry, size, volatility, beta), maximizing alpha minus transaction costs while staying close to benchmark characteristics; uses all alpha information and costs; hard to hit a target number of names, and risk-characteristic constraints should not cross with alpha. (4) Quadratic programming — fully accounts for all factors (including covariances); most complete but more inputs mean more noise. Exam traps: LP improves on stratification by using several risk characteristics; QP has the most inputs and noise.

concepts.title: 業績評估與市場擇時
concepts.titleEn: Performance Evaluation and Market Timing
concepts.explanation: 業績評估目標：判斷組合能否戰勝基準、與同行比較、確認風險/成本下的表現、識別業績來源。分解為資產配置（policy）、證券選擇（selection）與擇時（timing）。市場擇時能力：預測市場方向並在組合與無風險資產間轉換（上漲預期加高beta股票）。兩模型：Treynor-Mazuy：r_p − r_f = a + b(r_m − r_f) + c(r_m − r_f)² + e_p，c>0顯示擇時能力（凸回報）；Henriksson-Merton：加看跌保護項c(r_m − r_f)D（D為市場上漲虛擬變量），c>0為有擇時能力。無擇時者回歸為線性。考試陷阱：看二次項/虛擬項係數c的符號與顯著性；擇時者的beta隨市場狀態變化；TWR評價長期擇時者時會低估（現金流時點）。
concepts.explanationEn: Performance evaluation asks whether the portfolio beats its benchmark, how it compares with peers, whether performance justifies risks/costs, and where returns come from — decomposed into policy allocation, security selection and timing. Market timing: predicting market direction and shifting between the portfolio and risk-free assets (higher-beta stocks when bullish). Two models: Treynor-Mazuy r_p − r_f = a + b(r_m − r_f) + c(r_m − r_f)² + e_p with c>0 indicating timing skill (convex payoff); Henriksson-Merton adds c(r_m − r_f)D with D an up-market dummy, c>0 indicating skill. Without timing, the regression is linear. Exam traps: read the sign and significance of c; timers' beta varies with market state; TWR can understate long-horizon timers.

concepts.title: 風格分析 (Style Analysis)
concepts.titleEn: Style Analysis
concepts.explanation: Sharpe提出的基於收益的風格分析：用一組資產類別指數收益回歸基金收益 R_p = Σ w_s×R_s + ε，權重解釋為基金的風格暴露（非負約束、和為1）。Sharpe研究結論：97.3%的基金收益由風格（資產配置）解釋，僅2.7%來自選券與擇時——長期資產配置的重要性得到實證支持，擇時與選券收益至多勉強覆蓋運營與交易成本。考試陷阱：97.3%/2.7%的數字；風格分析是「基於收益」（return-based）而非持倉法；殘差ε代表選券能力。
concepts.explanationEn: Sharpe's return-based style analysis regresses fund returns on asset-class index returns R_p = Σ w_s×R_s + ε, with weights interpreted as style exposures (non-negative, summing to one). Sharpe's finding: 97.3% of fund returns explained by style (asset allocation) and only 2.7% by selection bets (security selection and timing) — empirically establishing the dominance of long-run asset allocation, with timing and selection returns at best covering operating and trading costs. Exam traps: the 97.3%/2.7% figures; style analysis is return-based, not holdings-based; ε captures selection skill.

concepts.title: 對沖基金行業演進與數據偏差
concepts.titleEn: Hedge Fund Industry Evolution and Data Biases
concepts.explanation: 演進：1990年代前業績數據難得；1994年初（美聯儲加息衝擊）大幅虧損推動對沖基金數據庫建立；1997-2010年AUM增長10倍、基金數量翻兩番；1998年LTCM崩潰是行業分水嶺（高收益伴隨高風險）；2000-01互聯網泡沫破裂期間對沖基金以一半於標普500的波動跑贏大盤，機構資金湧入；1999-2007年AUM從1970億美元增至1.39萬億，投資者從私人財富轉向機構（捐贈基金、養老金、保險）。數據偏差：自我選擇偏差（self-selection，業績好的基金才自願上報）與回填偏差（backfill，把歷史好業績補錄進指數），使數據庫業績被高估；共識是1996年後指數回報漸趨可靠。考試陷阱：1994是數據庫分界、1998是LTCM；self-selection vs backfill的區別；基金不參與數據庫造成彙總偏差。
concepts.explanationEn: Evolution: performance data were scarce before the early 1990s; dramatic losses in early 1994 (Fed policy shift) spurred hedge fund databases; AUM grew tenfold from 1997 to 2010 as fund count quadrupled; the 1998 LTCM collapse was a watershed (higher returns mean higher risk); in 2000-01 hedge funds beat the S&P 500 with half its volatility, drawing institutional money; AUM rose from $197 billion (1999) to $1.39 trillion (2007) as investors shifted from private wealth to institutions. Data biases: self-selection (only better-performing funds volunteer) and backfill bias (splicing past results into indexes) overstate database performance; index returns became increasingly reliable from 1996. Exam traps: 1994 for databases, 1998 for LTCM; distinguish self-selection from backfill; non-reporting funds distort aggregates.

concepts.title: 對沖基金盡職調查
concepts.titleEn: Hedge Fund Due Diligence
concepts.explanation: 盡職調查是投資者在投資前對策略、經理與基金進行的評估分析。應評估現代對沖基金所需的三種能力：投資能力（investment skills，策略與風險）、操作能力（operational skills，估值、托管、合規——很多欺詐發生在運營端）、業務能力（business skills，治理與可持續性）。風險管理系統的盡職調查問題應針對大型多策略基金：風險指標如何計算與監測、壓力測試、限額與止損、風險部門獨立性與直屬匯報線。考試陷阱：三種技能缺一不可；「僅關注投資策略」不充分；運營失敗（如估值操縱）是常見倒閉原因。
concepts.explanationEn: Due diligence is the evaluation and analysis an investor performs on a strategy, manager and fund before committing capital. Assess all three skill sets needed to run a modern hedge fund: investment skills (strategy and risk), operational skills (valuation, custody, compliance — many frauds occur operationally), and business skills (governance and sustainability). For large multi-strategy funds, risk-management due diligence should probe how risk is measured and monitored, stress testing, limits and stop-losses, and the independence and reporting lines of the risk function. Exam traps: all three skills matter; focusing only on strategy is insufficient; operational failures (e.g., valuation manipulation) commonly sink funds.

concepts.title: Alpha-Beta分離與可移植Alpha
concepts.titleEn: Alpha-Beta Separation and Portable Alpha
concepts.explanation: Alpha是評價主動經理的風險調整後收益指標；關鍵是區分收益中來自風險（beta）與來自主動管理（alpha）的部分（distinguishing alpha and beta）。分離（separating alpha and beta）：公司可分別管理beta暴露與組合alpha——用衍生品（期貨、互換）獲取基準beta、同時把資金投向alpha來源，從而最小化或消除不想要的系統性風險；可移植alpha（portable alpha）即把alpha「搬到」任意beta暴露之上。考試陷阱：實現手段是衍生品疊加；分離的好處是beta與alpha分別付費；可移植alpha的風險在於衍生品保證金與抵押品流動性。
concepts.explanationEn: Alpha is the risk-adjusted return measure for active managers; the key is distinguishing how much of a strategy's return comes from risk (beta) versus active management (alpha). Separation: manage beta exposure separately from alpha — use derivatives (futures, swaps) to obtain benchmark beta while investing the cash in alpha sources, minimizing or eliminating unwanted systematic risk; portable alpha 'ports' alpha onto any beta exposure. Exam traps: implementation is a derivatives overlay; separation prices beta and alpha separately; portable alpha carries margin and collateral liquidity risk.

concepts.title: 低風險異象 (Low-Risk Anomaly)
concepts.titleEn: The Low-Risk Anomaly
concepts.explanation: 實證發現與傳統理論相反的現象：(1) 低波動率股票未來收益與其波動率呈負相關；(2) 已實現beta與未來收益負相關；(3) 最小方差組合的收益高於市場組合。解釋：槓桿限制（機構無法加槓桿轉而追逐高beta高風險股票）、代理問題（經理追逐基準相對排名）、偏好（彩票型偏好）。考試陷阱：「低風險≠低收益」；解釋中「槓桿限制」最常考；該異象說明CAPM的預期方向在橫截面上不成立。
concepts.explanationEn: Empirically, contrary to theory: (1) low-volatility stocks' future returns are negatively related to their volatility; (2) realized beta correlates negatively with future returns; (3) the minimum-variance portfolio outperforms the market portfolio. Explanations: leverage constraints (institutions cannot lever, so they chase high-beta stocks), agency issues (managers chase benchmark-relative ranks), and preferences (lottery-type tastes). Exam traps: low risk does not mean low return; leverage constraints are the classic explanation; the anomaly contradicts CAPM's cross-sectional prediction.

concepts.title: 基金經理與機構的風險管理要點
concepts.titleEn: Fund Manager and Institutional Risk Management
concepts.explanation: 不同投資公司的資金風險差異巨大：DB養老金風險在出資人（ALM框架）、DC在員工、捐贈基金關注實際支出、共同基金關注贖回與現金拖累。經理層面的風險管理工具：VaR限額與壓力測試、跟蹤誤差限額、流動性管理（贖回條款、gate）、槓桿與衍生品敞口監控。宏觀因子與風格因子對不同情境投資者的影響（如利率上行利於價值因子、不利於長久期）。考試陷阱：DB/DC/捐贈基金的風險承擔主體；共同基金的流動性風險（大額贖回被迫賤賣）。
concepts.explanationEn: Funding risk varies dramatically across investment companies: DB plans put risk on the sponsor (ALM framework), DC plans on employees, endowments focus on real spending, and mutual funds face redemption and cash-drag risk. Manager-level tools: VaR limits and stress testing, tracking-error limits, liquidity management (redemption terms, gates), and monitoring leverage and derivative exposures. Macro and style factors affect different investors differently (e.g., rising rates favor value, hurt long duration). Exam traps: who bears risk in DB/DC/endowments; mutual funds' liquidity risk from forced sales on redemptions.

concepts.title: 私人信用市場 (Private Credit)
concepts.titleEn: Private Credit Markets
concepts.explanation: 私人信用（private credit，私募信貸）：非公開市場提供的直接貸款（direct lending）、夾層貸款（mezzanine）、不良債務等，主要由私募信貸基金/BDC向中型企業發放。全球驅動因素：銀行監管收緊（巴塞爾後銀行退出中端市場貸款）、機構追逐收益與分散化、利率環境。風險特徵：流動性差（鎖定期長、二級市場薄）、估值平滑導致的波動與相關性低估（見unsmoothing）、信用風險集中（單一借款人、行業）、槓桿貸款的違約回收不確定性、以及利率上升期利息覆蓋率惡化。與私人信用的發展相關的宏觀議題：貨幣與財政政策對信用利差的影響。考試陷阱：私人信用流動性差、估值偏差是其風險核心；「銀行收縮→私募基金填補」的結構性驅動。
concepts.explanationEn: Private credit: direct lending, mezzanine and distressed debt provided outside public markets, mainly by private credit funds/BDCs to mid-sized companies. Global drivers: tighter bank regulation (banks retreating from mid-market lending), institutional demand for yield and diversification, and the rate environment. Risk features: illiquidity (long lock-ups, thin secondary markets), smoothed valuations understating volatility and correlations (see unsmoothing), concentrated credit risk (single borrowers, sectors), uncertain recovery on leveraged loans, and deteriorating interest coverage as rates rise. Macro themes include monetary and fiscal policy effects on credit spreads. Exam traps: illiquidity and valuation bias are the core risks; banks' retreat and private funds filling the gap is the structural driver.

concepts.title: 投資管理中的VaR運用與限額體系
concepts.titleEn: VaR in Investment Management and Limit Systems
concepts.explanation: 買方運用VaR的方式：設定組合與經理層級的VaR限額、風險預算分解（MVaR/成分VaR）、新頭寸審批（增量VaR）與跟蹤誤差管理。典型考題：組合100百萬、99% VaR限額200百萬——判斷加入新資產X（σ=9%、ρ=0.7）或Y（σ=12%、ρ=0）是否超限：用分散化VaR公式計算加入後組合VaR比較。結論示例：加入Y（不相關）雖波動率更高但分散化效果更好，組合VaR 176百萬<200百萬，滿足預算；加入X則超限。考試陷阱：分散化VaR要看相關性而非單看波動率；z(99%)=2.33；現有頭寸的VaR = z×σ×V。
concepts.explanationEn: Buy-side VaR applications: portfolio and manager-level VaR limits, risk budgeting via MVaR/component VaR, new-position approval via incremental VaR, and tracking-error management. Classic problem: a 100 million portfolio with a 99% VaR limit of 200 million — test whether adding X (σ=9%, ρ=0.7) or Y (σ=12%, ρ=0) breaches it using the diversified-VaR formula. Illustration: adding Y (uncorrelated) yields portfolio VaR 176 million < 200 million (within budget) despite higher standalone volatility, while adding X breaches. Exam traps: diversification depends on correlation, not volatility alone; z(99%) = 2.33; standalone VaR = z×σ×V.

formulas.name: 時間加權與金額加權收益率
formulas.latex: $TWR = \left[(1+R_1)(1+R_2)\cdots(1+R_n)\right]^{1/n} - 1 \quad;\quad DWR = IRR\ of\ portfolio\ cash\ flows$
formulas.description: 中文：TWR為各期收益的幾何平均（複合增長、不受現金流時點影響）；DWR為IRR——期初價值與存入為流入、提取與期末價值為流出。坑點：經理評價用TWR；投資者實際回報用DWR；現金流時點不利時DWR可能大幅低於TWR。
formulas.descriptionEn: TWR is the geometric average of sub-period returns (compound growth, independent of flow timing); DWR is the IRR — beginning value and deposits are inflows, withdrawals and the ending value are outflows. Pitfalls: use TWR to judge managers and DWR for investor experience; ill-timed flows can drive DWR far below TWR.

formulas.name: 風險調整後業績指標（Sharpe/Treynor/Jensen/IR）
formulas.latex: $Sharpe = \frac{R_p - r_f}{\sigma_p} \quad;\quad Treynor = \frac{R_p - r_f}{\beta_p} \quad;\quad \alpha_p = R_p - [r_f + \beta_p(R_m - r_f)] \quad;\quad IR = \frac{\alpha_p}{\sigma(\alpha_p)}$
formulas.description: 中文：Sharpe用總風險σ_p；Treynor用系統風險β_p；Jensen's alpha為超過CAPM的部分；IR=主動回報/跟蹤誤差（或α_p/σ(α_p)）。坑點：分散化程度決定用哪個指標；IR的分母是主動風險；比率間不可直接跨組合比較（除非風險口徑一致）。
formulas.descriptionEn: Sharpe uses total risk σ_p; Treynor uses systematic risk β_p; Jensen's alpha is the excess over CAPM; IR = active return over tracking error (α_p/σ(α_p)). Pitfalls: diversification determines the appropriate measure; IR's denominator is active risk; compare ratios only with consistent risk bases.

formulas.name: 組合VaR（Delta-Normal）
formulas.latex: $VaR_i = z\,\sigma_i |V_i| = z\,\sigma_i |w_i| V_P \quad;\quad VaR_P = z\,\sigma_P V_P = \sqrt{VaR_1^2 + VaR_2^2 + 2\rho\, VaR_1 VaR_2}$
formulas.description: 中文：z為置信水平對應分位數（95%→1.645、99%→2.33）；σ_P由協方差矩陣得出：σ_P² = w_1²σ_1² + w_2²σ_2² + 2w_1w_2σ_1σ_2ρ_{1,2}。未分散VaR = ΣVaR_i。坑點：分散化VaR < 未分散VaR（ρ<1）；多資產用矩陣；w_i帶符號（空頭為負）。
formulas.descriptionEn: z is the confidence-level quantile (1.645 at 95%, 2.33 at 99%); σ_P comes from the covariance matrix: σ_P² = w_1²σ_1² + w_2²σ_2² + 2w_1w_2σ_1σ_2ρ_{1,2}. Undiversified VaR = ΣVaR_i. Pitfalls: diversified VaR < undiversified for ρ<1; use the matrix for many assets; weights carry signs (negative for shorts).

formulas.name: 邊際VaR (MVaR)
formulas.description: 中文：MVaR_i為頭寸i每增加1元對組合VaR的邊際影響，含資產與組合的相關係數ρ_{iP}。坑點：MVaR不是獨立VaR（差在ρ_{iP}）；全局最小VaR組合要求各資產MVaR相等。
formulas.descriptionEn: MVaR_i is the marginal impact on portfolio VaR per extra dollar of position i, embedding the asset-portfolio correlation ρ_{iP}. Pitfalls: MVaR differs from stand-alone VaR by ρ_{iP}; the global minimum-VaR portfolio equates MVaRs across assets.

formulas.name: 成分VaR與百分比貢獻
formulas.description: 中文：成分VaR為頭寸對組合VaR的貢獻（分散化後小於獨立VaR）；β_i為頭寸相對組合的系統beta；ΣCVaR_i = VaR_P。坑點：可加性是檢查點；百分比貢獻=w_i×β_i；例：V_A=4百萬、V_B=2百萬，MVaR分別0.064428與0.175388 → CVaR_A=0.2577、CVaR_B=0.3508百萬。
formulas.descriptionEn: Component VaR is the position's contribution to portfolio VaR (below its stand-alone VaR due to diversification); β_i is the position's beta versus the portfolio; ΣCVaR_i = VaR_P. Pitfalls: additivity is the checkpoint; percentage contribution = w_i×β_i; e.g., with V_A = 4m, V_B = 2m and MVaRs 0.064428/0.175388, CVaR_A = 0.2577m and CVaR_B = 0.3508m.

formulas.name: 增量VaR與經理風險預算權重
formulas.nameEn: Incremental VaR and Manager Risk Budgeting Weights
formulas.description: 中文：增量VaR≈邊際VaR×新增頭寸權重；經理i應管理的組合權重與其IR成正比、與其跟蹤誤差成反比（IR_i/TE_i標準化）。坑點：增量VaR用於「加入新頭寸是否超風險預算」的判斷；經理分配的是風險不是資金。
formulas.descriptionEn: Incremental VaR ≈ MVaR × the new position's weight; manager i's allocated portfolio weight scales with IR and inversely with tracking error (standardized by IR_i/TE_i). Pitfalls: use incremental VaR to test whether a new position breaches the risk budget; managers are allocated risk, not cash.

formulas.name: MVaR最優組合條件
formulas.description: 中文：全局最小VaR組合中各頭寸MVaR相等；投資者最優組合中各頭寸「超額回報/MVaR」相等。坑點：判斷新增資產時比較比值高低（低→賣出/不買，高→買入）；需先把收益轉換為同一期限。
formulas.descriptionEn: In the global minimum-VaR portfolio MVaRs are equal; in the investor's optimum each position's excess return per unit of MVaR is equal. Pitfalls: when adding an asset compare the ratios (low → sell/avoid; high → buy); align return horizons first.

formulas.name: 盈餘及其波動率
formulas.description: 中文：A、L為資產與負債市值，σ_A、σ_L為各自收益波動率，ρ為資產-負債收益相關；ρ越高盈餘波動越小（天然對沖）。坑點：交叉項是−2ALσ_Aσ_Lρ（資產與負債同向變動對沖）；負債近似長債多頭。
formulas.descriptionEn: A and L are market values of assets and liabilities, σ_A and σ_L their return volatilities, and ρ the asset-liability return correlation; higher ρ lowers surplus volatility (natural hedge). Pitfalls: the cross term is −2ALσ_Aσ_Lρ; liabilities behave like a long bond.

formulas.name: 盈餘風險值 (SaR)
formulas.description: 中文：SaR為給定置信水平c下盈餘可能惡化的最大幅度；年末盈餘置信區間以E(S_1)=S_0+E(ΔSurplus)為中心。坑點：z_c與置信水平對應（95%→1.65、99%→2.33）；盈餘目標低於SaR時需調整資產負債結構。
formulas.descriptionEn: SaR is the worst deterioration in surplus at confidence level c; the end-of-year surplus confidence interval centers on E(S_1) = S_0 + E(ΔSurplus). Pitfalls: z_c matches the confidence level (1.65 at 95%, 2.33 at 99%); if the target surplus is below SaR, adjust the asset-liability structure.

formulas.name: CAPM
formulas.description: 中文：β_i為資產i的系統性風險敞口，E(R_m)−R_f為市場風險溢價。均衡時資產只因承擔系統風險獲得補償。坑點：α=E(R_i)−CAPM預測為異象信號；β_i=ρ_{i,m}σ_i/σ_m；假設清單常被考（單期、同質預期、無稅、可賣空等）。
formulas.descriptionEn: β_i is asset i's systematic exposure and E(R_m)−R_f the market risk premium; equilibrium compensates only systematic risk. Pitfalls: α = E(R_i) − CAPM prediction signals anomalies; β_i = ρ_{i,m}σ_i/σ_m; assumption lists (single period, homogeneous expectations, no taxes, shorting) are frequently tested.

formulas.name: 風險源（市場風險溢價的微觀基礎）
formulas.description: 中文：γ為市場投資者的平均風險厭惡係數，σ_m為市場組合波動率；風險源=厭惡度×市場方差。坑點：是方差（σ²）不是標準差；γ越大溢價越高；該式把CAPM與效用理論連接。
formulas.descriptionEn: γ is the average investor's risk aversion and σ_m market volatility; the source of risk equals aversion times market variance. Pitfalls: it is variance (σ²), not standard deviation; higher γ means a higher premium; this links CAPM to utility theory.

formulas.name: Fama-French三因子模型
formulas.description: 中文：MKT為市場因子（組合收益超無風險利率）；SMB為小盤減大盤收益差；HML為高賬面市值比減低賬面市值比收益差。β_{SMB}>0表示與小盤同向。坑點：三因子不含動量；因子定義的「減法方向」決定符號解讀。
formulas.descriptionEn: MKT is the market factor (portfolio return over the risk-free rate); SMB is small minus big; HML is high minus low book-to-market; β_{SMB} > 0 co-moves with small caps. Pitfalls: no momentum factor here; the subtraction direction defines the sign interpretation.

formulas.name: Carhart四因子模型
formulas.description: 中文：WML（winners minus losers）為橫截面動量因子（過去贏者組合減輸者組合）。坑點：動量因子是「過去12個月剔除最近1個月」的慣例；β_{WML}>0表示追漲特性。
formulas.descriptionEn: WML (winners minus losers) is the cross-sectional momentum factor (past winner minus loser portfolios). Pitfalls: momentum conventionally skips the most recent month over a 12-month window; β_{WML} > 0 indicates chasing winners.

formulas.name: 主動管理基本定律
formulas.description: 中文：IC為預測與實際收益的相關係數，BR為每年獨立下注次數（breadth）。假設各次預測獨立。坑點：根號BR；提高IC或BR都能提升IR；「BR=25」時IR=IC×5。
formulas.descriptionEn: IC is the forecast-return correlation and BR the number of independent bets per year, assuming forecast independence. Pitfalls: square root of BR; raising either IC or BR lifts IR; e.g., BR=25 gives IR = IC×5.

formulas.name: 主動風險厭惡與增值效用
formulas.nameEn: Active Risk Aversion and Value Added
formulas.description: 中文：λ_A為主動風險厭惡係數（由IR與跟蹤誤差σ_α反推）；效用=主動回報−λ_A×主動風險平方。多資產時對各資產用各自的λ_{A}與σ_{A}。坑點：分母是2σ_α；懲罰項是二次式；λ_A越大經理越保守。
formulas.descriptionEn: λ_A is the active risk aversion inferred from IR and tracking error σ_α; utility = active return − λ_A×active risk squared. With asset classes, use each class's λ_A and σ_A. Pitfalls: the denominator is 2σ_α; the penalty is quadratic; larger λ_A means a more conservative manager.

formulas.name: Alpha縮放（精煉Alpha）
formulas.description: 中文：σ_residual為殘差（跟蹤）風險，IC為預測相關係數，Score為標準化預測分數（均值0、標準差1）。把原始預測轉化為與風險預算一致的alpha。坑點：三項相乘的結構；中性化與異常值處理是另兩步精煉。
formulas.descriptionEn: σ_residual is residual (tracking) risk, IC the forecast correlation, and Score a standardized forecast (mean 0, standard deviation 1), converting raw forecasts into alpha consistent with the risk budget. Pitfalls: the three-factor product; neutralization and outlier trimming are the other refinement steps.

formulas.name: 交易成本與無交易區間
formulas.nameEn: Transaction Costs and the No-Trade Region
formulas.description: 中文：MCVAn為資產n對組合增值的邊際貢獻，MCVA_n為其對主動風險的邊際貢獻，2λ_Aσ_α為主動風險影子價格；當MCVAn落在賣出成本SC_n與買入成本PC_n之間時不交易。坑點：成本越高區間越寬、換手越低；區間外才調倉。
formulas.descriptionEn: MCVAn is asset n's marginal contribution to value added, MCVA_n its marginal contribution to active risk, and 2λ_Aσ_α the shadow price of active risk; no trade occurs while MCVAn lies between selling cost SC_n and purchase cost PC_n. Pitfalls: higher costs widen the region and lower turnover; trade only outside the region.

formulas.name: 市場擇時模型（TM與HM）
formulas.latex: $TM:\; r_p - r_f = a + b(r_m - r_f) + c(r_m - r_f)^2 + e_p \quad;\quad HM:\; r_p - r_f = a + b(r_m - r_f) + c(r_m - r_f)D + e_p$
formulas.description: 中文：TM用二次項、HM用上漲市場虛擬變量D（r_m>r_f時D=1）；c>0且顯著表示具備擇時能力。坑點：看c的符號與顯著性而非b；擇時者回報呈凸性（市場上漲時beta自動升高）。
formulas.descriptionEn: TM uses a squared term; HM uses an up-market dummy D (=1 when r_m > r_f); c > 0 and significant indicates timing skill. Pitfalls: read c's sign and significance, not b; timers' payoffs are convex (beta rises in up-markets).

formulas.name: 基於收益的風格分析
formulas.description: 中文：用資產類別指數收益回歸基金收益，權重w_s為風格暴露（非負、和為1），殘差ε反映選券能力。Sharpe：97.3%收益由風格解釋、2.7%由選擇解釋。坑點：權重非負約束；風格分析不用持倉數據。
formulas.descriptionEn: Regress fund returns on asset-class index returns; weights w_s are style exposures (non-negative, summing to one) and ε captures selection skill. Sharpe: 97.3% of returns explained by style, 2.7% by selection. Pitfalls: non-negativity constraint; no holdings data required.

formulas.name: 經理間風險預算分配
formulas.description: 中文：經理i管理的組合權重與其信息比率IR_i成正比、與其跟蹤誤差TE_i成反比（TE_P、IR_P為組合整體的目標）。坑點：比例經IR/TE標準化；總權重和為1需再歸一化。
formulas.descriptionEn: Manager i's weight scales with his information ratio and inversely with tracking error (TE_P, IR_P are the portfolio's targets). Pitfalls: standardized by IR/TE; weights should be renormalized to sum to one.

formulas.name: 政策混合與主動管理風險分解
formulas.latex: $R_p - R_f = \underbrace{\left(\sum_i w_{policy,i} R_i - R_f\right)}_{policy\text{-}mix} + \underbrace{\sum_i (w_{actual,i} - w_{policy,i}) R_i}_{active}$
formulas.description: 中文：總超額收益分解為政策混合（長期資產配置）與主動管理（偏離政策權重與選券）兩部分；兩部分近似不相關時方差可加：σ_total² ≈ σ_policy² + σ_active²。坑點：政策混合風險由SAA決定；主動風險用跟蹤誤差度量；相對VaR = z×σ_主動×V。
formulas.descriptionEn: Total excess return decomposes into policy-mix (long-run allocation) and active-management (deviations and selection) components; with approximate uncorrelation, variances add: σ_total² ≈ σ_policy² + σ_active². Pitfalls: policy-mix risk is set by SAA; active risk is measured by tracking error; relative VaR = z×σ_active×V.

chapters.summary: 本章對應2026年FRM二級Current Issues部分（權重10%），圍繞八大讀物展開：(1) IMF《金融穩定報告》2024年10月第三章「人工智能的進展：對資本市場活動的影響」——AI/GenAI在資本市場的採用、市場結構變化與四大穩定風險；(2) FSB 2024年11月報告「人工智能的金融穩定影響」——收益與脆弱性；(3) Martínez Resano「數字韌性與金融穩定」——網絡風險的系統性與政策工具箱；(4) IMF GFSR 2025年4月第二章「地緣政治風險：對資產價格與金融活動的影響」——GPR度量、傳導渠道與資產價格實證；(5) BIS年度經濟報告2025第2節「貨幣與財政政策：維護穩定與信任」——政府債務上升、財政主導與央行獨立性；(6) IMF金融科技筆記「規範加密生態系統：以無背書加密資產為例」——分類、風險、BCBS處理與巴厘議程；(7) BIS「私人信貸的全球驅動因素」——規模、供需驅動、銀行與機構角色；(8) IMF金融科技筆記「代幣化與金融市場低效率」——代幣化定義、三大特徵、生命週期摩擦與外部性。考試以定性概念題為主，關注結論性表述與關鍵數字。
chapters.summaryEn: This chapter maps to the 2026 FRM Part II Current Issues section (10% weight), covering eight readings: (1) IMF GFSR Oct 2024 Chapter 3 'Advances in Artificial Intelligence: Implications for Capital Market Activities'; (2) FSB Nov 2024 report 'The Financial Stability Implications of Artificial Intelligence'; (3) Martínez Resano, 'Digital Resilience and Financial Stability'; (4) IMF GFSR Apr 2025 Chapter 2 on geopolitical risks and asset prices; (5) BIS Annual Economic Report 2025 Section 2 'Monetary and fiscal policy: safeguarding stability and trust'; (6) IMF Fintech Note 'Regulating the Crypto Ecosystem: The Case of Unbacked Crypto Assets'; (7) BIS 'The Global Drivers of Private Credit'; (8) IMF Fintech Note 'Tokenization and Financial Market Inefficiencies'. The exam tests mostly qualitative concept questions, focusing on conclusive statements and key figures.

concepts.title: AI在資本市場的採用：演進式與革命式
concepts.titleEn: AI Adoption in Capital Markets: Evolutionary vs. Revolutionary
concepts.explanation: IMF GFSR 2024年10月第三章區分兩類採用：(1) 「演進式」（evolutionary）——在既有分析方法上的延伸，已廣泛發生：協助分析師寫代碼、改善客戶服務、生成投資想法；LLM作為輸入提升文本分析預測力；即時處理央行公告等非結構化數據加快市場反應；降低量化投資者進入低流動性資產類別（公司債、主權債）的門檻。(2) 「革命式」（revolutionary）——徹底新建的策略與流程（如無人監督的自主AI交易）仍屬推測性：市場參與者普遍無法接受人類無法理解的AI策略，基於監管、風險管理、責任與倫理原因，「人在環中」（human in the loop）被視為必要。勞動市場與專利證據表明AI採用將顯著上升。考試陷阱：當前使用多為既有ML趨勢的延伸，更大變化屬中長期議題。
concepts.explanationEn: IMF GFSR Oct 2024 Ch3 distinguishes: (1) 'evolutionary' adoption — extensions of existing analytics, already widespread: code-writing help, customer services, investment idea generation; LLMs boosting textual-analysis forecasts; real-time processing of unstructured data (central bank announcements) speeding market reactions; lower entry barriers for quant investors in less liquid assets. (2) 'revolutionary' uses — radically new strategies (autonomous AI trading without oversight) remain speculative: participants view human-unintelligible AI strategies as a nonstarter and consider 'human in the loop' essential for regulatory, risk, liability and ethical reasons. Labor-market and patent evidence points to significantly higher adoption ahead. Exam trap: current use mostly extends existing ML trends; bigger changes are a medium- to long-term concern.

concepts.title: AI對市場結構與動態的改變
concepts.titleEn: AI's Transformation of Market Structures and Dynamics
concepts.explanation: AI可能通過以下途徑改變市場：(1) 算法交易（algorithmic trading）更強大的運用與新交易/投資策略——美國股市採用最激進，活動集中於少數大型參與者；(2) 提高換手率與資產相關性；(3) 價格以越來越快的速度反映新信息；(4) AI推動做市與投資活動進一步遷移至對沖基金、自營交易公司等非銀行金融中介（NBFIs）。網絡效應可能帶來市場結構的深度變化。對新興市場：AI被廣泛視為正面因素（技術跨越、普惠金融、深化本地市場），但若固定成本導致各地採用速度不同，可能產生碎片化風險。考試陷阱：AI也可能「降低」穩定風險——更優的風險管理、更深的市場流動性、更好的監管監測。
concepts.explanationEn: AI may reshape markets through: (1) more powerful algorithmic trading and novel strategies — the US equity market is the most aggressive adopter, with activity concentrated among a few large players; (2) higher turnover and asset correlations; (3) prices reflecting new information ever faster; (4) migration of market-making and investment activities to NBFIs (hedge funds, prop firms). Network effects could deeply change market structure. For EMs: AI is widely seen as positive (leapfrogging, inclusion, deeper local markets), though differing adoption speeds from high fixed costs could create fragmentation risk. Exam trap: AI may also REDUCE stability risks — superior risk management, deeper liquidity, better monitoring by participants and regulators.

concepts.title: AI相關的四大金融穩定風險
concepts.titleEn: Four Broad Categories of AI-Related Financial Stability Risks
concepts.explanation: IMF歸納四類風險：(1) 壓力下的市場速度與波動性上升——尤其當AI交易策略對衝擊作出相似反應（策略高度相關）或在意外事件中同時關閉時；(2) 不透明與監測挑戰——AI系統的極端行為日益難以預測，且AI活動遷移至非銀行中介加大監測難度；(3) 依賴少數關鍵第三方AI服務提供商（算力與大語言模型服務主導者）帶來的操作風險上升；(4) 網絡與市場操縱風險上升——尤其AI生成的欺詐與社交媒體虚假信息（deepfake、disinformation）。這些風險可通過市場信心喪失、借貸成本上升與重大系統中斷傳導至實體經濟。考試陷阱：四大類中「網絡與操縱」與FSB認定的「最直接的穩定風險」相呼應。
concepts.explanationEn: IMF identifies four broad risk categories: (1) increased market speed and volatility under stress — especially if AI trading strategies respond to shocks similarly (highly correlated) or shut down together after unforeseen events; (2) opacity and monitoring challenges — extreme AI behavior is hard to anticipate and AI activity migrates to NBFIs; (3) increased operational risk from reliance on a few key third-party AI service providers (compute and LLM providers); (4) increased cyber and market manipulation risks — notably AI-generated fraud and social media disinformation. These transmit stress to the real economy via loss of confidence, higher borrowing costs and major outages. Exam trap: the cyber/manipulation channel echoes the FSB's 'most immediate financial stability risk'.

concepts.title: AI的政策建議
concepts.titleEn: Policy Recommendations for AI in Capital Markets
concepts.explanation: IMF建議當局：(1) 針對AI驅動的快速價格變動，校準熔斷機制（circuit breakers）並審查保證金實務；(2) 加強對大型交易者（包括非銀行中介）活動的監測與數據收集；(3) 解決對數據、模型與技術基礎設施的依賴——要求受監管機構提供風險映射（risk mapping，即交付關鍵服務所需的內外部互聯與依賴數據）；(4) 採取協調方法界定關鍵AI第三方服務提供商，並通過強化網絡攻擊應對協議維護資本市場韌性；(5) 採取措施確保AI普及後場外市場的誠信、效率與韌性。考試陷阱：現行監管框架已涵蓋許多風險，重點是「準備與監測」，而非立即全面新立法。
concepts.explanationEn: IMF recommends that authorities: (1) calibrate circuit breakers and review margining practices in light of rapid AI-driven price moves; (2) enhance monitoring and data collection on large traders, including NBFIs; (3) address dependency on data, models and technological infrastructure by requesting risk mappings from regulated entities (data on internal/external interconnections needed to deliver critical services); (4) adopt a coordinated approach to defining critical AI third-party service providers and strengthen cyberattack protocols; (5) ensure market integrity, efficiency and resilience of OTC markets as AI use proliferates. Exam trap: existing frameworks already address many risks — the focus is preparedness and monitoring, not immediate wholesale new legislation.

concepts.title: 合成數據：機遇與局限
concepts.titleEn: Synthetic Data: Opportunities and Caveats
concepts.explanation: 合成數據（synthetic data）指由算法生成的、與真實數據相似的數據，可用於訓練與測試AI模型，在數據稀缺的市場（如部分新興市場低效資產）尤有價值：填補數據缺口、提升市場流動性、降低進入壁壘。兩大關鍵局限：(1) 意外的過度或不足代表真實數據分布中的某些取值，損害AI系統在極端事件下的表現（尾部代表性失真）；(2) 若生成過程未考慮二階應用的具體性與要求，合成數據會延續（傳播）偏差。考試陷阱：合成數據有價值但「不能」完全替代真實數據的尾部信息。
concepts.explanationEn: Synthetic data — algorithmically generated, real-data-like data — helps train and test AI models, especially where data are scarce (e.g., less efficient EM assets): filling data gaps, enhancing liquidity and lowering entry barriers. Two key caveats: (1) unintended over- or under-representation of certain values of the real-world distribution undermines extreme-event performance; (2) biases are perpetuated when the generation process ignores the specificities of second-order applications. Exam trap: synthetic data is valuable but cannot fully substitute for real data on tail behavior.

concepts.title: FSB：AI在金融部門的收益
concepts.titleEn: FSB: Benefits of AI in the Financial Sector
concepts.explanation: FSB 2024年11月報告（應G20輪值主席國巴西要求，更新2017年報告）梳理AI（特別是生成式AI）在金融服務的快速採用，收益包括：(1) 前中後台運營效率提升；(2) 更好的合規（RegTech/SupTech應用）；(3) 個性化金融產品與更佳客戶體驗；(4) 風險管理能力增強；(5) 提升金融普惠——改善對未獲服務與服務不足人群的觸達。報告的核心結論：在缺乏適當控制與監督的情況下，AI的使用會「放大現有金融脆弱性」，而非創造全新類別的風險。考試陷阱：FSB認為現有監管框架大體上可涵蓋AI風險，但可能存在需要填補的缺口。
concepts.explanationEn: The FSB Nov 2024 report (for the G20 Brazilian presidency; updates its 2017 report) reviews rapid AI (especially GenAI) adoption in finance. Benefits: (1) improved operational efficiency across front/middle/back office; (2) better compliance via RegTech/SupTech; (3) personalised products and enhanced customer experience; (4) enhanced risk management; (5) greater financial inclusion for unserved/underserved populations. Core finding: without appropriate controls and oversight, AI use AMPLIFIES existing financial vulnerabilities rather than creating wholly new risk categories. Exam trap: the FSB judges existing frameworks likely cover AI risks, though gaps may need addressing.

concepts.title: FSB：AI放大的四大脆弱性
concepts.titleEn: FSB: Four Vulnerabilities Amplified by AI
concepts.explanation: FSB識別AI可能放大的四類脆弱性：(1) 第三方依賴與集中度——對少數AI/雲服務提供商的嚴重依賴（供應鏈集中）；(2) 市場相關性——模型同質化與羊群行為放大市場波動（與IMF結論一致）；(3) 網絡風險放大——AI助長欺詐、deepfake與更複雜的網絡攻擊，FSB將其列為「最直接的金融穩定風險」（most immediate financial stability risk）；(4) 模型風險與薄弱的AI治理——可解釋性（explainability）挑戰、模型錯誤、治理與監督框架不足。考試陷阱：FSB與IMF的風險清單高度重疊，但FSB明確「網絡風險」為最緊迫，且強調「治理/監督」短板。
concepts.explanationEn: The FSB identifies four vulnerabilities AI can amplify: (1) third-party dependencies and concentration — heavy reliance on a few AI/cloud providers; (2) market correlations — model homogeneity and herding amplifying volatility (consistent with the IMF); (3) amplified cyber risk — AI-enabled fraud, deepfakes and more sophisticated attacks, flagged as the MOST immediate financial stability risk; (4) model risk and weak AI governance — explainability challenges, model errors, inadequate governance/oversight. Exam trap: the FSB and IMF lists overlap heavily, but the FSB singles out cyber risk as most immediate and stresses governance/oversight gaps.

concepts.title: FSB對當局的建議與後續監測
concepts.titleEn: FSB Recommendations to Authorities and Follow-up Monitoring
concepts.explanation: FSB呼籲金融當局：(1) 加強對AI採用及相關脆弱性的監測；(2) 評估現有政策框架是否充分（結論：現有框架大體夠用，但缺口需處理）；(3) 在促進安全創新的同時解決AI採用的障礙。FSB於2025年10月發布後續報告《監測AI採用與相關脆弱性》，指出第三方依賴與服務提供商集中度仍是關鍵脆弱性。考試陷阱：FSB的立場是「監測+評估現有框架充分性」，而非呼籲推倒重來的新監管制度。
concepts.explanationEn: The FSB calls on authorities to: (1) enhance monitoring of AI adoption and related vulnerabilities; (2) assess whether existing policy frameworks are adequate (conclusion: likely adequate, but gaps may need addressing); (3) address barriers to AI adoption while fostering safe innovation. Its Oct 2025 follow-up, 'Monitoring Adoption of AI and Related Vulnerabilities in the Financial Sector', finds third-party dependencies and provider concentration remain key vulnerabilities. Exam trap: the FSB stance is 'monitor + assess adequacy of existing frameworks', not a wholesale new regulatory regime.

concepts.title: 網絡風險與金融穩定：從微觀到宏觀
concepts.titleEn: Cyber Risk and Financial Stability: From Micro to Macro
concepts.explanation: Martínez Resano（Banco de España《金融穩定評論》2022）指出：數字化使網絡風險成為金融穩定的核心議題。關鍵論點：(1) 網絡風險具有「系統性」特徵——攻擊可跨機構相關發生（攻擊者策略性選擇時機）、通過互聯與依賴傳播（供應鏈、共同基礎設施），不同於傳統操作風險的獨立性假設；(2) 單一機構層面的微觀審慎工具不足以應對系統性網絡事件，需要「宏觀審慎」視角與政策工具；(3) 網絡風險難以度量與定價（保險覆盖有限、歷史數據少），存在保障缺口（protection gap）。考試陷阱：網絡風險的相關性與傳播性使「操作風險獨立性假設」失效。
concepts.explanationEn: Martínez Resano (Banco de España FSR 2022) argues digitalization makes cyber risk a core financial stability issue. Key points: (1) cyber risk is SYSTEMIC — attacks can be correlated across institutions (attackers act strategically) and propagate via interconnections and dependencies (supply chains, shared infrastructure), breaking the independence assumption of traditional operational risk; (2) microprudential tools at the single-institution level are insufficient for systemic cyber events — a macroprudential perspective and tools are needed; (3) cyber risk is hard to measure and price (limited insurance coverage, scarce history), creating a protection gap. Exam trap: correlation and propagation void the independence assumption underlying operational risk models.

concepts.title: 數字韌性的政策工具箱
concepts.titleEn: The Policy Toolkit for Digital Resilience
concepts.explanation: 論文梳理「追求政策工具」的清單：事前（ex-ante）韌性要求——滲透測試與紅隊演練、網絡壓力測試（如TIBER-EU式的威脅主導滲透測試）、恢復與應急計劃、ICT第三方管理（含集中度評估）；事中與事後——事件報告與信息共享（威脅情報共享、FIRE式統一報告格式）、危機溝通與協調框架、演習；監管基礎設施——監督科技（SupTech）、明確的監管職責分工與問責。要點：工具組合應同時覆蓋「抵禦（withstand）—響應（respond）—恢復（recover）」，且需國際協調（攻擊者跨境而監管屬地）。考試陷阱：僅靠資本金要求無法解決網絡韌性——韌性是運營能力而非資本量。
concepts.explanationEn: The paper's 'quest for policy tools' covers: ex-ante resilience requirements — penetration testing and red teams, cyber stress testing (e.g., TIBER-EU-style threat-led testing), recovery and contingency planning, ICT third-party management including concentration assessment; during/after — incident reporting and threat-intelligence sharing (harmonised formats such as FSB FIRE), crisis communication and coordination frameworks, exercises; and supervisory infrastructure — SupTech, clear mandates and accountability. Key point: the toolkit must cover withstand-respond-recover and requires international coordination (attackers are cross-border; supervision is national). Exam trap: capital requirements alone cannot deliver cyber resilience — resilience is an operational capability, not a capital quantity.

concepts.title: 第三方集中與系統性網絡事件
concepts.titleEn: Third-Party Concentration and Systemic Cyber Events
concepts.explanation: 數字韌性議題的兩大系統性放大器：(1) 第三方/雲服務集中——金融機構廣泛依賴少數雲與技術提供商，單一提供商故障或被攻擊可同時衝擊大量機構（共同點薄弱環節），並造成「太大而不能倒」的提供商；(2) 系統性網絡事件的傳播渠道——直接攻擊多機構、供應鏈攻擊（通過共同供應商）、傳染（信心效應與取款/交易中斷）。政策含義：識別系統性關鍵第三方、對其實施類監管要求、開展跨境聯合演習與風險映射。考試陷阱：雲集中同時帶來規模化安全投資的收益與單點故障的風險，監管需在兩者間平衡。
concepts.explanationEn: Two systemic amplifiers in digital resilience: (1) third-party/cloud concentration — institutions rely on a few cloud and technology providers, so a single provider outage or breach can hit many institutions at once (common point of failure) and create 'too-big-to-fail' providers; (2) propagation channels of systemic cyber events — direct multi-institution attacks, supply-chain attacks via shared vendors, and contagion (confidence effects, interrupted payments/trading). Policy implications: identify systemically critical third parties, apply quasi-regulatory requirements to them, run cross-border joint exercises and risk mappings. Exam trap: cloud concentration brings scaled security investment AND single-point-of-failure risk — supervisors must balance both.

concepts.title: 地緣政治風險的度量
concepts.titleEn: Measuring Geopolitical Risk
concepts.explanation: IMF GFSR 2025年4月第二章基於Caldara–Iacoviello框架：地緣政治風險（GPR）以新聞為本的度量（報紙報導戰爭、恐怖襲擊與緊張局勢的頻率構成的GPR指數）捕捉，自2022年以來急升。補充度量：各國軍事支出占GDP比重、跨境貿易與金融限制措施，綜合「地緣經濟碎片化指標」——已達數十年最高水平。市場層面的敞口度量：GPR beta——控制市場因素後股票收益對地緣政治衝擊的敏感度；其截面分布近乎對稱（正負敏感度並存）。考試陷阱：GPR指數是新聞文本計數指標，不是市場價格隱含指標；GPR beta衡量個股/國家對GPR衝擊的敏感度。
concepts.explanationEn: IMF GFSR Apr 2025 Ch2 builds on the Caldara–Iacoviello framework: geopolitical risk is captured by NEWS-BASED measures (the GPR index counting newspaper coverage of wars, terrorist threats and tensions), which has surged since 2022. Complementary measures: military spending relative to GDP and restrictions on cross-border trade/financial transactions, blended into a geoeconomic fragmentation index at its highest in decades. Market-based exposure: the GPR beta — sensitivity of stock returns to geopolitical shocks controlling for market factors; its cross-sectional distribution is nearly symmetric. Exam trap: the GPR index is a news-text count, not a market-implied measure; GPR beta measures sensitivity of stocks/countries to GPR shocks.

concepts.title: 地緣政治風險的傳導渠道
concepts.titleEn: Transmission Channels of Geopolitical Risk
concepts.explanation: 兩大渠道：(1) 經濟渠道（影響現金流的實際效應）——貿易/金融限制擾亂供應鏈、逆轉資本流動、打擊被制裁經濟體的需求；針對增長與通脹的政策反應（貨幣緊縮、國防開支）間接影響資產價格；軍事衝突摧毀物質與生產能力、抑制投資；財政可持續性受質疑時主權利差與CDS走闊，激活主權-銀行關聯（sovereign-bank nexus）放大不穩定。(2) 市場情緒渠道（不確定性與風險厭惡）——事件發生前不確定性已上升，壓低估值、推高流動性與信用風險；價格急跌觸發保證金追繳、贖回與拋售，形成傳染與不利的宏觀金融反饋環。實證：重大衝擊後風險厭惡與不確定性均上升，但不確定性效應更持久。考試陷阱：區分「現金流渠道」與「貼現率/情緒渠道」的具體例子。
concepts.explanationEn: Two channels: (1) the economic channel (real effects on cash flows) — trade/financial restrictions disrupt supply chains, reverse capital flows and hit demand in targeted economies; policy responses to growth/inflation shifts (monetary tightening, defense spending) move asset prices indirectly; military conflict destroys physical and productive capacity, depressing investment; sovereign spreads and CDS widen when fiscal sustainability is questioned, activating the sovereign-bank nexus. (2) The market sentiment channel (uncertainty and risk aversion) — uncertainty rises before events materialize, depressing valuations and raising liquidity/credit risks; abrupt price drops trigger margin calls, redemptions and fire sales, creating contagion and adverse macrofinancial feedback loops. Empirically both risk aversion and uncertainty rise after shocks, but uncertainty is more persistent. Exam trap: match examples to the cash-flow vs discount-rate/sentiment channels.

concepts.title: 地緣政治衝擊下的資產價格反應
concepts.titleEn: Asset Price Reactions to Geopolitical Shocks
concepts.explanation: 關鍵實證結論：(1) 股票——典型國別衝擊使總體股價下跌約0.3%（按兩個標準差縮放），持續兩年以上；嚴重衝擊影響約為其7倍；全球性衝擊使股價下跌約1%、持續約一季度；平均而言股市下跌約3%，嚴重事件可達9%。(2) 案例——2022年俄烏：俄股單日暴跌33%；中美關稅（2018-24）：關稅公布後中國股票平均跌約4%。(3) 商品——石油與黃金通常上漲；商品進口國CDS走闊更多並伴隨貨幣貶值，出口國CDS收窄甚至股市上漲；受益行業：能源、國防/航空航天、替代能源；脆弱行業：可選消費、公用事業、全球供應鏈與銀行。(4) 主權風險溢價——重大衝突後一個月內CDS走闊約40bps（發達）vs約180bps（新興）；高公共債務、低儲備（約+100bps）、弱制度（約+120bps）是放大器；避險國長端收益率下降而新興市場收益率上升。(5) 風險定價——2012-2021年GPR溢價為負（做多高GPR beta/做空低GPR beta月均約−5%），2022年後轉正（約+1.1%）。考試陷阱：新興市場企業受損遠大於發達市場企業（後者受益於避險流入）。
concepts.explanationEn: Key empirical findings: (1) Equities — a typical country-specific shock cuts aggregate stock prices ~0.3% (scaled to two SDs), persisting two-plus years; severe shocks are ~7x larger; global shocks cause ~1% declines lasting about a quarter; on average equities fall ~3%, up to 9% for severe events. (2) Cases — Russia-Ukraine 2022: Russian stocks collapsed 33% in one day; US-China tariffs 2018-24: Chinese stocks fell ~4% on average after tariff announcements. (3) Commodities — oil and gold typically rise; commodity importers see CDS widen more plus currency depreciation, exporters see CDS decline; energy, defense/aerospace and alternative energy benefit; consumer discretionary, utilities, supply chains and banks are vulnerable. (4) Sovereign risk premia — CDS widen ~40 bps (advanced) vs ~180 bps (emerging) within a month of major conflict; high debt, low reserves (~+100 bps) and weak institutions (~+120 bps) amplify. (5) Risk pricing — the GPR premium was negative in 2012-21 (long-high-beta/short-low-beta ~ -5%/month) and turned positive (~+1.1%) after 2022. Exam trap: EM firms suffer far more than AEs, which benefit from safe-haven inflows.

concepts.title: 金融機構的地緣敞口與政策應對
concepts.titleEn: Financial Institutions' Geopolitical Exposures and Policy Responses
concepts.explanation: 敞口現狀：對受影響國家的敞口約占跨境銀行債權的8%、負債的10%（2024下半年），遠高於歷史約3%的水平；股票基金在受影響國家的持倉2024年達基金資產的13%。傳導：銀行股價下跌削弱貸款增長、推高融資成本與不良貸款；對衝突國家敞口10%的債券基金收益下降1.0個百分點、資金流出2.3個百分點；俄烏敞口10%的基金一周累虧約6%、六個月資金流出8%，基金隨後削減直接敞口約60%。政策建議：機構應投入地緣政治分析資源、將地緣情景嵌入壓力測試、按極端但合理的損失校準資本與流動性緩衝、監測直接與間接（二階）敞口；監管者應收集敞口數據並強化非銀行工具（如開放式基金流動性管理）；新興市場應發展衍生品市場對沖、保持充足國際儲備、控制財政脆弱性。考試陷阱：間接敞口（供應鏈、二階效應）往往大於直接敞口。
concepts.explanationEn: Exposures: claims on affected countries reached ~8% of cross-border bank claims and ~10% of liabilities (H2 2024), up from ~3% historically; equity fund holdings in exposed countries hit 13% of fund assets in 2024. Transmission: bank equity declines reduce loan growth and raise funding costs/NPLs; bond funds with 10% exposure to conflict countries saw returns fall 1.0 point and flows fall 2.3 points; funds with 10% Russia/Ukraine exposure lost ~6% in a week and 8% of flows over six months, then cut direct exposures ~60%. Policy: institutions should devote resources to geopolitical analysis, embed geopolitical scenarios in stress tests, calibrate capital/liquidity buffers to extreme-but-plausible losses, and monitor direct and indirect (second-order) exposures; supervisors should collect exposure data and strengthen NBFI tools; EMDEs should deepen derivatives markets, hold adequate reserves and contain fiscal vulnerabilities. Exam trap: indirect exposures (supply chains, second-order effects) often exceed direct ones.

concepts.title: 政府債務上升與財政空間
concepts.titleEn: Rising Government Debt and Fiscal Space
concepts.explanation: BIS年度經濟報告2025第2節「貨幣與財政政策：維護穩定與信任」的核心：公共債務處於和平時期高位且結構性上升（老齡化、國防、能源轉型等支出壓力），市場對財政可持續性的關注升溫。要點：(1) 財政政策必須確保公共債務軌跡可持續，並「恢復在需要時支持經濟的空間」——債務太高會侵蝕未來逆周期發力能力；(2) 高債務推高期限溢價與利率敏感度，使財政處境對利率上升更脆弱；(3) 債務市場對財政信號更敏感：財政消息能明顯推動收益率曲線。考試陷阱：BIS的立場不是「緊縮萬能」，而是「先修復財政空間，貨幣財政才能在下次衝擊時協同發力」。
concepts.explanationEn: Core of BIS AER 2025 Section 2 ('Monetary and fiscal policy: safeguarding stability and trust'): public debt is at peacetime highs and structurally rising (ageing, defense, energy transition spending pressures), and market focus on fiscal sustainability is intensifying. Points: (1) fiscal policy must ensure a sustainable public debt trajectory and 'restore space to support the economy when needed' — too much debt erodes future countercyclical capacity; (2) high debt raises term premia and rate sensitivity, making fiscal positions more fragile to rising rates; (3) debt markets are more sensitive to fiscal signals — fiscal news moves yield curves visibly. Exam trap: the BIS stance is not 'austerity above all' but 'repair fiscal space first so monetary and fiscal policy can jointly respond to the next shock'.

concepts.title: 財政主導與央行獨立性
concepts.titleEn: Fiscal Dominance and Central Bank Independence
concepts.explanation: BIS警告的關鍵風險——財政主導（fiscal dominance）：當政府債務負擔過重時，貨幣政策可能被迫遷就財政需要（維持低利率以降低償債成本、容忍更高通脹以稀釋實際債務），犧牲價格穩定目標。後果：(1) 通脹預期脫錨、央行信譽受損；(2) 貨幣與財政的邊界模糊，「財政理論」開始定價——市場用財政前景而非貨幣政策解釋通脹；(3) 對「貨幣的信任」（trust in money）受侵蝕。政策藥方：貨幣與財政職責清晰分離；政府整固債務，讓央行能獨立實現價格穩定；維護央行獨立性是通脹預期錨定的基石。考試陷阱：「財政主導」的標誌不是赤字本身，而是貨幣政策被債務約束所俘獲。
concepts.explanationEn: The BIS warns of fiscal dominance: when the government debt burden is too heavy, monetary policy may be forced to accommodate fiscal needs (keeping rates low to reduce debt service, tolerating higher inflation to dilute real debt) at the expense of price stability. Consequences: (1) de-anchored inflation expectations and damaged central bank credibility; (2) blurred monetary-fiscal boundaries — markets start pricing inflation from fiscal prospects; (3) erosion of trust in money. Prescription: clear separation of monetary and fiscal responsibilities; governments consolidate debt so central banks can independently deliver price stability; central bank independence underpins the inflation anchor. Exam trap: the hallmark of fiscal dominance is not the deficit itself but monetary policy being captured by debt constraints.

concepts.title: 維護穩定與信任的政策要求
concepts.titleEn: Policy Requirements to Safeguard Stability and Trust
concepts.explanation: BIS 2025第2節的藥方框架：(1) 貨幣政策——完成讓通脹回歸目標的「最後一英里」，避免過早寬鬆；維持央行信譽與獨立性；(2) 財政政策——確保債務軌跡可持續、修復財政緩衝與空間；(3) 結構性——推進有利於增長的改革以「做大分母」（增長化債）；(4) 制度——避免財政主導，維護「對貨幣的信任」這一貨幣金融體系的基石；審慎對待央行數字貨幣與穩定幣對信任的影響。考試陷阱：報告標題中的「信任」（trust）既指對貨幣的信任（低且穩定的通脹），也指對制度（央行獨立性）的信任。
concepts.explanationEn: The BIS 2025 Section 2 prescription: (1) monetary policy — finish the 'last mile' of returning inflation to target, avoid premature easing, preserve central bank credibility and independence; (2) fiscal policy — ensure a sustainable debt trajectory and rebuild fiscal buffers and space; (3) structural — growth-friendly reforms to 'grow out' of debt; (4) institutional — avoid fiscal dominance and safeguard trust in money, the foundation of the monetary system; be prudent about CBDCs and stablecoins for trust. Exam trap: 'trust' in the title covers both trust in money (low, stable inflation) and trust in institutions (central bank independence).

concepts.title: 加密資產的分類
concepts.titleEn: Classification of Crypto Assets
concepts.explanation: IMF金融科技筆記：加密資產是「利用密碼學原理保護交易並在去中心化網絡上管理轉移的數字資產」，通常基於DLT。四大類別：(1) 無背書加密資產（unbacked）——如比特幣、以太幣，無實物或金融資產背書，主要用於投機，波動極大、價值儲存功能差；(2) 功能型代幣（utility tokens）——換取平台產品/服務的訪問權（如BAT、Filecoin）；(3) 證券型代幣（security tokens）——代表對股票、房地產等資產的投資，通常受現行證券法約束（披露與投資者保護義務）；(4) 穩定幣（stablecoins）——錨定法幣、商品或其他加密資產（Tether、USDC、算法穩定幣DAI），降低波動以便日常使用。考試陷阱：分類決定監管待遇——黃金背書代幣是「非原生」代幣，而以債券為儲備的美元穩定幣是「原生」代幣。
concepts.explanationEn: IMF Fintech Note: crypto assets are 'digital assets that use cryptographic principles' to secure transactions on decentralized networks, typically DLT-based. Four categories: (1) unbacked crypto assets — Bitcoin, Ether; no backing by physical/financial assets, mainly speculative, highly volatile, poor stores of value; (2) utility tokens — access to a platform product/service (BAT, Filecoin); (3) security tokens — represent investment in stocks/real estate, usually subject to securities law (disclosure, investor protection); (4) stablecoins — pegged to fiat, commodities or other crypto (Tether, USDC, algorithmic DAI), reducing volatility for everyday use. Exam trap: classification drives regulation — a gold-backed token is NON-native; a USD stablecoin backed by bonds is native because bonds are not the unit of account.

concepts.title: 加密生態系統的組成與風險
concepts.titleEn: Components and Risks of the Crypto Ecosystem
concepts.explanation: 生態系統組成及各自風險：(1) 發行者——常匿名/去中心化，問責與執法困難；(2) 交易所——核心基礎設施，面臨網絡攻擊與運營失敗（Mt. Gox 2014年損失約85萬枚BTC）；(3) 錢包提供商——私鑰泄露風險；(4) 驗證者/礦工——能源低效與自私挖礦風險；(5) DLT本身——51%攻擊、技術故障；(6) 受監管金融機構——其加密敞口可將風險傳導至金融穩定。數據缺口是反覆出現的主題：數據不可靠妨礙評估系統性影響，解決方案包括統一分類、區塊鏈分析與強制報告。考試陷阱：無背書資產波動案例——比特幣從2021年11月約6.5萬美元跌至2022年6月不足2萬美元。
concepts.explanationEn: Ecosystem components and their risks: (1) issuers — often anonymous/decentralized, complicating accountability; (2) exchanges — core infrastructure exposed to cyberattacks and operational failures (Mt. Gox lost ~850,000 BTC in 2014); (3) wallet providers — private-key compromise; (4) validators/miners — energy inefficiency, selfish mining; (5) DLT itself — 51% attacks, technical failure; (6) regulated financial institutions — their crypto exposures can transmit risk to financial stability. Data gaps recur: unreliable data hinders systemic assessment; solutions include consistent taxonomies, blockchain analytics and mandated reporting. Exam trap: unbacked volatility case — Bitcoin fell from ~$65,000 (Nov 2021) to below $20,000 (Jun 2022).

concepts.title: 無背書加密資產的四大風險維度
concepts.titleEn: Four Risk Dimensions of Unbacked Crypto Assets
concepts.explanation: (1) 金融穩定風險——極端波動、投機泡沫（2017年ICO狂潮）、貨幣替代削弱貨幣政策（委內瑞拉、阿根廷）、新興市場敞口（薩爾瓦多2021年採用比特幣為法定貨幣）；(2) 消費者保護——運營失敗、網絡攻擊（2016年DAO攻擊約5,000萬美元）、拉高出貨操縱、缺乏追索與保險（QuadrigaCX 2019）；(3) 市場誠信——成交量與儲備不透明、槓桿高達100倍放大下行（2022年連環清算）、內幕交易與欺詐（Centra Tech 2018）；(4) 監管套利——司法轄區跳躍至寬鬆體制（開曼、馬耳他）造成「逐底競爭」、跨境執法缺口（中國禁令經VPN與離岸平台被繞過）。考試陷阱：四個維度要能與具體案例配對。
concepts.explanationEn: (1) Financial stability — extreme volatility, speculative bubbles (2017 ICO crash), currency substitution undermining monetary policy (Venezuela, Argentina), EM exposure (El Salvador's 2021 Bitcoin legal-tender adoption); (2) consumer protection — operational failures, cyberattacks (2016 DAO hack ~$50M), pump-and-dump manipulation, lack of recourse/insurance (QuadrigaCX 2019); (3) market integrity — opaque volumes/reserves, leverage up to 100x amplifying downturns (2022 liquidations), insider trading and fraud (Centra Tech 2018); (4) regulatory arbitrage — jurisdiction hopping to lax regimes (Cayman, Malta) creating a race to the bottom, cross-border enforcement gaps (China's ban circumvented via VPNs/offshore platforms). Exam trap: pair the four dimensions with concrete cases.

concepts.title: 加密資產的監管應對：BCBS與巴厘議程
concepts.titleEn: Regulatory Responses: BCBS Treatment and the Bali Fintech Agenda
concepts.explanation: BCBS對銀行加密敞口的處理：(1) Group 1a——代幣化傳統資產，適用標準風險權重；(2) Group 1b——滿足嚴格穩定、儲備與贖回標準的穩定幣，可享優惠處理，否則歸入更審慎類別；未經考驗的技術可加「基礎設施風險加成」；(3) Group 2a/2b——無背書資產適用1,250%風險權重（資本須完全覆蓋敞口），Group 2b不承認對沖；(4) 敞口限額——Group 2敞口不得超過銀行一級資本的1%，超出部分按Group 2b處理。巴厘金融科技議程（IMF/世界銀行12項要素）要點：持續監測、適應性法律框架與法律確定性、穩健的數據基礎設施與強制報告。考試陷阱：1,250%風險權重與1%一級資本限額是高頻考點。
concepts.explanationEn: BCBS treatment of bank crypto exposures: (1) Group 1a — tokenized traditional assets, standard risk weights; (2) Group 1b — stablecoins meeting strict stability, backing and redemption standards may get preferential treatment; an infrastructure risk add-on applies to untested technology; (3) Group 2a/2b — unbacked assets carry a 1,250% risk weight (capital effectively covering the full exposure); Group 2b gets no hedging recognition; (4) exposure limit — Group 2 exposure capped at 1% of Tier 1 capital, excess treated under Group 2b. The IMF/World Bank Bali Fintech Agenda (12 elements): continuous monitoring, adaptive legal frameworks and legal certainty, robust data infrastructure and mandated reporting. Exam trap: the 1,250% risk weight and 1% Tier 1 limit are high-frequency exam points.

concepts.title: 私人信貸的規模與全球驅動因素
concepts.titleEn: The Scale and Global Drivers of Private Credit
concepts.explanation: BIS 2025年3月季報（Avalos, Doerr, Pinter）：私人信貸（private credit）過去二十年快速增長並擴展到更多國家——全球未償貸款從2010年約1,000億美元增至超過1.2萬億美元，含未投資資本的總資產超過2萬億美元。核心發現（跨國供需分析）：私人信貸的足跡在「政策利率較低」和「銀行監管更嚴格/限制更多」的國家更大——即傳統銀行放貸受約束或低利率推動投資者追求收益的地方，私人信貸增長更快。考試陷阱：驅動因素是「供需結合」——借款人需求（靈活、保密的融資）與投資者供給（保險公司、養老金等尋求收益與分散化）共同作用。
concepts.explanationEn: BIS Quarterly Review Mar 2025 (Avalos, Doerr, Pinter): private credit grew rapidly over two decades and spread across countries — global outstanding loans rose from ~$100 billion in 2010 to over $1.2 trillion, with total assets including undeployed capital above $2 trillion. Headline cross-country finding: private credit's footprint is LARGER in countries with LOWER policy rates and MORE stringent banking regulation/restrictions — it grows where bank lending is constrained or where low rates push investors toward yield. Exam trap: drivers combine demand and supply — borrower demand (flexible, confidential financing) plus investor supply (insurers, pension funds seeking yield and diversification).

concepts.title: 銀行與機構投資者在私人信貸中的角色
concepts.titleEn: The Role of Banks and Institutional Investors in Private Credit
concepts.explanation: 銀行是關鍵供給驅動者——銀行對私人信貸基金（NBFIs）的貸款：在美國銀行總貸款中占10.4%，是十年前3.6%的近三倍；銀行通過貸款給基金、共同發放與購買份額參與，形成銀行-非銀行相互關聯。機構投資者是資本來源——保險公司、養老基金及其他機構投資者（含BDC業務發展公司）為追求更高回報與分散化向私人信貸基金配置資本；保險公司的關聯投資（general account）尤其值得關注。考試陷阱：銀行對私人信貸的敞口是「間接」的——即使銀行不直接放貸，對基金的貸款也形成傳染渠道。
concepts.explanationEn: Banks are a key supply driver — loans from banks to private credit funds (NBFIs) now make up 10.4% of US banks' total loans, nearly triple the 3.6% of a decade ago; banks participate via fund lending, co-origination and stakes, creating bank-NBFI interconnections. Institutional investors are the capital source — insurers, pension funds and other institutions (including BDCs) allocate to private credit funds seeking higher returns and diversification; insurers' general-account investments are especially noteworthy. Exam trap: banks' exposure to private credit is INDIRECT — even without direct lending, loans to funds create a contagion channel.

concepts.title: 私人信貸的風險與透明度
concepts.titleEn: Risks and Transparency of Private Credit
concepts.explanation: 風險：(1) 透明度低——估值由基金自行按模型標記（mark-to-model）、報告頻率低（季度且滯後），波動與相關性可能被低估（與非流動資產偏差邏輯一致，參見unsmoothing）；(2) 流動性錯配——開放式基金或半流動結構面臨投資者贖回壓力時被迫出售貸款；(3) 信用風險集中——借款人多為中型槓桿企業，利率上升期利息覆蓋率惡化；(4) 相互關聯——銀行、保險公司對基金的敞口形成傳染渠道；(5) 資產與負債幣種/期限錯配。FSB估計截至2024年底私人信貸放貸總額為1.5-2萬億美元。政策含義：加強數據收集與披露、監測銀行-基金關聯、審視開放式基金流動性管理。考試陷阱：估值平滑讓私人信貸的「低波動」表象部分是偏差。
concepts.explanationEn: Risks: (1) low transparency — valuations are mark-to-model by funds, reported quarterly with lags; volatility and correlations may be understated (same bias logic as illiquid assets, cf. unsmoothing); (2) liquidity mismatch — open-ended or semi-liquid structures face forced loan sales under redemption pressure; (3) credit concentration — borrowers are mostly mid-sized leveraged firms whose interest coverage deteriorates as rates rise; (4) interconnections — bank and insurer exposures to funds create contagion channels; (5) currency/term mismatches. The FSB estimates private credit lending at $1.5-2 trillion as of end-2024. Policy: strengthen data collection and disclosure, monitor bank-fund links, review open-end fund liquidity management. Exam trap: valuation smoothing makes private credit's 'low volatility' partly a bias.

concepts.title: 代幣化的定義與三大特徵
concepts.titleEn: Tokenization: Definition and Three Fundamental Features
concepts.explanation: IMF金融科技筆記（2025年1月）：數字代幣是「存在於數字賬本上的資產（或其代表）」，具有三個連續特徵——共享性（sharedness）、信任（trust）、可編程性（programmability）。代幣化=在共享、可編程且受信任的賬本上創建資產或資產代表；定義是「技術中立」的——不要求使用DLT/區塊鏈。三大特徵：(1) 共享性——多方可以持有、取得與轉讓賬本資產，通過接入或賬本合併增長；(2) 信任——所有權記錄準確（轉讓需同意且不可逆）與指令可預期執行的信心；(3) 可編程性——智能合約實現不可變邏輯、可組合性（composability，應用可復用）與原子性（atomicity，單一不可分割交易——要麼全部成功要麼全部不執行）。規模：BCG預測2030年代幣化可達約16萬億美元（約占全球GDP 10%）。考試陷阱：不要把代幣化等同於DLT；區分「同時結算」（兩腿同時）與「即時結算」（協議後立即）。
concepts.explanationEn: IMF Fintech Note (Jan 2025): a digital token is an asset (or representation) on a digital ledger with three features on a continuum — sharedness, trust, programmability. Tokenization = creating assets or representations on a ledger that is shared, programmable and trusted; the definition is technology-NEUTRAL — it does not require DLT/blockchain. Features: (1) sharedness — parties can hold, acquire and transfer ledger assets, growing via onboarding or ledger mergers; (2) trust — confidence that ownership records are accurate (transfers need consent and are irreversible) and instructions execute predictably; (3) programmability — smart contracts enable immutable logic, composability (reusable applications) and atomicity (single inseparable transaction — all steps succeed or none). Scale: BCG projects ~$16 trillion (~10% of global GDP) by 2030. Exam traps: never equate tokenization with DLT; distinguish simultaneous settlement (both legs together) from instantaneous settlement (immediately after agreement).

concepts.title: 代幣創建形式與賬本/信任模型
concepts.titleEn: Forms of Token Creation and Ledger/Trust Models
concepts.explanation: 代幣創建形式：(1) 原生代幣（native）——直接發行在賬本上、僅存在於賬本；(2) 非原生代幣（non-native）——托管人持有的鏈下資產的虛擬代表；(3) 遷移（migration）——以原生代幣取代非原生代幣及其背書資產。共享性模型：單一賬本（everyone有賬戶）、共同賬本（托管+憑證）、兼容賬本（標準化互操作）。信任模型：單一運營方（中心化，靠運營方信譽與法律救濟）、無許可DLT（去中心化驗證，如比特幣、以太坊）、許可DLT（混合：中心監督+分布式驗證）。信任失敗示例：51%共識攻擊、搶跑/三明治攻擊、預言機漏洞；單一運營方或許可當局可任意修改記錄。考試陷阱：賬本碎片化（fragmentation）是共享性的「下降」而非上升。
concepts.explanationEn: Token creation: (1) native tokens — issued directly on the ledger, existing only there; (2) non-native tokens — virtual representations of custodian-held off-ledger assets; (3) migration — replacing a non-native token and its backing asset with a native token. Sharedness models: single ledger (accounts for all), common ledger (escrow + certificates), compatible ledgers (standardized, interoperable). Trust models: single operator (centralized; trust via operator credibility and legal recourse), permissionless DLT (decentralized validation — Bitcoin, Ethereum), permissioned DLT (central oversight with distributed validation). Trust failures: 51% consensus attacks, front-running/sandwich attacks, oracle vulnerabilities; single operators or permissioned authorities can alter records at will. Exam trap: ledger fragmentation is a DECREASE in sharedness.

concepts.title: 資產生命週期中的摩擦與效率提升
concepts.titleEn: Frictions and Efficiency Gains Across the Asset Lifecycle
concepts.explanation: 代幣化對資產生命週期各階段的影響：(1) 發行——共享賬本省去登記與托管成本，智能合約自動化拍賣，債券條款與ESG數據可嵌入；(2) 交易——「同時結算」在自動交換前鎖定兩腿，等效於DVP（券款對付）執行；「即時結算」縮短多日清算周期；直接撮合削減場外搜尋摩擦與價差。局限：從締約到結算之間的衍生品對手方風險依然存在——仍需CCP或昂貴的抵押品鎖定；(3) 服務/贖回——股息與利息自動支付，服務邏輯嵌入代幣。實證證據：代幣化債券承銷費、收益率利差與買賣價差更低；基於區塊鏈的ABS收益率比傳統ABS低約25bps。考試陷阱：代幣化緩解的是「即時交易的對手方風險」，不能消除衍生品的對手方風險。
concepts.explanationEn: Lifecycle effects: (1) issuance — shared ledgers remove registrar and custodian costs, smart contracts automate auctions, bond terms and ESG data embeddable; (2) trading — simultaneous settlement locks both legs before automated exchange, effectively DVP execution; instantaneous settlement shortens multi-day clearing cycles; direct matching cuts OTC search frictions and spreads. Limitation: derivatives counterparty risk between initiation and settlement persists — a CCP or costly collateral lock-in is still needed; (3) servicing/redemption — automated dividend and interest payments, servicing logic embedded in tokens. Empirics: tokenized bonds show lower underwriting fees, yield spreads and bid-ask spreads; blockchain-based ABS yields ~25 bps less than traditional ABS. Exam trap: tokenization mitigates immediate-trade counterparty risk, NOT derivatives risk.

concepts.title: 代幣化的外部性、內部性與市場力量
concepts.titleEn: Tokenization: Externalities, Internalities and Market Power
concepts.explanation: 代幣化的雙面效應：(1) 衝擊傳播外部性——更便宜的債務提高加槓桿激勵；零售存款轉向增加對脆弱批發融資的依賴；互聯與更快的自動化交易放大衝擊與閃崩風險；(2) 基礎設施投資不足——互聯與集中（共享賬本是單一攻擊點）導致安全投資不足；(3) 網絡外部性——正面：共享性提高流動性、支持碎片化份額；負面：碎片化且不互操作的賬本降低流動性；(4) 知識外部性——共享基礎設施便利開發者創新；(5) 零售內部性（internalities）——直接訪問與複雜產品構建更容易，產生內部性成本；無許可賬本妨礙監管執法；(6) 市場力量——雙向：更低的轉換成本與直接交易選項約束經紀商費用，但私人賬本所有者可憑網絡效應與規模提取壟斷租金。核心結論：糾正一種低效率（如交易成本）可能惡化另一種（如槓桿外部性）。考試陷阱：代幣化效應是「雙刃劍」，題目常考方向判斷。
concepts.explanationEn: Two-sided effects: (1) shock-transmission externalities — cheaper debt raises leverage incentives; retail deposit shifts increase reliance on fragile wholesale funding; interconnected, faster automated trading amplifies shocks and flash-crash risk; (2) infrastructure underinvestment — interconnectedness and concentration (a shared ledger as a single attack point) reduce security investment; (3) network externalities — positive: more sharedness boosts liquidity and fractionalization; negative: fragmented, noninteroperable ledgers reduce liquidity; (4) knowledge externalities — shared infrastructure eases developer innovation; (5) retail internalities — direct access and easier construction of complex products create internalities; permissionless ledgers hinder enforcement; (6) market power cuts both ways — lower switching costs discipline broker fees, but private ledger owners may extract monopoly rents via network effects and scale. Core conclusion: fixing one inefficiency (transaction costs) can worsen another (leverage externalities). Exam trap: effects are double-edged — questions test direction.
